articles.title: Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning from Point Prompts
articles.content: Existing 3D part decomposition methods do not necessarily partition the original shape into non-overlapping parts that collectively cover the entire shape, allowing overlaps or gaps that hinder downstream part-level applications. We instead formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape, where the predicted parts are non-overlapping and jointly recover the entire shape. Our key insight is that part decomposition should consider all desired parts jointly, rather than modeling each part independently. To this end, we develop a promptable model for 3D part decomposition from images or meshes. Users can specify desired parts through 3D point prompts for controllable decomposition. Given one point prompt per desired part, our model produces the corresponding parts as a complete partition of the entire shape. We build on a pretrained 3D generation model and first obtain a shape latent from either an input image or mesh. We then introduce a prompt encoder that maps each 3D point prompt to a part token while attending to the shape latent. To decode the desired parts, we propose a novel part decoder jointly scoring the entire shape against all part tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, assigning every position within the shape volume to exactly one part. We perform part decomposition in this shared shape latent space, enabling a unified model for image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation. Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods. Code and models will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 点2 部分: 从点提示进行统一三维分隔
articles.content_zh: 现有的3D部分分解方法并不一定将原始形状分割成非重叠部分,这些部分共同覆盖整个形状,允许重叠或漏洞阻碍下游部分层面的应用. 我们而是将部分分解制成整个形状的联合分割,其中预测的部分不重叠,共同恢复整个形状. 我们的主要见解是,分解部分应共同考虑所有理想部分,而不是独立地模拟每一部分。 为此,我们开发了一个从图像或元件中分解3D部分的快速模型. 用户可以通过3D点提示指定想要的部分,用于可控分解. 鉴于每个理想部分的1分速率,我们的模型产生相应的部分,作为整个形状的完整分割. 我们利用预先训练的3D生成模型,首先从输入图像或网格中获取一个潜在形状。 然后,我们引入一个快速编码器,将每个3D点的提示映射到一个部分符号,同时注意形状的潜在。 为了解码想要的部分,我们提议用一个新颖的部分解码器 以粗细的方式将整块形状 与所有部分的标志进行联合评分, 将形状体积内的每个位置 都分配给一个部分。 我们在这个共享的形状潜在空间中进行部分分解, 使得图像到部分的生成, 网格到部分的生成, 和部分的分解能够有一个统一的模型。 我们的方法超越了所有三项任务中所有部分质量度量标准的现有工作,并且比以往的SOTA方法以数量级提高各部分之间的兼容性。 将发布代码和模型。

articles.title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
articles.content: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 想象 3D- LLM: 将 MLLMs 教给 imagine 3D 幕后回答
articles.content_zh: 从多视图图像来解释3D世界仍然是多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的根本挑战. 现代的MLLMs虽然有效地处理单一图像输入,但很难将不同观点的证据纳入一致的3D理解中. 越来越多的工作试图通过向MLLMs注入3D意识来弥补这一差距,要么通过增强精细的像素水平交叉视图通信,要么通过从3D几何基础模型中引信特征,然而与人类推理的巨大差距依然存在. 在这部作品中,我们重新审视了人类的空间推理,这说明人类与其依赖精细的几何提示,不如大致辨别各种观点之间的共同物体,推断观点之间的相对几何,并组装了场景粗糙的3D布局. 在这一过程的启发下,我们引入了Imagine3D-LLM,这是一种MLLM,它学习将场景的类似紧凑的3D表现集合起来,并且为它对这一表现的回答提供了条件. 具体地说,我们在图像符号之后附加了一小组可学习的汇总符号,把它们解码成一个紧凑的3D高斯电镀表示器,由光度重建损失监督,并结合标准下键预测目标一起训练. 值得注意的是,虽然只有摘要符号直接接受重建监督,但这一目标还促使LLM的基本图像特征内有更强的跨框架通信,表明学习重建在整个模型中传播3D-意识信号. 因此,Imagine3D-LLM在跨多个空间推理和3D理解基准的以往方法上,一贯的超越效果,说明想象场景比被告知其像素几何效果更有效.

articles.title: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
articles.content: Teaching humanoids loco-manipulation skills, such as carrying diverse objects, via visual imitation is a promising path toward generalist robots. However, collecting diverse, high-quality interaction videos, such as clips that clearly show a person's full body and unoccluded interactions with objects, poses a practical barrier to scaling this approach. We propose PRISM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that overcomes this limitation by amplifying a handful of real videos into a large, diverse training set. PRISM first generates hundreds of diverse "counterfactual" human-object interaction videos via video-to-video (V2V) generation from a few exemplar real videos. Our contact-anchored real-to-sim pipeline then reconstructs both human and object motions, retargeting this imperfect video data into physically plausible trajectories. The intra-class variability across these counterfactual videos lets us train a single policy that generalizes to unseen objects within each category. We demonstrate the full pipeline by deploying this policy on a real robot without any real-world fine-tuning. Using only onboard depth observations, our humanoid picks up, carries, and drops objects, including boxes, barrels, bins, and balls, across novel instances, sizes, and initial configurations.

articles.title_zh: 反事实视频生成启用可缩放的人体Loco- 管理
articles.content_zh: 通过视觉模仿来教授人造机器人的操作技巧,例如携带不同的物体,是通俗主义机器人的一条有希望的道路。 然而,收集多样,高质量的互动视频,如清晰显示一个人全身的剪辑和与物体的无遮挡互动,对推广这种方法构成了实际障碍. 我们提出PISM, 一个真实到真实的框架, PISM首先通过视频到视频(V2V)生成数百个多样化的"反事实"人类对象交互视频,这些视频来自几个实例性真实视频. 然后我们接触的真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对真对 这些反事实视频的阶级内部变化让我们能够 执行一个单一的政策 将它概括到每个类别中看不见的物体上 我们通过将这一政策部署在一个真正的机器人上,而没有任何现实世界的微调,来展示整个管道。 仅利用船上的深度观测,我们的人造物会收集、携带和投放物体,包括盒子、桶、桶和球,跨越新的实例、大小和初始配置。

articles.title: Adversarial Training for Pixel Diffusion
articles.content: Pixel diffusion models generate RGB images directly, avoiding the bottleneck of an autoencoder, yet their outputs still systematically underrepresent fine-scale natural-image statistics. We show that adversarial learning provides an effective post-training correction for this deficiency. Starting from a pretrained model, we retain its original diffusion or flow-matching objective and add an adversarial loss to the predicted output at non-high-noise timesteps, leaving the model architecture and sampling procedure unchanged. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of adversarial post-training for pixel diffusion. Across two pixel backbones, the method jointly improves distribution fidelity, coverage, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality. We further investigate why it works. Frequency-band and power-law analyses show that the original models systematically underproduce natural-image high-frequency content, while adversarial post-training restores this missing spectral power. In contrast, perceptual loss also increases high-frequency content but sacrifices distribution fidelity and prompt alignment. Nearest-neighbor, recall, and matched no-GAN SFT controls further rule out memorization, mode dropping, and additional optimization as simple explanations. Finally, we examine the boundary of this effect. Under the tested latent diffusion configurations, the same procedure does not produce comparable joint gains and adds almost no decoded high-frequency power. These results identify direct output access to the image statistics being corrected as a key factor governing when adversarial post-training succeeds.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 像素扩散的横向培训
articles.content_zh: 像素扩散模型直接生成RGB图像,避免了自动编码器的瓶颈,但其输出仍然系统性地低估了精细尺度的自然图像统计. 我们显示,对抗性学习为这一缺陷提供了有效的培训后矫正。 从预先训练的模型开始,我们保留其原始的扩散或流量匹配目标,并在非高噪音时段的预测输出中增加对抗性损失,使模型结构和取样程序保持不变. 据我们所知,这是对像素传播的对抗性后训练的首次系统研究. 通过两个像素主干线,该方法共同提高了分布忠贞度,覆盖度,即时对齐度和知觉质量. 我们进一步调查它为什么有效。 频率波段和功率法分析显示,原始模型系统化地低产自然成像高频含量,而对抗性训练后恢复了这种缺失的光谱功率. 与此相反,知觉损失也增加了高频含量,但牺牲了分发的忠诚和迅速的配合。 最近的邻居,回忆,和匹配的无GAN SFT控制进一步排除了记忆,模式下降,以及作为简单解释的额外优化. 最后,我们审视这种影响的界限。 在经过测试的潜在扩散配置下,同一程序不会产生可比较的联合增益,并增加几乎没有解码的高频功率. 这些结果表明,直接产出获取正在纠正的图像统计数据是制约对抗性培训成功的关键因素。

articles.title: Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data
articles.content: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation (PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. We validate our architecture with an in-depth ablation study, and analyse the performance of our model against state-of-the-art crop segmentation models on multiple tile-size variants of the popular PASTIS and MTLCC datasets. Our findings show our model to outperform all others in the task of crop class segmentation, verified across multiple important segmentation metrics, with especially strong performance against compared models seen in the often under-reported parcel delineation quality, for which we use the Boundary IoU metric. We also find that flawed class groupings within datasets can have a significant negative impact on model performance, and report that alternate tile-size variants of crop segmentation datasets produce results incomparable to one-another, invalidating fair comparison between model performance when trained on different tile-sizes. Based on these findings, we suggest further work is required to standardise best practices when constructing SITS crop segmentation datasets, and to enable future dynamic-tile-sizing for ideal model performance.

articles.title_zh: Cropland PatteRNS:卫星成像时间系列数据中并行维度关注网络和对作物分化数据集差异的关注
articles.content_zh: 卫星图像时间序列数据集和耕地分割边界划定结构的景观从未如此丰富。 然而,在这场淘金热中,两条战线上都忽略了重要的真理,因为对于最新颖的概念或最大的数据集的驱动力将更细细的细节推向一边. 在本文中,我们介绍了我们的混合变压器-演化模型,即耕地平行注意和细化分解网络(PatteRNS),这是第一个针对哨兵-2多光谱SITS数据的时间、光谱和空间方面分别使用自觉机制的模式。 为了在我们提议的模型中得到充分的注意,我们引入了一个新的平行变压器结构,大大降低了三要素自留的计算复杂性。 我们通过深入研究验证我们的建筑,并对照流行的PASTIS和MTLCC数据集的多个瓦片大小变体的先进作物分化模型分析我们模型的性能。 我们的研究结果表明,我们的模式在作物分类分解任务中表现优于所有其他模式,经过多个重要分解度量度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 我们还发现,数据集内存在缺陷的分类组合可能对模型性能产生重大的负面影响,并报告说,作物分块数据集的交替的瓦片大小变体产生的结果与一个-另一个无法比较,在接受不同瓦片大小的培训时,使模型性能之间的公平比较无效. 根据这些调查结果,我们建议需要开展进一步的工作,以便在建造SITS作物分块数据集时,将最佳做法标准化,并使未来能为理想的模型性能进行动态拓扑。

articles.title: Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling
articles.content: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 反思世界行动模式的代表
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型联合学习机器人政策并预测未来的观测结果,使表现空间成为控制与预测的界面. 我们通过有控制的比较来研究这一空间的设计,发现无论是重建忠贞性还是预先受过训练的感官特征,都不能确保有效的政策学习。 这些调查结果激励了REWAM,这是一种以代表性为中心的世界行动模式,它建立在事先经过培训的DINO特征上。 特征校准和瞬间代表 Bottleneck 将这些特征组织成适合动态建模的紧凑世界国家. 环绕行动代表制将行动损失梯度推向瓶颈,从而使政策形成代表制编码,而世界模式则学习如何演变。 没有基因视频预训,REWAM在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了93.6%的成功. 在RoboDojo上,它使用约600小时的内含的训练前数据,取得了平均12.29分和8.28%的成功率.

articles.title: DMA$^2$: Pixel-space Distribution Matching with Adversarial and Anchor Losses
articles.content: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) provides a general framework for few-step diffusion generation, but its modern text-to-image instantiations have been developed primarily around latent diffusion. It therefore overlooks key properties and design opportunities of native RGB. We revisit two DMD interfaces for pixel-space teachers. On the teacher-matching side, diagnostics show low-noise RGB matching is dominated by a local-texture cue, motivating a fixed high-noise matching band. On the real-data side, native clean-RGB outputs allow guidance from an external visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the heavy fake-score critic. DINO-Adv removes this critic from the adversarial gradient path and supplies local parametric patch guidance. For distribution-level guidance, we introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It operates on detached rolling real and generated supports in the shared DINOv2 space while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision. AF-Loss adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. Together these designs form DMA$^2$. Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, the four-step DMA$^2$ student performs better than the 25-step teacher and evaluated few-step distillers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DMA$^2$: 像素- 空间分布匹配逆差和锁定损失
articles.content_zh: 分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)为几步扩散生成提供了总体框架,但其现代文本到图像的即兴开发主要围绕潜在扩散. 因此,它忽略了当地RGB的关键属性和设计机会. 我们重温两个像素空间教师的DMD接口. 在教师配对方面,诊断显示低噪声RGB配对以本地文字提示为主,激发固定的高噪声配对带. 在真实数据方面,原生的清洁-RGB输出允许从外部的视觉表现进行引导,而不会翻转解码器或分享沉重的假分评人. DINO-Adv将这个批评者从对抗梯度路径中移除,并提供本地参数补丁指导. 对于分布级指导,我们引入了AF-Loss,一个无参数的辅助语义分布-场目标,为文本对映DMD设计. 它在共享的DINOv2空间中运行于可脱落的滚动真实和生成的支撑,同时保持了即时的教师监督. AF-Loss 没有添加可学习参数或推论时间计算. 这些设计合在一起构成DMA$^2美元. 跨DPG-Bench、GenEval、VQAScore和COCO30K,四步DMA$^2美元的学生表现优于25步教师,评价了几步蒸馏器。

articles.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
articles.content: Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days. Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events. Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the "biography" of the particular entity a question concerns. To address this, we introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that groups visually grounded observations of the same physical instance across clips into retrievable biographies while preserving the context of each moment. During question answering, the biography is retrieved alongside episodic evidence, allowing the model to follow an entity through events using identity links established during memory construction. Evaluations across four benchmarks, including day-long and week-long recordings, demonstrate improvements over prior memory frameworks in both multiple-choice and open-ended question answering. On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0% accuracy, 4.4 percentage points above the best published result. Ablations show that grounded identity association and biography reading both contribute to the gains, which additional descriptions alone do not fully recover.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越时间线:用地基实体生物图增强长视频记忆
articles.content_zh: 回答关于长视频的问题,往往需要将涉及相同物体的事件连接起来,跨越数小时或数天。 编年史描述和文本衍生的实体可以留下实体身份未解决的问题:不同的对象可能共享一个描述,而同一对象的观测仍然在事件间断开. 因此,检索相关事件不一定能恢复特定实体所关注的"传记". 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了地基实体生物图,这是一个长视频的记忆框架,将同一物理实例的视基观测在片段之间组合成可检索的生物图,同时保留每个时刻的背景。 在回答问题时,该传记与零星证据一起检索,使模型能够利用在内存构建过程中建立的身份链接通过事件跟随一个实体. 包括全天和全周录音在内的四项基准的评价表明,在多选择和开放式问题回答方面,比以前的记忆框架有所改善。 在EgoLifeQA上,GEB的精度达到72.0%,比最佳公布结果高出4.4个百分点. 叙述表明,基于身份的关联和传记都有助于取得这些成果,而仅靠补充说明并不能完全恢复。

articles.title: LongLive-Plug: Once-for-All Distillation for Video Generation
articles.content: Video diffusion models are increasingly developed into specialized models for diverse downstream tasks, and this development often includes a distillation stage, for example to accelerate sampling or to improve long-video generation. This stage is typically repeated for every specialized model. We introduce LongLive-Plug, a once-for-all distillation framework that learns reusable capabilities as LoRAs on a base model for training-free, plug-and-play deployment to compatible downstream models. These capabilities include single-pass classifier-free guidance, few-step sampling, and long-context error correction for autoregressive generation. The adapters remain reusable even when downstream models add conditioning branches, expand output channels. Despite training at a fixed guidance scale, our dedicated CFG LoRA provides text guidance control through its inference weight. Combining it with a few-step LoRA simultaneously preserves few-step generation and CFG controllability on downstream tasks. We verify training-free deployment on 54 downstream models across three backbone families and eight task categories, including world modeling, robotics, editing, and multimodal generation. The approach may support additional compatible models. Each capability can thus be distilled once per backbone family and reused without per-target retraining.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LongLive-Plug:一劳永逸用于视频生成
articles.content_zh: 视频传播模式日益发展成为不同下游任务的专用模式,这种发展往往包括一个蒸馏阶段,例如加速取样或改进长视频生成. 通常每个专业型号都会重复这一阶段. 我们引入了LongLive-Plug,一个一劳永逸的蒸馏框架,在无训练,插座和游戏部署兼容的下游模型的基模型上学习作为LORA的可重复使用的能力. 这些能力包括单通道无分类器制导,少步采样,以及用于自动递归生成的长文本错误校正. 适配器即使下游型号添加了调节分支,扩展了输出通道,仍然可以再使用. 尽管在固定的指导尺度上进行了培训,但我们专用的CFG LoRA通过其推论权重提供文本指导控制. 将它与几步LORA结合,同时保留了几步生成和下游任务的CFG可控性. 我们核实对54个下游模式的免费部署,涉及三个骨干家庭和八个任务类别,包括世界建模、机器人、编辑和多式联运。 这种办法可以支持其他兼容模式。 因此,每种能力都可以在不进行每个目标再培训的情况下,在每个骨干家族中蒸馏一次并重新使用。

articles.title: PowerSim: Differentiable Physics Simulation and Rendering with Power Diagrams
articles.content: We introduce PowerSim, a method to bring physically grounded, differentiable dynamics to PowerFoam's power diagram based 3D representation. PowerSim directly couples a pre-trained PowerFoam scene to the Material Point Method (MPM) by exploiting a natural alignment between the two: the geometric and appearance properties of each primitive correspond closely to the quantities MPM already tracks as an object deforms. Consequently, simulated motion can drive the scene's geometry and appearance directly, without an auxiliary representation in between. Built on this framework, we enable a range of applications on real and synthetic scenes: (1) simulating a static scene under user interaction, (2) recovering spatially varying material fields, (3) compositing primitives from independently captured scenes into a single simulation-ready scene and (4) ray-tracing reflections that update consistently as the object deforms. Our results suggest that PowerSim excels over previous frameworks for physically grounded dynamics, while unlocking unique advantages-such as secondary ray lighting effects on dynamic scenes. Results are best viewed on our project website: https://power-sim.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PowerSim:可区分物理模拟和用Power图渲染
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了PowerSim,一种将物理的,不同的动态带给PowerFoam基于3D的动力图代表的方法. PowerSim通过利用两者间的自然对齐,直接将一个经过预先训练的PowerFoam场景与材料点法(MPM)对齐:每个原始物的几何和外观属性与MPM作为物体变形已经跟踪的数量紧密对应. 因此,模拟运动可以直接驱动场景的几何和外观,在两者之间没有辅助表现. 以这个框架为基础,我们在真实和合成场景上实现了一系列的应用:(1)在用户互动下模拟一个静态场景,(2)恢复空间差异的材料场,(3)从独立捕获的场景中将原始物堆积成一个单一的模拟准备场景,(4)射线跟踪反射持续更新作为物体变形. 我们的结果表明,PowerSim优于以往的物理动态框架,同时在动态场景中释放出独特的优势,如二次射线照明效应。 我们的项目网站:https://power-sim.github.io/查阅结果最好。

articles.title: FracGen: Learning How Objects Stretch and Tear with Physics-Informed Video Generation
articles.content: We introduce FracGen, a fracture-aware video generation model that produces plausible, controllable fracture dynamics from a single image of an intact object, conditioned on physics signals. To train FracGen, we build FracSim, a fracture-aware simulation framework that augments material point method (MPM) simulation with a continuum damage model, producing paired fracture videos and dense, pixel-aligned physical fields at no additional cost beyond standard rendering. FracGen leverages these maps in two ways: it is trained to jointly predict them alongside RGB video, encouraging the model to capture physical state rather than surface appearance; and it is supervised with physics-informed losses that encourage consistency among the predicted maps. As a result, FracGen captures distinct material-specific fracture behavior without expensive test-time simulation or per-scene tuning, while offering fine-grained control over where an object tears, how fast the crack propagates, and how much deformation precedes failure. We further introduce a benchmark for evaluating the physical plausibility of generated fracture video, and show through extensive experiments that FracGen outperforms existing video generation baselines in both physical and visual fidelity. Results are best viewed in our project website: https://fracgen.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FracGen:学习物体与物理的伸展和泪水-成形视频生成
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了FracGen,一种具有断裂意识的视频生成模型,它从一个完整物体的单一图像中产生出可信,可控的断裂动态,以物理信号为条件. 为了训练FracGen,我们建造了FracSim,一个断裂感模拟框架,这个框架用连续损伤模型来增强物质点方法(MPM)的模拟,产生成对断裂视频和密集,像素相通的物理场,除了标准渲染外,没有额外的成本. FracGen对这些地图的杠杆作用有两种方式:它经过培训,可以与RGB视频一起共同预测它们,鼓励模型捕捉物理状态而不是表面外观;它受到物理知情损失的监督,鼓励预测地图的一致性. 因此,FracGen在没有昂贵的测试时间模拟或人均场面调理的情况下,捕捉出独特的物质特异性的断裂行为,同时对物体的眼泪位置,裂缝传播的速度,以及故障前的变形程度提供精细的控制. 我们进一步采用了一个基准,用于评估生成的断裂视频的物理可信度,并通过广泛的实验显示FracGen在物理和视觉忠心方面都超过了现有的视频生成基线. 项目网站:https://fracgen.github.io/查阅结果最好。

articles.title: LIFT: Layout-In-Future Video Generation under Large Viewpoint Change via On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.content: We introduce LIFT, a unified image-to-video generation framework that complements camera control with Layout-In-FuTure control, enabling users to specify what should appear in a future view and where it should appear. This addresses a practical need in controllable video generation: given an initial image, users often care not only about how the camera moves, but also about what the scene should look like at key future moments, especially the final frame. Existing camera controls specify viewpoint trajectories, while text prompts provide only coarse semantic guidance; neither precisely determines the content and spatial layout of future views. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced under large viewpoint changes, where the camera reveals regions that are not visible in the first frame. LIFT therefore uses the last-frame layout as an explicit control signal for the desired future scene. Since learning from such sparse layout guidance is substantially more challenging than conditioning on dense per-frame layouts, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) to transfer the control capability of a dense-layout teacher to a last-frame-layout student. We further curate LIFT-Vista, a dataset featuring large viewpoint changes with camera and temporally consistent layout annotations. Experiments show that LIFT improves video quality, future-layout controllability, and camera controllability over other methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LIFT: 在大视图点变化下通过On-Political Self-Distillation制作未来视频
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了LIFT,这是一个统一的图像到视频生成框架,它用布局-In-FuTure控制来补充相机控制,使用户能够指定未来视图中应该出现什么以及它应该出现在哪里. 这解决了可控视频生成中的实际需要:由于有了初始图像,用户往往不仅关心镜头如何移动,而且关心镜头在未来的关键时刻,特别是最终帧应该是什么样子. 现有的相机控制指定了视线轨迹,而文本提示则只提供粗糙的语义指导;两者都不确切确定未来视图的内容和空间布局. 在大角度的变化下,这种限制变得特别明显,照相机揭示了第一帧看不到的区域。 因此,LIFT将最后一帧布局作为期望未来场景的明确控制信号. 由于从这种简陋的布局指导中学习比对密密的每帧布局的调节要具有更大的挑战性,我们引入了政策上的自我消化(OPSD),将密密的教师的控制能力转移给最后一个密密的学生. 我们进一步管理LIFT-Vista,这是一个数据集,以大视野变化为特征,并附有相机和时间一致的布局说明。 实验显示,LIFT可以提高视频质量,提高未来放电的可控性,以及相机对其他方法的可控性.

articles.title: Breaking the Uniformity Trap: Scaling Video Diffusion Model via SplitMoE
articles.content: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), popularized by large language models, is a promising paradigm for scaling visual generative models. However, conventional token-wise MoE routes tokens independently within a homogeneous expert pool and regularizes expert usage toward uniformity, making it poorly matched to video data that is spatiotemporally redundant and semantically long-tailed. We show that existing visual MoEs fall into a uniformity trap: semantically under-organized routing, compounded by uniform expert-usage regularization, scatters coherent patches across disparate experts, causing routing fragmentation and structural distortion. To address this, we propose SplitMoE, a split-role sparse architecture that breaks the shackles of uniformity. To accommodate the inherent semantic imbalance, we explicitly bifurcate the expert pool into semantic experts and generic experts, with semantic experts capturing high-level semantic abstraction and generic experts preserving residual visual information and flexible generative capacity. Leveraging prototype-guided routing and pull-push regularization, SplitMoE enables tokens to cluster naturally by semantic attributes rather than arbitrary balancing constraints. Extensive results show that under an equivalent activated-parameter budget, SplitMoE outperforms traditional load-balanced MoEs in convergence speed, routing coherence, and video generation quality across standard benchmarks. By revealing an emergent coarse-to-fine denoising logic, SplitMoE provides the community with a modality-aware scaling path, serving as a critical reference for building large-scale video world models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 突破统一陷阱:通过SplitMoE放大视频传播模式
articles.content_zh: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE),被大型语言模型所普及,是放大视觉基因模型的有希望的范式. 然而,传统象征性的教育部路线在单一的专家库中独立显示,并使专家的用法规范化,使之与瞬息万变的冗余和长尾的视频数据不相称。 我们显示,现有的视觉教育部陷入一个统一的陷阱:由于组织不足,加上统一的专家使用规范化,分散了各行各业的专家的一致补丁,造成路线支离破碎和结构扭曲。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议SplitMoE,一种分裂作用的零散建筑,打破统一性的枷锁. 为了适应固有的语义不平衡,我们明确将专家库分为语义专家和通用专家,由语义专家捕捉高级语义抽象和通用专家保存剩余视觉信息和灵活的基因能力. 利用原型制导的路由和牵引-推式规范化,SplitMoE使令牌能够自然地通过语义属性而不是任意的平衡约束来集群. 广泛结果表明,在相当的激活参数预算中,SplitMoE在趋同速度、路由一致性和视频生成质量方面超越了传统的负载平衡的MOE。 SplitMoE通过揭示一种新兴的粗糙至精细的解析逻辑,为社区提供了一种模式感知的缩放路径,作为构建大规模视频世界模型的关键参考.

articles.title: CLeaR: A Unified Framework for Resolving the Leakage-Degradation Dilemma in Style Transfer
articles.content: Style transfer aims to render target content in the style of a reference image, but existing methods often suffer from content leakage, where objects, layouts, or semantics from the style reference appear in the generated output. Although prior data-driven and training-free methods can reduce leakage, they often face a leakage-degradation dilemma: stronger content suppression may weaken style fidelity, while richer style preservation may reintroduce unwanted reference content. We identify this dilemma across the full style-transfer pipeline, including feature separation, feature-space grounding, and diffusion generation. To address these issues, we propose CLeaR, a training-free framework for content-leakage-resistant style transfer. CLeaR first uses Orthogonal Subspace Projection to define content-reduced style targets in each vision foundation model (VFM) feature space. It then performs Ensemble Inversion, which optimizes a shared pixel-space style anchor satisfying style constraints across multiple VFMs. Finally, Energy-Guided Calibration maintains style alignment during diffusion sampling by steering the denoising trajectory toward the ensemble-defined style manifold. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the style-anchor estimation error decreases with the number of VFMs. Experiments on StyleBench demonstrate that CLeaR improves style alignment, reduces content leakage, and achieves better LLM-as-Judge evaluation compared with existing methods. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CLeaR: 解决样式转移中的泄漏-退化困境的统一框架
articles.content_zh: 样式传输旨在使目标内容具有参考图像的样式,但现有方法往往受到内容渗漏的影响,在生成的输出中会出现样式引用的对象,布局,或语义. 虽然以往的数据驱动和无培训方法可以减少渗漏,但它们往往面临渗漏-降解的两难境地:强化内容抑制可能会削弱风格忠贞性,而更丰富的风格保存可能会重新引入不想要的参考内容. 我们查明了整个风格转让管道的这种两难境地,包括特征分离、特征空间地面定位和传播生成。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出CLeaR,一个无培训的框架,用于进行耐漏内容的样式转让. CLeaR首先使用Orthogonal Subspace Projection来定义每个视觉基础模型(VFM)中的内容减少样式目标特征空间. 然后它进行Ensemble Inversion,它优化了共享像素-空间风格主锚,满足多个VFM的风格限制. 最后,能源导向校准在扩散取样期间通过引导调试轨迹向综艺界定的样式多面进行样式调整。 我们进一步提供了理论分析,显示样式-定点估计误差随着VFM数量减少. 关于Style Bench的实验表明,CLeaR改进了样式对齐,减少了内容泄漏,比起现有方法,实现了更好的LLM-as-Judge评价. 该代码可在\href{https://github.com/0606zt/CleaR}{https://github.com/0606zt/CleaR}获得.

articles.title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model
articles.content: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 海利克斯世界:实时互动视听世界模式.
articles.content_zh: 世界模拟本质上是多感性的,要求实时同步的视觉和声学动态. 然而,目前流行的交互式世界模式仍然严格保持沉默,只注重视觉渲染和控制,而忽略声学层面。 我们介绍HelixWorld,一种实时交互式视听世界模型,视觉场景和照相机定位空间立体声在用户互动下在本土共同演化. 我们用真实的立体声学和公制相机来管理一个高真实度的空间视听数据集,我们以此为条件预先训练一个以6-DoF相机轨迹和用户动作为条件的双向教师。 为了实现低纬度因果互动,我们通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将老师分解成几步流体的学生,在单一的GPU上维持24个FPS的无漂流联合视听推出. 此外,我们正式确定空间-声学一致性,并引入Helix Bench来评价综合音域是否忠实地跟踪动态视角运动。 广泛的实验表明,HelixWorld在视觉忠心度和应答度方面与最先进的无声世界模型相匹配,同时在相机对齐的空间声波浸润度方面大大超过了现有的基线.

articles.title: VideoLoop: Looped Working Memory Against Semantic Thrashing in Long-Form Video Agents
articles.content: Long-form video understanding requires multimodal agents to iteratively gather evidence over many reasoning steps. However, most existing agentic methods suffer from semantic thrashing: as append-only working memory grows, attention to key evidence collapses, and the agent loses access to what it has already found. First, we provide a structural argument showing that append-only memory can incorporate newly observed target evidence, but cannot remove accumulated noise or prevent ordered context growth without a rewrite operator. Second, motivated by this analysis, we propose VideoLoop, a multimodal agent with two coupled loops. The outer loop reasons over the video and the inner loop, after each step, retrieves artifacts from an unbounded filesystem of past observations and intermediate analysis, and rewrites a bounded working memory. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoLoop, which improves four popular LVLM backbones in a plug-and-play manner, with an average gain of 4.2% points over baseline on VideoMME (long). Further analysis of working memory suggests that VideoLoop mitigates semantic thrashing: on the hardest quarter of VideoMME (long) questions, a blind judge that reads only the agent's context answers 81.1% correctly, versus 60.9% for the append-only agent. With Gemini 3.1 Pro, VideoLoop reaches 88.3% on VideoMME (long), 88.8% on VideoMMMU, and 80.9% on LongVideoBench (long).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VideoLoop: 循环工作记忆, 对抗长格式视频代理中的语义化重击
articles.content_zh: 长式视频理解要求多式联运代理商在许多推理步骤上迭代收集证据. 然而,大多数现有的代理方法都受到语义抽打的困扰:随着只有附件的工作记忆不断增长,对关键证据的注意力崩溃,代理失去了已经发现的东西的获取. 首先,我们提供了一个结构论证,表明仅附件内存可以包含新观察到的目标证据,但不能去除累积的噪音或防止没有重写操作员的有序上下文生长. 第二,在这项分析的推动下,我们提议采用VideoLoop,一种具有两个连线的多式联运代理。 视频上的外环原因和内环,在每一步之后,从过去观察和中间分析的无约束文件系统中检索文物,并重写有约束的工作内存. 广泛的实验证明了VideoLoop的有效性,它以插座和播放方式改进了四个流行的LVLM主干线,平均比VideoMME(长)的基线提高4.2%. 对工作记忆的进一步分析表明,VideoLoop缓解了语义上的抽打:在VideoMME(长)问题最困难的四分之一,只读到代理上下文的盲目判断者正确回答81.1%,而只有副代理的回答率为60.9%。 随着双子座3.1 Pro,VideoLoop在VideoMME(长)上达到88.3%,在VideoMMU上达到88.8%,在LongVideo Bench上达到80.9%.

articles.title: GA-EIRFS: A Geometry-Augmented Repeat-Factor Sampling Method for Long-Tailed LiDAR 3D Object Detection
articles.content: Long-tailed 3D object detection is treated as a class-frequency problem, but LiDAR supervision quality depends on object observability: similar frequencies can hide different geometric evidence. We introduce Geometry-Augmented Exponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling (GA-EIRFS), a detector-agnostic method that modulates a frequency-based repeat factor with a fixed geometry score combining point count, surface-normal entropy, and surface coverage. GA-EIRFS changes only frame-sampling probabilities, leaving the detector and inference unchanged. On nuScenes it improves mean average precision (mAP) and the nuScenes detection score (NDS) in four converged experiments with CenterPoint and PointPillars over two seeds; for CenterPoint at seed 666, mAP rises from 0.552 to 0.563 and bicycle AP from 0.306 to 0.359. Per-class gains correlate with the class sampling-weight increase (Spearman rho=0.70, p=0.025) but not with geometry score alone (rho=0.32, p=0.37), so geometry amplifies frequency-driven need. KITTI results vary across seeds, most for the rarest class. Code: https://github.com/Multimodal-Sensing-Lab/GA-EIRFS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GA-EIRFS:长途LiDAR 3D物体探测的几何增强式重复法
articles.content_zh: 长尾的3D物体探测被作为类频问题处理,但LiDAR监督质量取决于物体可观察性:类似的频率可以隐藏不同的几何证据. 我们引入了几何-增量指数-智能重复因子取样法(GA-EIRFS),这是一种探测器-不可知论方法,它用固定的几何分数来调制频率重复因子,结合点数,表面正常的演算,表面覆盖. GA-EIRFS只改变帧抽样概率,使探测器和推论保持不变. 在NuScenes上,在与CenterPoint和PointPillars在两个种子上进行的四个集中实验中,它提高了平均精度(mAP)和nuScenes检测分数(NDS);对于CenterPoint在666种子上,mAP从0.552上升到0.563,自行车AP从0.306上升到0.359。 每类增益与类采样-重量增益(Spearman rho=0.70,p=0.025)相关,但不单与几何分数(rho=0.32,p=0.37)相关,因此几何可以放大频率驱动的需要. KITTI的结果因种子而异,大多数是属于最稀有的种类. 代码:https://github.com/多式联运-传感器-Lab/GA-EIRFS。

articles.title: Self-Aligned Forcing: Streaming Video Diffusion with Differentiable Noisy History
articles.content: Autoregressive video diffusion enables interactive streaming generation, but suffers from error accumulation over long rollouts. Self-rollout training reduces exposure bias, yet finite rollouts leave long-range drift unresolved. We observe that the noise level of the history key-value (K/V) representations trades visual quality against motion, and that restoring gradients through the history aligns causal training far more closely with bidirectional training. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF), a training scheme that aligns the history of each block with the noise level of the block being denoised. Specifically, the history is the K/V produced by preceding blocks at the same denoising stage, so all blocks at a stage can be denoised in a single forward pass under a causal mask. This keeps the noisy history differentiable, allowing future losses to optimize how it is encoded. SAF therefore avoids a separate no-gradient rollout and per-block timestep-zero recaching, training up to 1.8x faster than prior methods with lower memory. At inference, SAF achieves the highest single-GPU throughput among existing methods and keeps one history bank per stage for a multi-GPU pipeline, reaching 49.1 FPS on 4 GPUs. Experiments show superior long-horizon generation with a better balance between visual quality and motion. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/self-aligned-forcing/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自成一体的强迫:用不同噪音的历史流传视频
articles.content_zh: 自动后退的视频传播使得互动流流生成成为可能,但因长时间推出而出现错误积累。 自我推出培训减少了暴露偏差,但有限推出则留下远程漂移未解决的问题。 我们注意到,历史键值(K/V)的噪声水平代表了视觉质量与运动的对比,通过历史恢复梯度使因果训练与双向训练更紧密地一致。 基于这些观察,我们引入了“自成一体的堡垒”(SAF)这一培训计划,它将每个街区的历史与该街区的噪音水平与被取消的街区的噪音水平联系起来。 具体地说,历史是由前方块在同一去诺化阶段产生的K/V,所以一个阶段的所有块都可以在一个因果面具下的单个前方通道中去诺化. 这使得吵闹的历史可以有所区别,使得未来损失能够优化其编码方式. 因此,苏丹武装部队避免单独推出不升级模式,避免每块时间步-0重新检查,培训速度可达1.8x,比以往内存较低的方法快。 推论,苏丹武装部队在现行方法中实现了最高的单GPU吞吐量,并且为多GPU管道每级保留一个历史库,在4个GPU上达到49.1 FPS. 实验显示优异的长视距生成,在视觉质量和运动之间有更好的平衡. 项目网页:https://anonymous.4open.science/w/self-aconition-forcing/.

articles.title: From Routing Signals to Selective Review: Visual regrounding in MoE VLMs
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) may accept false visual premises, answering questions about a target object's color, count, location, or state even when it is absent. We call this reliability-critical behavior a target-absence grounding failure. Existing visual-grounding detectors primarily rely on generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures. We present the first framework to leverage internal routing decisions in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs to detect target absence before generation and guide selective correction. We extract target-token routing probabilities from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, train a separate L2-regularized linear detector for each model, and use its predictions to selectively invoke a target-aware review prompt. Using routing alone, the Qwen and Gemma detectors achieve ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956 on GQA-Inpaint and retain 0.8095 and 0.7781 on the external OBER dataset, respectively. The resulting routing-gated policy improves end-to-end accuracy on GQA-Inpaint and OBER by +22.25% and +12.17% for Qwen, and by +13.42% and +1.39% for Gemma, without modifying model weights. Further analysis shows that the signal is localized to the target-object token, emerges in early MoE layers, and is distributed across partially substitutable experts. Although cross-dataset threshold shifts require recalibration, false-positive review causes limited harm overall, suggesting that intervention risk can be controlled through joint selection of the detector threshold and review prompt. Overall, we show that routing probabilities alone preserve actionable information about visual perception, allowing computation already produced by an MoE VLM to support low-cost detection and selective visual regrounding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从Routing Signals到选择式审查:在MOE VLMs中视觉重定位
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可能接受虚假的视觉前提,回答有关一个目标对象的颜色,计数,位置,或状态,即使它缺席. 我们把这个可靠性的关键行为 称为目标缺失 地面故障。 现有的目视定位探测器主要依靠生成的响应,隐藏状态,或不确定性措施. 我们提出第一个框架,以利用专家组合中的内部路径决定,在生成前发现目标缺失,并指导选择性修正。 我们从Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it中提取目标-token的路由概率,为每个模型单独训练一个L2-正规线性探测器,并利用其预测有选择地引用目标-意识审查的提示. Quen和Gemma探测器仅使用线路,在GQA-Inpaint上分别实现0.998和0.9956的ROC-AUC,并在外部OBER数据集上保留0.8095和0.7781. 由此产生的路由定型政策提高了GQA-Inpaint和OBER的端对端的精度,Quen的精度为+22.25%和+12.17%,Gemma的精度为+13.42%和+1.39%,没有修改模型重量. 进一步的分析显示,信号是局部到目标对象符号,出现于早期的MOE层,并分布于部分可替代的专家中. 虽然跨数据集阈值变化需要重新校正,但假阳性审查总体上造成的危害有限,这表明干预风险可以通过联合选择探测器阈值和快速审查来控制. 总体而言,我们显示,仅路由概率就保存了可操作的视觉感知信息,使得一个MOE VLM已经产生的计算能够支持低成本的检测和选择性的视觉再定位.

articles.title: VISTA: Internalizing Collective Visual Experience via On-Policy Distillation for Active Multimodal Agents
articles.content: Active multimodal agents use visual tools to acquire task-relevant evidence while reasoning. Although reinforcement learning samples multiple interaction trajectories per input, outcome-based objectives primarily use the group to estimate scalar advantages, leaving complementary visual discoveries underused. We introduce VISTA, which internalizes collective visual experience through on-policy distillation by turning observations from same-input rollouts into shared supervision. Collective visual experience distillation (CVED) organizes these observations with their interaction context and aligns them with individual decisions, while heterogeneity-aware policy improvement (HAPI) reinforces successful trajectories and provides experience-guided distillation for unsuccessful attempts. An experience-conditioned teacher evaluates the student's sampled response prefixes, allowing discoveries from one trajectory to guide learning in another without replacing the student's original history or generating new target trajectories. The trained agent retains its visual tools and acts using its own interaction history. VISTA achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated active multimodal agents of comparable size and consistently outperforms same-backbone training baselines across fine-grained perception and general reasoning tasks, demonstrating the value of collective experience for active multimodal learning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VISTA:通过积极多式联运代理商的政策消化将集体视觉经验内部化
articles.content_zh: 积极的多式联运代理人在推理时使用视觉工具获取与任务相关的证据. 虽然强化学习对每次输入的多个相互作用轨迹进行了样本,但基于结果的目标主要利用该组来估计斯卡尔的优势,使得互补的视觉发现被利用不足. 我们引入了VISTA,它通过政策上的提炼将集体视觉经验内部化,把同投入推出的观察转化为共同监督。 集体视觉经验衍射(CVED)用其相互作用的背景来组织这些观测,并使之与个别决定保持一致,而异质感-意识政策改进(HAPI)则加强成功的轨迹,并为失败的尝试提供经验指导衍射. 一个经验条件好的老师评价学生的抽样反应前缀,允许从一个轨迹中发现来指导另一个轨迹中的学习,而不取代学生的原始历史或产生新的目标轨迹. 训练有素的特工保留自己的视觉工具和行为,使用自己的互动历史. VISTA在规模相当的经评价的活跃多式联运代理商中取得了最强的平均业绩,在精细的认知和一般推理任务中,其业绩始终高于同一背骨培训基线,表明集体经验对活跃的多式联运学习的价值。

articles.title: OmniTaskonomy: When Does Visual Generation Improve Visual Understanding?
articles.content: Training a model to generate visual content can encourage it to learn rich perceptual capabilities related to geometry, spatial relationships, and objectness; yet, its benefits for visual understanding remain unclear. We ask: when and how does visual generation supervision improve visual understanding? We study controlled pairs of image-to-image (I2I) generation and image-to-text (I2T) understanding tasks that express the same underlying problem in different output modalities. We find that under the correct recipe, I2I training improves downstream I2T performance, with larger gains as the amount of I2I training data increases. We next ask which generation tasks benefit which understanding capabilities. To study transfer beyond paired tasks, we introduce OmniTaskonomy, a unified taxonomy spanning 19 I2I generation tasks and 25 I2T understanding capabilities. The resulting transfer map reveals selective, task-dependent benefits. Some follow intuitive correspondences, e.g., depth prediction improving metric 3D reasoning, object pointing improving counting, and jigsaw reconstruction improving 2D ordering. Interestingly, we also uncover surprising connections: 2.5D segmentation improving category recognition and Z-depth prediction improving localization. To probe these patterns, we analyze gradient alignment between generation and understanding tasks and find that stronger alignment is associated with larger downstream transfer gains. Together, our results highlight visual generation as a rich source of supervision for visual understanding and provide a roadmap for unlocking its benefits through the right training curriculum and task selection. Project page: https://omni-taskonomy.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OmniTaskonmy:视觉一代何时改善视觉理解?
articles.content_zh: 培训一种生成视觉内容的模型可以鼓励它学习与几何、空间关系和物体有关的丰富的感知能力;然而,它对视觉理解的益处仍然不明确。 我们问:视觉生成监督何时以及如何提高视觉理解? 我们研究可控对映成像(I2I)生成和图像对文本(I2T)理解任务,这些任务在不同输出模式中表达相同的根本问题. 我们发现,在正确的配方下,I2I培训改善了I2T下游的性能,随着I2I培训数据数量的增加,收益更大. 我们接下来要问的是,哪一代人的任务对理解能力有好处。 为了研究超越配对任务的转移,我们引入了OmniTaskonomy,一种跨越19个I2I生成任务和25个I2T理解能力的统一分类学. 由此产生的转移图显示有选择、取决于任务的利益。 有些遵循直观的函式,如深度预测改进了度量3D推理,对象指点改进了计数,拼图重建改进了2D定购. 有趣的是,我们也发现了令人惊讶的关联:2.5D分解改善了类别识别,Z深度预测改善了本地化. 为了探索这些模式,我们分析生成和理解任务之间的梯度调整,发现更强的调整与更大的下游转移收益有关. 我们的成果共同突出了视觉生成是视觉理解的丰富监督来源,并提供了一个路线图,通过正确的培训课程和任务选择来释放其惠益。 项目网页:https://omni-taskonomy.github.io/。

articles.title: MUGEN: Interactive Panoramic World Exploration via Camera Control
articles.content: Interactive panoramic video generation aims to synthesize immersive 360\textdegree{} videos that remain visually coherent while following user-specified camera trajectories during exploration. However, progress is limited by a coupled data-and-model gap: existing panoramic video datasets are often short, weakly annotated, or lack camera trajectories, while existing camera-controlled video generation models are designed for perspective videos and do not directly support panoramic geometry. In this paper, we introduce MUGEN and Wan360 to address these limitations. MUGEN is a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset tailored to interactive 360-degree world exploration, comprising over 1,300 hours of at least 4K panoramic videos with rich semantic and geometric annotations. Built on MUGEN, we further present Wan360, a camera-controllable interactive panoramic video generation model. Panoramic videos are commonly represented by EquiRectangular Projection (ERP), which unfolds a spherical 360-degree view into a rectangular frame with cyclic longitude seams and pole distortions. To this end, Wan360 introduces three parameter-free ERP-aware components: periodic longitude RoPE for seam-consistent positional encoding, ERP-aware padding for reducing boundary artifacts, and random roll yaw for consistent learning. For camera control, Wan360 uses a panoramic Plücker embedding that represents camera motion with ERP rays rather than perspective pinhole rays. Experiments show that MUGEN serves as a data foundation for panoramic world exploration, and that Wan360 enables high-quality, temporally coherent, camera-controllable 360-degree video generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MUGEN:通过相机控制进行交互式全景世界探索
articles.content_zh: 互动全景视频生成旨在合成浸润360\文本度的视频,这些视频在探索过程中遵循用户指定的相机轨迹,同时保持视觉一致性. 然而,进展受到数据与模型的结合差距的限制:现有的全景视频数据集往往很短,注释薄弱,或者缺乏相机轨迹,而现有的相机控制的视频生成模型是为视角视频设计的,并不直接支持全景几何. 在本文中,我们介绍了MUGEN和Wan360,以解决这些局限性。 MUGEN是一个针对交互式360度世界探索量身定制的大型现实世界全景视频数据集,包含超过1300小时的至少4K全景视频,内容丰富的语义和几何说明. 在MUGEN上,我们进一步展示了Wan360,一种相机可控交互式全景视频生成模型. 全景视频通常以Equi矩形投影(ERP)为代表,将球形360度的视线展开成长方形框架,具有循环经度的缝隙和杆状扭曲. 为此,Wan360引入了三个无参数的ERP-意识组件:定期经纬度ROPE用于切换一致的位置编码,ERP-意识粘贴以减少边界文物,随机滚动yaw用于一致学习。 对于相机控制,Wan360采用全景Plücker嵌入法,它代表了与ERP射线的相机运动,而不是视角针孔射线. 实验显示,MUGEN是全景世界探索的数据基础,而Wan360则能够实现高质量,时间性一致,相机可控360度的视频生成.

articles.title: RS-OPSD: Reliable Privileged On-Policy-Self-Distillation for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing VQA
articles.content: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires models to resolve small visual evidence within extremely large images. Existing approaches typically rely on token pruning, visual search, or tool-augmented reasoning at inference time. We instead investigate whether the benefit of zoom-in visual privilege can be internalized into the model. We introduce RS-OPSD, a reliable privileged on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) framework for UHR remote sensing VQA. To provide high-quality privileged information with explicit question-relevant evidence, we construct GeoEvidence-6K, containing 6,750 VQA samples across seven task categories with evidence-region annotations, and develop Human Feedback-Guided Skill Refinement (HF-SR) for scalable annotation. To address context loss from tight crops and conflicting signals from imperfect teachers, RS-OPSD introduces Context-Preserving Visual Privilege (CPVP) and Correctness-Aligned Distillation (CAD). Without any additional visual search or tool calls at inference time, RS-OPSD achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on XLRS-Bench, MME-RealWorld-RS, and LRS-VQA, outperforming pervious SOTA models of comparable scale by an average of 4.0 percentage points. Moreover, our 2B variant, RS-OPD-Lite, surpasses most 8B-scale models while achieving the fastest measured inference speed. Our Code, GeoEvidence-6K, and the model weights for RS-OPSD and RS-OPD-Lite are publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RS-OPSD:对超高分辨率遥感的可靠政策自控
articles.content_zh: 超高分辨率(UHR)遥感视觉问题回答(VQA)需要模型在极大图像中解决小视觉证据. 现有方法通常依赖于象征性的搜索、视觉搜索或推论时间的工具强化推理。 相反,我们调查是否可将放大视觉特权的好处内化为模型。 我们提出RS-OPSD,这是UHR遥感VQA的可靠的特权政策自我消化框架。 为了提供高质量的特权信息,提供与问题有关的明确证据,我们构建了GeoEvience-6K,包含6,750个VQA样本,涉及7个任务类别,并附有证据区域说明,并开发了人类反馈指导技能精度(HF-SR),用于可伸缩注释。 为了解决收紧作物造成的上下文损失和来自不完善教师的相互矛盾的信号,RS-OPSD引入了上下文保存视觉隐私(CPVP)和正则协调抖动(CAD). 在没有任何额外的视觉搜索或工具在推断时间调用的情况下,RS-OPSD在XLRS-Bench,MME-Real World-RS,以及LRS-VQA上实现最先进的性能(SOTA),平均比可比尺度的SOTA模型表现优于4.0个百分点. 此外,我们的2B变体RS-OPD-Lite超过了大多数8B级模型,同时实现了测得最快的推论速度. 我们的代码,GeoEvidence-6K,以及RS-OPSD和RS-OPD-Lite的模型权重已经公开.

articles.title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Real-world robot learning is constrained by the cost of collecting experience and evaluating candidate behaviors. Video generation models offer a scalable foundation for visual simulators that predict action outcomes before physical execution. Yet they often favor visual plausibility over accurate action following and coherent robot--object dynamics, while action-conditioned simulators depend on scarce, embodiment-specific data that are difficult to share across incompatible control spaces. We introduce WorldLine, an action-driven visual simulator that decouples transferable dynamics learning from heterogeneous action grounding. WorldLine learns manipulation dynamics from more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos and grounds them using over 2,000 hours of action trajectories across more than ten embodiments. An image-space action representation provides a shared control interface across embodiments, while multi-view and failure-enriched training with relational regularization improves interaction-sensitive prediction. Robot-focused few-step distillation enables efficient causal rollout while preserving action-critical motion. Across held-out and out-of-domain settings, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement; on failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. It predicts trajectory success with 74% mean accuracy across RoboTwin and AgiBot, one percentage point above the strongest baseline. Without RoboTwin training or adaptation, its rollouts improve task success by up to 21.4 percentage points over direct policy execution. Together, these capabilities make WorldLine a scalable and efficient visual simulator for policy evaluation and embodied planning. More results are available at \href{https://zhengsh123.github.io/WorldLine/}{project page}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorldLine:用于机器人操纵的动作驱动视觉模拟
articles.content_zh: 现实世界的机器人学习受到收集经验和评价候选行为成本的限制. 视频生成模型为视觉模拟器提供了可扩展的基础,这些模拟器在物理执行前预测动作结果. 然而,它们往往倾向于视觉上的合理性,而不是跟踪和连贯的机器人-物体动态,而行动条件模拟器则依赖于稀缺的、具体化的数据,这些数据难以在互不兼容的控制空间中共享。 我们引入了WorldLine,一种由动作驱动的视觉模拟器,它从各种动作的地面上学习,使可转移的动态脱钩。 WorldLine从超过10000小时的无动作机器人视频中学习了操纵动态,并用超过2000小时的动作轨迹将其定位在超过10个浮雕上. 图像空间行动表现提供了跨越各表现体的共享控制界面,而多视图和多故障强化培训与关系规范化改进了互动敏感预测。 以机器人为主的几步蒸馏可以有效地因果推出,同时保持行动关键运动。 在整个被搁置和域外设置中,WorldLine保持了强大的视觉质量和机器人运动协议;在故障轨迹上,它将机器人面具IoU改进0.1626,超过了最强基线. 它预测整个RoboTwin和AgiBot的轨迹成功率为74%,比最强基线高出一个百分点。 如果没有RoboTwin的培训或改造,其推广比直接政策执行提高了21.4%。 这些能力共同使WorldLine成为政策评价和体现规划的可扩展和高效的视觉模拟器. 更多结果可在\href{https://zhengsh123.github.io/WorldLine/QQProject页面上查阅}。

articles.title: EVO-WAM: Evolving World Action Models through Video-Action Verification
articles.content: Improving robot policies on new tasks without collecting additional expert demonstrations remains a central challenge in robot learning. World action models (WAMs) use broad video priors to jointly predict future videos and actions, offering a potential source of supervision for adapting to new tasks. However, generated videos may fail to depict task completion, and even visually successful videos may be paired with inconsistent actions that lead to execution failure. We propose EVO-WAM, a framework that adapts WAMs to unseen tasks by learning from their own generated video-action trajectories, without executing candidate actions in an external environment. First, we augment WAM training with state prediction and anchored multi-frame context to enable complete autoregressive rollouts without external execution feedback. Second, we identify reliable training experience by selecting task-completing prefixes with a vision-language model and verifying their video-action consistency with an inverse dynamics model. Third, we iteratively train the WAM on verified prefixes and generate new rollouts with the updated model. On seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, EVO-WAM increases average success rates from 26.9% to 68.0% for Cosmos3 and from 28.5% to 46.4% for DreamZero, reaching approximately $2.5\times$ and $1.6\times$ their initial success rates. On three unseen long-horizon composite tasks in the real world, it improves Cosmos3's average success rate from 20.0% to 76.7%, a gain of 56.7 percentage points. Project Page: https://evo-wam.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EVO-WAM:通过视频行动核查演变的世界行动模式
articles.content_zh: 在不收集更多专家演示的情况下改进关于新任务的机器人政策仍然是机器人学习的一个中心挑战。 世界行动模式(WAMS)使用宽广的视频前传,共同预测未来的视频和行动,为适应新任务提供了潜在的监督来源. 然而,生成的视频可能无法描绘任务的完成,甚至视觉上成功的视频也可能与导致执行失败的不一致行动配对. 我们提出EVO-WAM这个框架,通过学习他们自己产生的视频动作轨迹,使WAM适应无形的任务,而不在外部环境中执行候选行动. 首先,我们通过国家预测和定位的多框架背景,加强WAM培训,以便能够在没有外部执行反馈的情况下完全自动推出。 其次,我们通过选择任务完成前缀和视觉语言模型,并核实其视频动作与反向动态模型的一致性,来确定可靠的培训经验. 第三,我们反复在经过核实的前缀上训练WAM,并用更新的模型产生新的推出. 在未见的RoboTwin 2.0任务中,EVO-WAM将Cosmos3的平均成功率从26.9%提高到68.0%,将DreamZero的平均成功率从28.5%提高到46.4%,达到2.5\times$和1.6\tims$的初始成功率。 在现实世界中三个看不见的长视距复合任务上,它提高了宇宙3的平均成功率,从20.0%提高到76.7%,提高了56.7个百分点. 项目网页:https://evo-wam.github.io/。

articles.title: Pow3R-SLAM: Real-Time RGB-D SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
articles.content: We present Pow3R-SLAM, a real-time RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that uses Pow3R for tracking and mapping. Inspired by MASt3R-SLAM, a recent work on monocular SLAM using two-view 3D reconstruction priors, we extend the work to incorporate depth as a prior on the network's prediction, rather than as geometry to fuse. Where traditional RGB-D SLAM systems struggle with sparsity in the depth images, Pow3R utilizes the available depth to give a better-conditioned pointmap, while inferring the depths in empty regions from the two-view photometric, depth, and intrinsic data. Evaluated against MASt3R-SLAM following its protocol on 24 sequences from TUM, 7-Scenes, and Replica, Pow3R-SLAM runs 1.6x faster in wall time, has 15% lower mean trajectory error, a 3.1x lower unscaled error, and produces denser maps, with a 30% lower Chamfer distance. We also introduce a hybrid variant that runs 2.1x faster than MASt3R-SLAM at 25.3 frames per second (FPS), while maintaining improved tracking and mapping accuracy. Against ORB-SLAM3 in RGB-D mode, Pow3R-SLAM is more accurate on TUM, 7-Scenes, and ETH3D-SLAM, and completes every TUM sequence. While Pow3R-SLAM can struggle on a small set of self-similar scenes, its overall performance shows that adding depth as a prior for two-view 3D reconstruction SLAM can be beneficial. A project webpage is available at: https://ChrisKolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM , and code will be made open-source upon acceptance.

articles.title_zh: Pow3R-SLAM: 实时 RGB- D SLAM 与 3D 重建前身
articles.content_zh: 我们提出Pow3R-SLAM,这是一个实时的RGB-D同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)系统,使用Pow3R进行跟踪和绘图. 受MASt3R-SLAM的启发,最近使用双视立体重建前作的单视SLAM的作品,我们扩展了工作,将深度作为网络预测的前作,而不是作为几何引信. 当传统的RGB-D SAMM系统在深度图像中与sparsity相搏时,Pow3R利用已有的深度给出一个更好的条件点图,同时从双景光度,深度,内在数据中推断空域的深度. Pow3R-SLAM在TUM,7-Scenes,和Replica的24个序列协议之后,根据MAst3R-SLAM进行了评估,Pow3R-SLAM在墙壁时间上运行速度较快1.6x,平均轨迹误差较低15%,未分级误差较低3.1x,并生成更密集的地图,差差30%. 我们还采用了一种混合变体,运行速度快于MAST3R-SLAM,每秒25.3帧(FPS),同时保持改进的跟踪和绘图精度. 针对ORB-SLAM3的RGB-D模式,Pow3R-SLAM在TUM,7-Scens,和ETH3D-SLAM上更准确,并完成每个TUM序列. 虽然Pow3R-SLAM可以在一小组自相仿的场景上挣扎,但其整体表现表明,作为双视3D重建SLAM的前身加入深度可能是有利的. 项目网页见https://ChrisKolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM,接受后代码将开放源码。

articles.title: doPlan: A Variable-Horizon Dataset for Multi-Stage Language-Conditioned Planning in Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Autonomous vehicles interacting with passengers through natural language must reason beyond immediate commands. Passenger intent may span multiple stages of behavior, depend on future events, refer to surrounding agents or landmarks, and remain relevant as driving conditions evolve. Existing language-enabled driving datasets largely focus on short, localized interactions, leaving these longer-horizon forms of passenger intent comparatively underexplored. We introduce doPlan, to our knowledge the first publicly available, human-annotated real-world dataset designed to study passenger language as persistent task context. Built on nuPlan, doPlan contains 5,154 human-written passenger instructions spanning 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context over 50.9 hours of unique driving, with annotation windows ranging from 30.0 to 508.8 s. The annotations capture immediate, deferred, event-conditioned, persistent, and multi-stage passenger intent. The dataset, annotation interface, and supporting resources are publicly available at https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan. We evaluate four language-conditioned driving models and find that sensitivity to passenger language does not reliably translate into behavior consistent with the requested direction. More broadly, among 2,161 examples with a matched future maneuver, the first associated maneuver occurs a median of 24.6 s after the evaluation point, and only 9.8% occur within the models' common 5 s prediction horizon. These findings highlight the need to connect persistent passenger intent with successive planning decisions. doPlan provides a setting for studying how unresolved goals can be retained, grounded in evolving scenes, and tracked across multiple stages, including how a planner determines when a future goal becomes relevant to the current plan.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: doPlan:用于多层次语言条件的可变范围数据集 自主驾驶规划
articles.content_zh: 自主车辆通过自然语言与乘客互动,必须超越即时指令的理由. 乘客意图可能跨越行为的多个阶段,取决于未来的事件,指周围的代理人或地标,随着驾驶条件的发展,仍然具有相关性. 现有的基于语言的驱动数据集主要侧重于短而局部的交互作用,使得这些较长的客运意向形式相对的探讨不足. 我们介绍DoPlan, 据我们所知,这是第一个公开的、由人类附加说明的现实世界数据集,旨在将客运语言作为持续的任务背景加以研究。 建造在nuPlan上, doPlan载有5,154个人文旅客书面说明书,跨越169.1小时的累计指令对齐背景,超过50.9小时的独特驾驶,注释窗口从30.0到508.8秒不等. 说明载有立即、推迟、有事件条件、持续和多阶段的乘客意图。 数据集、注释界面和支助资源可在https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan上公开查阅。 我们评价四个语言条件的驾驶模式,发现对客运语言的敏感性不能可靠地转化为符合要求方向的行为. 更广泛地说,在2,161个具有相应未来操作的例子中,第一个相关操作发生在评价点之后的24.6秒中位数,只有9.8%发生在模型的5度共同预测范围内。 这些调查结果突出表明,必须将持续的客运意图与连续的规划决定联系起来。 doPlan为研究如何保留未实现的目标提供了一个环境,其基础是不断变化的场景,并贯穿多个阶段进行跟踪,包括规划者如何决定未来的目标何时与目前的计划相关。

articles.title: Beyond Lip Sync: Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement for Audio-Driven Portrait Animation
articles.content: We present RGOR (Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement), an audio-driven lip-sync framework that renders the mouth of the specific person being dubbed rather than a generic one. Existing lip-sync systems follow the audio closely and keep the face recognizable, yet the mouth they render is an average mouth: the shape and texture of the lips, the arrangement of the teeth, and how much of them shows as the mouth opens are not that person's. The problem persists because nothing in current training or evaluation asks for the person's own mouth: perceptual losses accept any plausible mouth, face identity is carried mostly by the skin around it, and the released inference code of inpainting systems uses the unmasked target frame as the reference, which hides the gap. To address this, RGOR conditions every generated frame on frames from separate enrollment recordings of the same person and on HD patches of the mouth that bypass the VAE, and trains the generator against a paired judge that compares each rendered mouth with the person's reference and learns to reject a realistic mouth of someone else. We further build an evaluation protocol and use it to compare open-source and commercial lip-sync systems on held-out identities. Experiments show that RGOR achieves the best or second-best result on most metrics, and preserves the person's own lip and dental detail while keeping synchronization and the rest of the face intact.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Lip Sync: 音频驱动外观动画的参考全方位口服改进
