articles.content_zh: 肺栓塞(PE)是心血管死亡的主要原因,然而,FDA清空的AI检测模型的真实世界性表现仍然不完全. 我们从一个单一商业平台(Aidoc Medical BriefCase)对两个经FDA认证的AI算法进行了回顾评价,一个用于专用CT肺血管造影(CTPA;n = 30 678)的PE分型,另一个用于常规对比增强的CT(n = 37 191)的偶然PE分型检测,跨越一个17个功能的学术卫生系统。 使用经验证的LLM管道从放射报告中取出参考标准标签(97%的准确度,kapa=0.94)。 PE模型实现了86.8%的灵敏度和99.1%的特异性,灵敏度从马鞍栓骨99.3%下降到了72.9%,从89.7%的急性PE下降到了65.3%。 IPE模型实现了73.5%的灵敏度和99.8%的特异性. 这两个模型的敏感性都低于林业发展局的清扫基准,但超过了清扫的特异性,外围和非急性浮雕的性能下降,反映了已知的人类阅读器局限性,并强调需要对人工智能辅助医疗器械进行标准化的上市后监测。

articles.title: The Camera Inside the Editor: Reading the Implicit Camera of Image Editors with Painted Calibration Patterns
articles.content: Instruction-based image editors insert objects, restyle scenes and render new viewpoints, but it is unknown which camera they assume when they paint into a photograph. Asked to cover the floor with a checkerboard, an editor paints projective structure from which classical vanishing-point geometry reads pitch, roll, focal length, yaw and, on renders, the principal point, without any training. Unlike a calibrator such as GeoCalib, which estimates the camera of an image, this isolates the camera under which the editor paints. On 120 rendered cameras with exact ground truth, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 paints tile edges that meet their vanishing points within 0.26 degrees, and its implicit camera matches the true one to 0.8 degrees in pitch and 6% in focal length, more accurately than GeoCalib except in roll. Asked to draw the horizon or mark a vanishing point instead, the editor fails, so this knowledge is revealed by painting and not by the explicit tasks we tried. The implicit camera has two priors: roll is pulled towards level (slope 0.71), and telephoto perspective towards a default of about 30 mm, which roughly matches the camera the models paint without any scene. For Qwen, the priors do not grow when blur removes four fifths of the line evidence. They are stronger on real photographs, and on NYUv2 a shorter wording of the task removes the difference for roll. On photographs from a 24--240 mm zoom lens the painted perspective grows with only 0.62 of the lens's slope, while GeoCalib and MoGe-2 saturate at about 52 and 42 mm. FLUX.1 Kontext and LongCat-Image-Edit are pulled much harder. Finally, from a level camera a camera-control LoRA executes pose commands at only 50--70% of their strength, and a board painted into its output agrees with the camera it produced.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 编辑器内部的相机:用绘画校正模式读取图像编辑器的隐形相机
articles.content_zh: 基于指令的图像编辑器会插入对象,重塑场景并渲染出新的视角,但是他们画入相片时所假设的相机是未知的. 被要求用一个检查板遮盖地板,一个编辑所绘制的投影结构,古典的消失点几何读取了投影,卷子,焦距,yaw,然后是主点,没有任何训练. 与GeoCalib等计算器估计出一幅图像相机不同,这隔离了编辑所所画相机. 120拍摄到准确地面真实的相机上,Qun-Image-Edit-2511画出在0.26度以内满足其消失分数的瓷砖边缘,而其隐含相机将真相机在投出时比起0.8度和焦距时比起GeoCalib更准确,只有卷出. 被要求画出地平线或标记一个消失点,编辑器失败了,所以这种知识是通过绘画而不是通过我们尝试的明确任务揭示的. 隐含相机有两个前题:卷被拉向平面(slope 0.71),而遥相视角默认为30毫米左右,大致与模型所画的相机相匹配而没有任何场景. 对于Quen来说,当模糊去除行证据的五分之四时,前缀不会增长. 它们对于真实相片更强壮,而对于NYUv2,任务更短的用词可以去除相差以进行卷. 在从24-240毫米缩放镜头取出的照片上,所画的视角只长出0.62个镜头的坡度,而GeoCalib和MoGe-2的饱和度大约为52和42毫米. FLUX.1 Kontext和LongCat-Image-Edit被拉得更难。 最后,从一个平面相机中,一个相机控制LORA执行的指令仅以其强度的50-70%摆出,一个被涂入其输出的相机与它生产的相机一致.

articles.title: CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces
articles.content: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4 fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CogWAM:通过事件驱动界面使语义认知与世界行动模型一致
articles.content_zh: 机器人政策越来越多地包括语义推理和未来世界的预测,然而结合这些能力并不能保证当地的预测和行动仍然与任务进度相配合. 我们介绍了CogWAM,这是一种认知指导的世界行动模式,它通过一个持久的语义状态,在任务推理和世界行动学习之间建立了明确的语义界面,存储已完成的任务事件和活性子任务. CogWAM 仅在观测显示语义过渡时更新此状态,允许任务级上下文在多个动作块上持续. 为了将语义上的背景与物理预测和控制联系起来,CogWAM采用了有进度条件的世界和行动查询方法,有选择地为未来世界的预测和行动生成提取与任务有关的信息。 在培训期间,语义学国家为两个分支提供共享的任务进度背景,而推论则去掉未来预测分支,直接从观测和保持状态中产生行动. 我们进一步推行语义学培训策略来改进过渡学习和闭路调节. 由于没有额外的机器人动作预训,CogWAM在RoboDojo上实现了15.56/11.70%的分数/SR,在BiCoord上实现了最先进的性能,而现实世界的实验显示闭路双臂操纵,语义状态再生比相继更新要少出16.4分.

articles.title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
articles.content: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PolyOCR-Venus:文本-儿童视觉智能统一OCR基金会模型
articles.content_zh: 光学字符识别(OCR)正在从平面文字转录到一般视觉智能,要求模型在复杂的视觉环境中识别,本地化和理性高于文字信息. 然而,现有的OCR系统往往只在一些任务上表现优异,并努力平衡各种设想的承认、分析和推理。 在本报告中,我们介绍PolyOCR,这是一个由不同规模的统一OCR基金会模型组成的家族. PolyOCR将一个遵循共享指令的框架与一个大型数据引擎相结合,将多相异的视觉资源转换为质量验证的OCR监督. 我们引入了能力指导政策优化,通过基于教师可靠性和师生能力差距的抽样路径,将基于核查者的团队相对政策优化与政策分解相结合。 我们还引入了OCR Bench v2.1,我们修改了OCR Bench v2,并用人工核实的注释校正和任务相匹配的分数度量. 跨OCR Bench v2.1,CC-OCR,内部KIE基准,OmniDoc Bench v1.6和MDP Bench的广泛实验表明,PolyOCR实现了最先进的或高度竞争性的性能.

articles.title: VIF-Bench: Evaluating Visual Instruction Following in Multi-Reference Image Generation
articles.content: Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues. However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images. To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity. Using these capabilities, we uncover three findings: (1) models face an adherence-artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts in generated images, (2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and (3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description. VIF-Bench is released as an open benchmark to establish a basis for fair comparison in controllable multi-reference image generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VIF- Bench:评价多参考图像生成中的视觉指示
articles.content_zh: 近期的多模式图像生成模型可以取出多幅图像和文字指令作为输入,使基于参考的生成不仅能被文本所引导,而且能被布局,箭头等视觉指令所引导,并可以出场出场. 然而,现有基准并不评价多种参考物必须在多种和多样化的视觉指示图像下构成的联合设定。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了VIF-Bench这一基准,即1,241项任务,目的是通过涵盖以下内容来评估模型能力在这一联合设置中的边缘:(一)多相异相视觉指令下的多参考生成(最多为7个),(二)参考图像可能与视觉指令相竞争的案例(例如,一个强烈的主体对一个目标姿势),以及(三)将视觉指令与文本描述在不同具体级别上的可控比较. 利用这些能力,我们揭示出三个发现:(1)模型面临遵守-艺术取舍:一旦模型达到更强的视觉指令遵守性,更强的遵守性往往与生成的图像中更多的指令文物相吻合;(2)视觉指令遵守性往往低于其参考图像具有受控属性显著状态的任务(如光线指令下的霓虹线标本),最一致地用于光线和风能;(3)对于能够理解视觉指令的模型,往往最好直接提供视觉约束,而不是在文字中加以描述;在使用文本时,适度的细节效果优于详尽的描述. VIF-Bench作为开放式基准发布,以建立公平比较可控多参考图像生成的基础.

articles.title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
articles.content: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memory systems accumulate RGB observations or latent features, causing storage requirements to grow as generation proceeds. We introduce **Honeycomb**, a video world model built on **HexMemory**, a compact low-rank representation that stores scene features in a fixed-size memory comprising six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each newly generated video chunk to plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, HexMemory warps the existing planes while preserving their dimensions, then integrates new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latent features from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. Because the writer processes only observations from the latest chunk, Honeycomb avoids per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full generation history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust consistency when revisiting previously observed regions, while maintaining constant feature-storage requirements throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Honeycomb: 视频世界模型的恒大场景记忆代表
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型需要持续的场景内存来保持长视距视频生成过程中的一致性. 现有的空间内存系统会积累RGB的观测或潜伏特征,使存储要求随着生成过程而增长. 我们引入了**Honeycomb**,一个基于**HexMemory**的视频世界模型,一个紧凑的低等代表,将场景特征存储在一个由6个空间和瞬间平面组成的固定大小内存中. 每个新生成的视频块到平面特写图。 随着空间覆盖或时间范围的扩大,HexMemory在保留其尺寸的同时将已存在的平面曲折,再通过信心加权集合和学习到的剩余修正来整合出新的特征. 一个读取器从HexMemory检索出潜在的特性,以附加后续的视频生成条件. 由于写作程序只处理从最新块的观测结果,Honeycomb避免了一地一地优化并重复处理全代历史. 关于WorldScore和RealEstate10K的实验显示,在重新审视以前观察到的区域时,视频生成质量强并具有很强的一致性,同时在全代始终保持对地物存储的要求. 我们的https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/上提供了代码和其他可视化信息。

articles.title: PAIQ: Patch-Aligned Semantic Injection via Residual Rotation
articles.content: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate--base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q. This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PAIQ:通过残留旋转进行补丁-相通语义注射
articles.content_zh: 语言相通和自我监督的视觉编码器在语义抽象和空间细节方面提供了互补的优势. 利用这种互补性需要丰富当地的特点,同时保留与集合相关的补丁之间的区别。 我们引入了PAIQ,一个补丁相通的语义注入框架,将基于内容的交叉编码器与正统受约束的剩余更新相匹配. 以DINOv3补丁特征为空间基,PAIQ通过联合源分配来聚合互补的SigLIP特征,并通过共享正交转换Q来注入集合-基差. 这种旋转在保留剩余规范和对等角度的同时会适应更新方向. 对于固定的预测特征,我们得出了类似语义集合下补丁可分性的条件,并表明在共享集合时,旋转会比直接插值增加一个非负分词. 只有投影和聚变参数经过了训练;视觉编码器和语言模型都仍然被冻结,聚变保留了196个可视符号. 跨各种语言主干网,PAIQ在法官评估的正确性和减少幻觉严重性方面,在图像描述和视觉问题回答方面,比单编码器接口大有收获。 在2B和9B Quen的骨干上,这种紧凑的接口平均比最强的被评价的聚变或符号压缩基线高出约2.9正确分.

articles.title: Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation
articles.content: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains. To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO, a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process. On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Med-RADIO:通过多教师分泌将所有医疗领域缩小到一个
articles.content_zh: 大规模医疗数据集和计算资源的迅速扩大,推动了医疗基础模型的显著进步. 鉴于医学成像模式的内在异质性,目前的研究主要走两条道路:为特定模式优化的专门模式和为处理多种模式而设计的通论模式. 然而,相对于自然形象通论者而言,医学通论模型既有培训数据尺度不足,又相对于医学专家而言,具体领域深度不足. 从经验上讲,通用模型确立了跨模式性绩效基线,而专家则在各自领域界定了绩效上限。 为了将这一基线提升到这些天花板上,我们提议将多个领域教师的补充性专门知识压缩成一个统一的医疗愿景基础模型,从而将一个医疗多教师蒸馏框架(Med-RADIO)。 我们的方法对普通教师和专家教师进行解析,分配模式相适应的蒸馏流来重组普通师预训数据,使之与专家领域相匹配,并使用平衡的损失防止任何一位教师主宰蒸馏过程。 在涉及五种模式的内部和外部分类基准方面,医疗-辐射防护组织在线性测试下比强健的医学通论者有所改进,在大多数评价模式方面仍然与有代表性的专家有竞争力。 代码见https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO。

articles.title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
articles.content: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 平均 优点: 微分平均速度发电机的稳定奖励
articles.content_zh: MeanFlow通过预测间隔-平均速度,可以高效地分出几步生成,但这种表示方式造成了奖励微调的不匹配:现有基于优势的目标通常以即时速度或等值的$_0-空间预测来定义,而推论则直接使用所学的平均速度图. 我们提出“平均速度优势”目标, 我们的关键构造采用共享的,分解的MeanFlow衍生物校正,以表达预测空间的奖励目标,同时在推算部署的平均速度网络上进行推开并参考规范化的具体处罚. 由此得到的配方保留了MeanFlow本土的几步采样器,并提供了将奖励改进转移到所部署的流图的直接机制. 在SD3.5-中度上,平面 优势是,所有8个报告指标都高于对应的4个步骤平均FlowNFT基线,而且只有4个非FE,与8个指标中的6个指标中的40个步骤的传播NFT基线相匹配或超过。 同一目标还转移到DNA促进器的设计上,在这种设计中,它既支持在多向和教师指导的奖励分级分级法中定义的发电机的无教师政策RL,又支持在比较的配置中得出最低一阶的Sei剖面MSE。

articles.title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?
articles.content: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. We observe that this is the result of the model performing a dimensionality reduction of vision representations in early layers. In order to explain this phenomenon: (1) We show analytically that linear self-attention can perform a dimensionality reduction by projecting in-context data onto its principal components, with each layer implementing one gradient descent step toward this objective. (2) We provide evidence that trained LVLMs reduce the dimensionality of vision representations in early layers via a similar mechanism.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内置图像值十维吗 ?
articles.content_zh: 在了解大语言模型的内语学习能力方面,特别是在入门电路方面,开展了大量工作。 对于几发分级任务,诱导电路会利用每个被标注为被标注的示例的线性表示来进行无标注的查询分类. 然而,很少有作品关注这些线性表述是如何首先构建的. 利用视觉模式相对于文字的表达性,我们在"大视觉语言模型"(LVLMs)内部发现了一种共有的区别几何. 它是一个低维空间,在所有图像分类任务中共享,其中内文本图像被压缩成线性可分解的表示物后用于进行分类. 我们认为,这是该模型在早期减少视觉表现的维度的结果。 为了解释这一现象:(1) 我们从分析上表明,线性自觉通过将内容中的数据投射到其主要组成部分上,可以实现维度的降低,每一层都朝着这一目标迈出了一步。 (2) 我们提供的证据表明,经过培训的LVLM通过类似机制降低早期视觉表现的维度。

articles.title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning
articles.content: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed mainly for text-based language models, and our empirical study reveals two challenges when complex multimodal sources are involved. First, the joint image-text attribution can underrepresent visual evidence relative to text, obscuring the image regions supporting the response. Second, visual evidence may influence the generated response through multiple intermediate reasoning paths, while existing methods trace only a limited subset of these paths, causing important visual contributions to be underestimated. Motivated by these insights, we introduce VTrace, a multimodal token-attribution framework that traces input contributions through intermediate reasoning and calibrates attribution scores across modalities. VTrace constructs pairwise attributions that highlight token-specific contributions and aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form to account for both direct and indirect contributions. Cross-modal calibration then rescales image and text attribution scores using modality contributions estimated from response-likelihood changes, enabling a unified ranking of input tokens. Evaluations against seven baselines across six visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior attribution faithfulness. Project page: https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 追踪证据:通过愿景-语言表达的忠实归属
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)表现出了很强的推理能力,然而支持所生成的响应的视觉和文字证据仍然难以识别. 忠实的符号归属解释LVLM的响应方式是,根据模型对它的依赖程度,分配给图像的分数和迅速的符号,这样去掉排名较高的符号使得生成的响应更有可能更快地下降. 然而,现有的象征性分配方法主要是为基于文本的语言模式而开发的,我们的经验研究揭示了在涉及复杂的多式联运来源时面临的两个挑战。 首先,联合图像-文本归属可以对文本进行不实的视觉证据描述,模糊支持响应的图像区域. 其次,视觉证据可能通过多条中间推理路径来影响所生成的响应,而现有方法只能追踪这些路径中有限的子集,导致重要的视觉贡献被低估. 基于这些见解,我们引入了VTrace,这是一个多式联运代号分配框架,通过中间推理来追踪投入贡献,并校准各种模式的归属分数。 VTrace构建了双向归属,突出特定符号贡献,并以封闭的形式汇总所有前向归属路径,以说明直接和间接贡献。 跨模式校正之后,利用从响应-相似度变化中估计的方式贡献来对图像和文本归属分数进行再分级,从而能够对输入符进行统一排序. 根据6个视觉推理基准的7个基线进行评价,显示出优越的归属忠诚。 项目网页:https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.

articles.title: Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding
articles.content: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Exemplar2VQA:通过多代理编码可缩放的Exemplar-Driven视觉问答生成框架
articles.content_zh: 在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)中推进空间智能,被复杂,可扩展的3D问答(QA)数据的稀缺所瓶颈. 虽然人工注释是劳动密集型的,但直接使用LLMs合成这些QA对往往由于在空间和几何计算中固有的缺陷而失败. 我们引入了Exemplar2VQA,是一种可伸缩的由exemplar驱动的视觉问题解答生成框架,通过多剂编码在模拟环境中快速合成出大规模空间QA对. Exemplar2VQA通过为协作代理人配备精密设计的几何公用图书馆,通过确定密码执行来绕过LLMs的空间推理缺陷. 关键是,这个框架展现出显著的多功能性:将不同的静态以物体为中心的空间查询模板作为示例,它无缝和自主地将其缩放成大规模高纯度合成数据集. 仅以Exemplar2VQA生成的室内合成数据作精细调取Quen2.5-VL(3B/7B),在各种基准中产生显著的性能改进. 此外,其效力不仅限于室内内部数据集,而且还大力扩展至室外和混合场景基准。 这些结果将Exemplar2VQA确立为缩小Embody AI中模拟到实际差距的可扩展而强大的范式. 我们的代码在https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA上

articles.title: Texture Space Material Diffusion
articles.content: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 质地空间材料扩散
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了一种完全在纹理空间为三维物体生成高质量材料的方法。 我们微调一个视频传播变压器,用于文本制导材料生成,多视图材料生成,材料提升. 我们的关键见解是利用从图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影,使扩散过程能够将任意的地美和纹理参数化概括起来. 这种方法还避免了视频和多视图传播模式所固有的观点一致性问题. 因为纹理空间是二维的,我们可以再利用预先训练的视频传播模型的强前奏. 我们采用我们的方法来进行高质量的材料重建,从不明光线下拍摄的所展示的照片,以及文字和图像指导材料的生成。 我们的方法可以放大到高分辨率(8K),100+输入视图,以及神经物质表达. 在定量和定性评价中,我们显示了材料生成和重建的最新成果。

articles.title: VoxelSage: Tool-Augmented 3D CT Analysis and Simulator-Shielded Sequential Resection Planning for Liver Tumors
articles.content: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VoxelSage:工具增强的3D CT分析与模拟器-Shielded 对活体肿瘤进行序列分解规划
articles.content_zh: 手术前肝-肿瘤评估需要分解,物理-空间测量,视觉证据,以及从同一个三维CT体积进行分解规划. 现有的工具往往分别处理这些步骤,而语言模型无法可靠地从CT计算物理测量. 为了提供一个综合的工作流程,我们提出VoxelSage,一种双维和三维可视化的多模式系统,肝肿瘤分析,以及手术前分解规划. 它的双端口架构将语言-模型管弦与图像计算区分: 端口 A解释请求并选择技能,而Port B将其应用于CT卷和分解口罩并返回结构化的结果. 保持B口的物理测量使LLM无法直接计算,并降低被编造出数值结果的风险. 8个内置技能支持定量分析,视觉证据生成,三维重建,分化完善,并相继进行分解规划;用户定义的技能可以扩展这些功能. 对于序列规划,一个行为克隆神经分级器命令候选人重新剖析目标,而一个基于模拟器的屏蔽则根据预先定义的限制来检查. 这种方法将256个未见模拟场景的平均模拟时间从34.274分减少到33.388分(0.886分,2.59%),将模拟失血时间从300.847分减少到183.852分升(116.995分,38.89%)。 这些结果表明系统集成和模拟器级性能,而不是临床疗效或安全性. 公众执行情况见https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage。

articles.title: Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model
articles.content: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision--language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce \textbf{M}ask-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{C}ounterfactual \textbf{E}xplanations (\mace), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. \mace constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source--target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate \mace on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对照视觉-语言模型的定向视觉反事实解释
articles.content_zh: CLIP等对比性视觉-语言模型的当前解释方法主要识别出重要区域而未显示如何为获得目标预测而改变输入. 我们引入\textbf{M}任务制导\textbf{A}daptive\textbf{C}事实\textbf{E}xplanations (\mace),一种专门为CLIP零发分类设计的定向视觉反事实方法. \mace 构造一个来自源属性或源- 目标属性差异的可编辑区域, 并且只在需要达到指定目标类别时才会扩展掩码 。 一个潜在的扩散涂抹模型然后会修改所选区域,而被冻结的CLIP模型则提供修改指导并固定剩余图像内容到原始输入. 我们评价图像网、食品101、牛津宠物和CUB-200。 源-mask变相在所有四个数据集中都实现了最高的目标上-1成功率,而差-mask变相则产生最小的像素水平和知觉变化和最佳现实主义分数. 这两种变体都使用同一种基因主干线,在稳定扩散的唯一基线上改进了接近性和现实性。 这些结果显示适应性的口罩制导编辑产生了有效的CLIP反事实. 他们进一步揭示了反事实有效性和源图像保存之间的取舍。

articles.title: Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers
articles.content: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 2.2 pp over standard random initialization. Our analysis identifies recurrence as essential for learning compact weights that transfer across models. In ViTs, we localize a key benefit in the suppression of high-norm tokens that produces substantial improvements in zero-shot segmentation (ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 to 42.9), object localization (VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 to 18.4), and depth estimation (NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 to 0.998). This demonstrates that transformers need not start from a blank slate, and can be initialized with generic capabilities at low cost with no domain- or task-specific data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 程序核心:愿景变换器的契约经常初始化
articles.content_zh: 变形器一般通过随机初始化来训练,需要从大规模优化中产生出所有能力. 最近的工作显示,少量抽象的程序性数据可以帮助低成本地获得通用的导出结构. 然而,这增加了每个目标模式必须重复的训练前阶段。 我们提出程序核心,一种初始化战略,将这一通用结构收录为一套可跨模型再利用的紧凑的权重. 我们在程序数据上训练一个最小的经常性变压器,然后扩大其重量来初始化任意宽度和深度的变压器. 由此而来的初步化提高了图像分类,自我监督的视觉学习(DINO),以及模拟自然语言(FineWeb-Edu)和代码(CodeParrot)的性能. 对于图像分类,将1M参数芯扩展为85M参数的Vit-Base初始化,比标准随机初始化提高2.2pp的ImageNet上1精度. 我们的分析认为,复发对于学习跨模型的紧凑权重至关重要。 在ViTs中,我们将一个关键好处定位在压制高正标,从而在零发分解(ImageNet-S mAP 32.3至429),物体定位(VOC07 CorLoc 9.9至 18.4)和深度估计(NYUv2 RMSE 1.104至0.998)方面产生重大改进. 这表明变压器不需要从空白的板块起步,可以低价以通用能力初始化,没有域或任务特定数据.

articles.title: TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction
articles.content: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 交友翻译: 建立CT重建基础模式
articles.content_zh: 监督的深层学习推动了稀有的地形学重建。 然而,传统的模型,一般是将回向投影(FBP)图像或星图映射为清洁重建而作的映射,这些模型在分发的转变中十分脆弱。 由于每当投影计数和角度,探测器分辨率,或数据分布变化时,它们都需要再培训,因此它们在现实世界应用中的部署仍然有限. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了TomoTransformer,一个基于变压器的架构,将每个\textit{local}被过滤的投影作为个人的符号,并通过自觉预测缺失的视图. 关键的是,TomoTransformer在\emph{后向投影空间}中运行,将跨空间位置的预测相隔开来,使视图插值几何性能好,对探测器大小不常见. 这种设计产生一个单一的基础模型,可以在任意角位置和探测器尺寸处理任何数量的输入预测,并在不进行再培训的情况下查询任何数量的靶角. TomoTransformer对涵盖多种医学CT解剖学和自然影像的大规模数据集进行了培训,并有效地概括了解剖学、材料和分辨率。 对若干基准稀有视图数据集的广泛评价表明,TOMOTransformer明显超越VideoTrans等并行的多用途模型,匹配或超过针对特定协议的有力基线,同时对投入和目标预测的数量保持完全不可知. 此外,该模型在从X-射线同步星所收集的真正实验性纳米规模的大脑数据上表现出强烈的零射一般化,显示出其对现实世界应用的实用性。

articles.title: When to Adapt: Multi-Signal Domain Shift Detection for Efficient Training-Free Adaptation in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
articles.content: Robust and reliable perception is essential for autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, particularly in long-term missions where environmental conditions may change significantly over time. Although recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have improved open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, these models can still suffer from domain shift, which can significantly degrade performance if they are not adapted to the current environment. Training-free domain adaptation is a relevant paradigm for adaptation, consisting of adjusting the model online using lightweight adapters. Recent approaches apply this on a per-frame basis, which is impractical for deployments on resource-constrained robotic hardware. To tackle this, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) in open-vocabulary segmentation. Our method leverages temporal coherence across consecutive frames by monitoring and combining complementary aspects of domain shift (visual change, adapter mismatch, and semantic drift) to trigger adaptation only when needed. We validate our approach on a benchmark including indoor and outdoor environments and using real robotic data. We demonstrate that our approach maintains segmentation accuracy while substantially reducing adaptations, making training-free adaptation practical and feasible for long-term, real-world robotic deployments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 何时适应:多标志域移动检测,以在开放词汇分区中高效地适应无培训
articles.content_zh: 对在现实世界环境中运作的自主机器人来说,特别是环境条件可能随时间而发生重大变化的长期飞行任务来说,强健而可靠的认知是必不可少的。 虽然视觉基础模型(VFMs)最近的进步改善了开放-vocabulary语义分解,但这些模型仍然会受域位移的影响,如果不适应当前环境,域位会显著地降低性能. 无培训域适应是一个相关的适应范式,包括使用轻量级适配器在线调整模型. 最近的办法按框架适用,这对于部署受资源限制的机器人硬件是不切实际的。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用多信号域移位检测方法,在开放-真空分解中进行无培训的持续测试-时间适应(TF-CTTA)。 我们的方法通过监测和综合域转移的互补方面(视觉变化、适配器不匹配和语义漂移),在连续的框架中利用时间一致性,仅在需要时触发适应。 我们以一个基准验证我们的方法,包括室内和室外环境以及使用真正的机器人数据。 我们表明,我们的做法保持了分化的准确性,同时大大减少了适应,使无培训的适应在长期、现实世界的机器人部署中切实可行。

articles.title: FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
articles.content: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FedSocket:不同模式联邦学习的可执行知识交流
articles.content_zh: 联邦知识必须被不同模式、私人结构和任务的接受者继续使用。 我们介绍FedSocket,它使得接受者执行成为交换型号的设计要求. 一个共享的Q结合了受援方-可计量的投入,任务自主的产出,以及自有意识的聚合,通过共同的预测界面将不同的私人模型连接起来. 私人模型教授本地Q复制;返回的Q支持本地学习和联合推论,只有Q参数和计数交换. 在六个数据集中,FedSocket在MELD和UCF-51上将缺失模式接收者的准确度提高14.44和15.51个百分点。 在相应的推论能力下,Joint以UCF-51精确度超过独立综艺节目11.06分,以正双向Flickr30k R@1. 联合还改善了所有四个不同终点的Q,显示了结合当地预测和交换预测的价值。 教师控制、共享途径干预和要素确定监督、共享和部署的作用。 FedSocket将交流知识从联邦培训直接用于接受者的推断。

articles.title: TReVS: Integrating Textual Relevance and Visual Saliency for Efficient Vision-Language Model Token Pruning
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. We further find that high-variance attention heads are more sensitive to the textual query and yield more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for second-stage pruning. Motivated by these findings, we propose TReVS, a training-free framework that combines textual relevance with vision-encoder saliency for pre-LLM pruning and leverages high-variance attention heads to remove task-irrelevant tokens at shallow-to-intermediate layers of the LLM. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS retains 92.8% of the unpruned baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TReVS: 将文字相关性和视觉重要性纳入高效的视觉语言模型Token Pruning
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)优于视觉理解和推理,但往往由于视觉符号数量多而引起大量推论成本. 近期的可视化符号打压方法越来越遵循了两阶段的范式:它们首先在视觉编码器后去掉可视化冗余符号,再丢弃与大语言模型(LLM)内文字查询无关的符号. 然而,由于第一阶段一般只依靠视觉-编码器的显著性,它可能会过早地去除与查询相关的符号,使随后的文字引导阶段失去关键的视觉证据. 我们的经验分析表明,将查询指导纳入第一阶段的查询,更好地保存了与任务相关的证据,并始终如一地改进业绩,而不是仅注重视觉的查询。 我们还发现,高度多变的注意力头对文字查询更为敏感,并产生更多的对文字到视觉的差别化注意力信号,用于第二阶段的穿梭. 基于这些调查结果,我们提议采用TReVS这一无培训框架,将文字相关性和视觉编码器的显著性结合起来,用于LLM前穿行,并利用高差异的注意力头去除LLM从浅到中层与任务相关的符号. 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上,TReVS保留了92.8%的未刷取基线性能,同时刷取了94.4%的可视地标,表现优于之前最先进的方法.

articles.title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Diagnosing Large Multimodal Models for AI-Generated Image Assessment
articles.content: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multimodal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects: Semantics, Quality, Authenticity, and Responsibility. SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AI-generated images sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro, already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评价者: 为AI-Generated图像评估诊断大型多模式
articles.content_zh: 随着文本到图像(T2I)生成的迅速推进,强力评价变得至关重要而具有挑战性,因为传统度量衡无法捕捉到精细的相配和分生文物. 虽然大型多模式模式越来越多地被采用为评价者,但现有的基准通常孤立地研究语义理解、质量感知和真实性识别,同时在很大程度上忽略了责任检测。 这给统一和全面的验证留下了空白. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了SQUARE-Bench这一综合基准,系统地评价LMM作为AI生成图像的评估者的能力,涉及四个方面:语义、质量、真实性和责任。 SQUARE-Bench引入了由38个子元构成的颗粒分类法,用于评价从22个从遗产到最先进的发电机等不同模型中抽取的近10KAI所生成的图像,并辅之以3K多幅真实世界的图像. 图像被附加了解析的问答对. 对23个LMM的广泛实验表明,顶级专利模型,如双子座-3-Pro,已经超过了个人专家的基准。 然而,模型之间的性能差距仍然很大,在精确推论和具体领域稳健性方面存在显著差距。 除了制定基准外,我们还对LMM制导的迭代编辑进行概念证明研究,其中针对维度的LMM向固定图像编辑提供诊断反馈. 由此产生的制导系统在语义、真实性和责任方面有选择地改进,同时呈现出一贯的视觉质量取舍。 SQUARE-Bench既可作为描述LMM评价能力并研究其在T2I生成改进中的用途的诊断工具. 基准和数据集将在公布后公布。

articles.title: Decompose Radicals, Then Reward: Fine-Grained Inspection for Accurate Chinese Text Rendering
articles.content: Rendering accurate Chinese text remains challenging for text-to-image models. Existing OCR-based reinforcement-learning rewards compare decoded transcripts with target strings. Such rewards overlook the compositional nature of Chinese writing: an ideograph consists of reusable components arranged through explicit spatial relations, yet OCR evaluates it as an atomic character. Consequently, visually different radical-level errors may receive equally coarse feedback, encouraging glyphs that merely resemble the target instead of faithfully reproducing its internal structure. We employ Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS), which comprise spatial operators and character components, and train an expert IDS recognizer to transcribe rendered Chinese text into this representation. Building on this recognizer, we introduce IDSpect, which deterministically decomposes the target text into IDS tokens and aligns crop-level visual IDS predictions with the target sequence. Globally unique token credit makes this comparison robust to the order of detected text regions. Combined with a whole-character semantic reward, IDSpect supplies fine-grained credit with component and spatial-relation without changing the image generator or adding inference-time cost. Experiments with GRPO post-training of Qwen-Image demonstrate that IDSpect achieves leading structural quality and semantic alignment on LongText and GenTextEval.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 分解"激进","再赏":精细精细地检查准确的中文文本渲染
articles.content_zh: 渲染准确 中文本对于文本到图像模型仍然具有挑战性. 现有的基于OCR的强化学习奖励将已解码的文字记录与目标字符串进行比较. 这种奖励忽略了汉字写作的构成性质:一个象形文字由通过明确的空间关系安排的可再用组件所组成,而OCR则评价为原子特性. 因此,视差不同的激进级错误可能得到同样粗糙的反馈,鼓励只与目标相似的格言,而不是忠实地复制其内部结构。 我们使用由空间操作员和字符组件组成的描述序列(IDS),并培训一个专家IDS识别器,将中文文本转录到这一表述中。 在这个识别器的基础上,我们引入了IDSpect,它决定了将目标文本分解为IDS符号,并将作物级的视觉IDS预测与目标序列相协调. 全球独特的象征性信用使这一比较与检测到的文本区域的顺序十分有力。 IDSpect与整体特征语义奖励相结合,在不改变图像生成器或增加推论时间成本的情况下,提供有组件和空间关系的精细分量信用. GRPO对Quen-Image进行后期训练的实验表明,IDSpect在LongText和GentextEval上实现了领先的结构质量和语义对接.

articles.title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants
articles.content: To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions. To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 549 sessions, 104 trajectories, and 2,719 candidates, spanning both objective and open-ended questions. Each session is a video with fine-grained annotations, and sessions within a trajectory revolve around related activities. Models then use persistent memory to answer questions about past sessions and provide proactive responses while maintaining real-time interaction. This raises challenges: persistent memory must be storable, selectively retain information, be injected at the right time, and remain efficient. Moreover, finite storage may leave required evidence unavailable, so assistants should recognize missing evidence. Therefore, we systematically evaluate general video models under different memory protocols and diverse specialized streaming memory systems, and test whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence. Our evaluation reveals a clear utility--latency--storage trade-off: existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, low overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions. APM-Bench provides a comprehensive testbed for developing and comparing persistent memory systems under realistic streaming conditions. We hope it encourages future work that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage toward more practical persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: APM-Bench:为爱高中心流视频助理设定跨会场持续记忆基准
articles.content_zh: 为了作为现实世界的个人助手,流传的视频模型需要持续的内存来保留过去的经验,以便日后使用. 然而,现有的流媒体基准和方法往往侧重于单个连续视频或短片,忽略了现实世界的互动经常是断断续续的,需要内存在中断中持续. 为了填补这一空白,我们引入了APM-Bench,它将现实世界的流线交互重新塑造为多会的活道. 它包括549个会议、104个轨道和2 719名候选人,涉及客观和开放式的问题。 每场会议都是一段带精细说明的视频,轨迹内的会议围绕着相关活动. 模型然后使用持久的内存来回答关于过去会议的问题,并提供主动的回答,同时保持实时的互动. 这提出了挑战:持续的记忆必须是可储存的,有选择地保留信息,在适当的时候注入,并保持效率. 此外,有限的储存可能使所需证据无法提供,因此助理人员应确认缺失的证据。 因此,我们系统地评价不同内存协议下的一般视频模型和不同的专业流传存储系统,并测试模型是否承认证据不足. 我们的评价揭示了一种明显的效用-相关性-储存取舍:现有方法仍然难以同时实现可靠的长期召回、低间接费用和跨会的有效主动援助。 APM-Bench为在现实流化条件下开发并比较持久性内存系统提供了一个全面的测试台. 我们希望它鼓励今后的工作,共同考虑效用、耐用性和储存,为现实世界的流派助手提供更切合实际的持续记忆。

articles.title: Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
articles.content: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization. We call this phenomenon ``probabilistic forgetting'': suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 杂草出坏种子:文字到图像传播模式的初始-噪声- Robust Unlearning for Text to-Image Diffusion Models
articles.content_zh: 机器不学习已成为一项关键的后热安全措施,在不进行令人望而却步的再培训的情况下,从T2I模式中去除敏感概念。 然而,我们揭示,由于噪音初始化严重缺乏活力,目前最先进的方法十分脆弱。 我们称这种现象为“可能忘记”:被压制的概念在具体的随机初始噪音条件下重新出现,尽管似乎对其他初始化没有了解。 我们追踪到这种失败,是因为标准高斯取样在不学习期间与不学习目标之间不一致。 由于目标概念在整个未学习阶段只在具体的初始噪音区域显示,统一的随机采样产生稀有的、非信息化的梯度更新,无法推动有力的去除。 为了克服这一问题,我们提出了一个适应性的、以概念为条件的抽样战略,将梯度更新动态地集中在目标概念体现的区域,即减重的无信息区。 我们用六个不同的SOTA不学习方法整合我们的框架, 跨越四个传播主干线, 并评估它的安全性、物体性和艺术风格的不学习, 我们的方法将所有随机初始化的有条件裸体再现率平均在4个基线内降低67.2%,并将两次对抗性评价中的攻击成功率降低. 在整个概念领域,适应性噪声抽样可以加强对抗性强和不目标保留,同时保持有竞争力的基因质量和目标时代性能。

articles.title: Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance
articles.content: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a $\textit{Maximum a Posteriori}$ (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subsequently, we apply our method to various ill-posed inverse problems and show that it surpasses convergent methods while competing with state-of-the-art empirical ones.

articles.title_zh: 对反向问题有原则的MAP估计:弥合趋同与绩效之间的差距
articles.content_zh: Pretrained denoisers提供了将图像前缀纳入还原算法的有力方法. 插管和放管和RED方法利用一等最优化计划中的固定噪声层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分 相形之下,最近最先进的方法利用了从流式或扩散式基因模型中衍生出来的分泌物,并按照降低噪音水平的顺序加以评价。 虽然这些方法取得了很强的经验性能,但其趋同理论仍然有限. 在本文中,我们通过专门设计一种算法来弥补这一差距,这种算法将噪声降低时的发声者与为确保趋同而定制的时间表结合起来。 从贝叶斯人的角度,我们证明我们的方法在适当的假设下汇合到$\textit{Maximum a Postereri}$(MAP)的估计数. 随后,我们将我们的方法应用于各种不合理的反向问题,并表明它超越了趋同的方法,而与最新经验方法相竞争。

articles.title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RawVLA:用于机器人操纵的健美神经影像信号处理器
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型一般运行在由固定相机图像信号处理器(ISP)所生产的RGB图像上,将成像管留在学习和评价回路之外. 我们从五个基本ISP维度,即增益,传感器噪声,色相反应,通体反应,和比特深度,系统地研究这种被忽略的设计选择的后果. 我们的分析表明,RAW-to-RGB处理在物质上既塑造了动作预测又塑造了操纵成功,不同的ISP维度产生大相径庭的效果. 以这些发现为指南,我们引入了RawVLA, 一种流出神经ISP, 它适应性地使RAW观测对被冻结的VLA政策,同时将其能力集中在与所体现行为相关的成像因子上. 我们进一步提出RawVLA-Bench,这是一个RAW-域操纵基准,将图像处理暴露为跨越干净和不利的获取条件的明确评价变量。 在RawVLA-Bench的实验表明,RawVLA在标准条件下保持性能,同时在退化成像下大幅度地提高稳健性,建立适应性的RAW处理,作为物理相机和所体现政策之间的有效接口.

articles.title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
articles.content: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 愿景-语言模型基准的分级压缩
articles.content_zh: 对视觉语言模型(VLMs)的彻底评价已经变得昂贵得令人望而却步,因为各种基准跨越不断扩展的能力范围,新的模型步入了无情的步伐。 将模型排名保留在成本一分之一的基准压缩方法对语言模型进行了很好的研究,但对VLMs来说,这个问题仍然没有得到充分的探讨. 我们介绍的是PRIME Bench(为多式联运评价运行冗余项目),这是一个具有远见的分级基准压缩框架,在保留模型排名的同时,大幅降低评价成本。 这种分级框架分四个阶段运作:数据清理以删除没有图像和全部正确项目可回答的项目;类别代表选择以选择每个能力类别的一个基准;项目与Vision-Aware Difference(VAW)进行核对;以及类别计数核对。 暴力侵害妇女问题将模型间差异与仅从多式联运嵌入计算出的视向分数结合起来,同时鼓励在每个基准内涵盖各种项目。 在从项目选择中抽取的模型上,它的平均忠诚度最高,只保留5%。 分级设计让从业者在任何阶段都停下来来配合他们的计算预算;所发行的套房在保留模型排名的同时删除了超过97%的项目. 除了压缩外,我们的分析还显示VLM评价如何随着模型面板的成长和演变而运作,为设计更有效率、更能模拟更替率的未来基准提供了指导,并明确了评价侧伸展的限度。

articles.title: LazySloth: Bounded LLM-based Lazy Tree Search for Fast Long Video Comprehension
articles.content: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising results in long-video understanding due to the rich semantic information they can capture. However, most methods focus on coarse captioning of extracted image frames that are computationally inefficient and require models with large context windows. While past work has explored efficient methods through multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), they rely on lossy embeddings that lose temporal context and fine-grained detail. Few works to date have investigated how VLM-based query-relevant information retrieval can be optimized. We introduce LazySloth, an efficient tree-based search method that speeds up video comprehension and retrieval tasks 2.9-8.3x (compared to existing agentic methods) through bounded captioning of portions of the video considered irrelevant by a VLM of the video. Compared to contemporary specialized video-understanding VLMs and RAG-based methods, LazySloth achieved similar or better final task accuracy across two recent open-source base VLMs--Gemma 4 31B and Qwen3.6 27B--across four benchmarks. LazySloth reduced the gap between the base open-source model and a closed-source model, GPT-4o. Ablations showed that replacing VLM scene understanding with CLIP-based retrieval cost 8.8-19.9% in accuracy, while lazy tree construction matches eager construction at a fraction of the captioning cost. With LazySloth, we demonstrate the possibility of faster long-video comprehension without substantial loss in performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LazySloth:基于 LLM 的 Brounded Lazy Tree 搜索快长视频解析器
articles.content_zh: 现代视觉语言模型(VLMs)由于能够捕捉到丰富的语义信息,在长视频理解上显示出有希望的结果. 然而,大多数方法都侧重于对被取取的图像框架粗糙的字幕,这些图像框架在计算上效率低下,需要具有大上下文窗口的模型. 虽然过去的工作通过多模式检索强化生成(RAG)探索了高效方法,但它们依赖于失去时间背景和细微细节的失落嵌入。 迄今为止,没有多少作品研究如何优化基于VLM的查询相关信息检索。 我们推出LazySloth, 一种基于树的高效搜索方法, 加速视频理解和检索任务2. 相较于当代专门的视频理解VLM和RAG方法,LazySloth在最近两个开源基站VLMs-Gemma 4 31B和Quen3.6 27B-在四个基准上实现了类似或更好的最终任务精度. LazySloth缩小了基础开源模型和闭源模型GPT-4o之间的差距. 校正显示,用基于CLIP的检索来取代VLM场景理解,精度为8.8%至19.9%,而懒惰的树构筑则以字幕成本的一小部分与急切的构造相匹配. 与LazySloth一起,我们展示了更快的长视频理解的可能性,而不会在性能上出现重大损失.

articles.title: Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting for Consistent Long-Form Video Generation
articles.content: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains a critical challenge, where a major bottleneck lies in conditioning independently generated shots to preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the full combination of required elements for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms recent-frame, memory-based, and entity-level retrieval baselines in cross-shot consistency and text-controllability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 辅助检索-强化催化一致的长格式视频生成
articles.content_zh: 虽然近期的视频基础模型在生成高质量短视频方面表现出色,但长式视频生成仍然是一项关键的挑战,其中主要瓶颈在于配置独立生成的镜头来保存整个故事中一致的角色、场景和物品。 现有的无培训方法通常会利用收回的历史视觉来限制目标拍摄。 然而,这些参考文献往往存在严重的信息不匹配现象,要么引入无关紧要的上下文冗余,要么未能为目标镜头提供所需元素的全部组合. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了补充检索强化提示,这是一种代理框架,它从战略上汇集了一整套相互支持的历史参考材料,以便在不进行再培训或修改基本生成器的情况下,为长式视频生成实现完整和有针对性的条件。 具体地说,我们的框架明确模拟每个目标拍摄所需的视觉元素,将叙述脚本解析成一个以文字为底线的视觉元素登记册,以跟踪字符,物体,场景,以及他们的镜头级别状态. 一个VLM附加说明的密钥框架库进一步将这些元素映射到过去的视觉观测. 在所需要素的指导下,我们的代理人检索到补充参考文献,以最大限度地扩大目标要素覆盖面,同时尽量减少历史噪音。 最后,检索到的参考文献、结构化元素状态和地平面指示被集合成一个统一的被冻结的视频生成器的提示。 这一元素意识过程提供了全面的条件,同时仍然可以充分解释。 对多镜头故事生成的定量和定性评价表明,在交叉镜头一致性和文本可控性方面,我们的方法一贯优于近期框架、内存和实体一级的检索基线。

articles.title: BeatDance: Generating Beat-Consistent 3D Dance with Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Modeling
articles.content: Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BeatDance: 生成Beat-Consistent 游戏 3D 与分级空间- 时空建模相舞
articles.content_zh: 从音乐中产生现实的3D舞蹈是一项挑战性的任务,需要准确与音乐节奏同步,同时能捕捉到人类运动的空间复杂性. 虽然现有方法可以产生物理上可行的舞蹈动作,但是它们往往会努力与音乐,如节拍,实现精确的对接. 为了消除这一局限性,我们提出了一个基于传播的新框架,即BeatDance,其中包括两个组成部分: 1)我们提出了分级分解关注(HDA)模块,首先将人类姿势和时间动态的学习分解. 然后采用分级结构来捕捉短期和长期的依赖性,从而加强时空模型。 2)我们采用循环相通的学习方式,引入了辅助舞蹈对音乐模块. 在训练期间,被重建的音乐和原作音乐之间的差异会诱发更强烈的损失信号,有效地鼓励了音乐和舞蹈运动之间的一致性属性. 广泛的试验结果表明,我们拟议的做法在两个基准数据集上超过了最近采用的竞争方法。

articles.title: Multi-task learning for the automatic grading of enlarged perivascular space burden using MRI
articles.content: Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale - a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences. We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. We comparatively evaluated a conditional convolutional neural network (CNN) which accepts PVS masks as an extra input channel, a multi-task CNN which performs both PVS segmentation and scoring, and a logistic regression model which utilises features derived from PVS masks to predict PVS scores. Multi-task learning was the most effective method, achieving a mean average precision of 64.08% compared to 60.22% for the conditional CNN, 52.11% for a baseline CNN trained only to predict PVS scores, and 49.32% for the logistic regression model. The multi-task model showed an ability to localise individual PVS not shown by the other CNNs, and behaved in a probabilistically sensible way, predicting with lower confidence on inherently harder classes. Age, sex, hypertension status, white matter hyperintensity volume, and ischaemic stroke lesion status were shown to be associated with the multi-task model's PVS score predictions and the ground truth in a similar way.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用核磁共振系统自动分级扩大的血管外空间负担的多任务学习
articles.content_zh: 在脑磁共振成像(MRI)中可见的被扩大的通心血管空间(PVS)越来越被认为与脑健康不良有关. PVS为直径小于3毫米的延长结构,可以有多个. 为了反映PVS的发病情况,放射科医生根据临床分级标准对其负担进行视评,这项工作将受益于自动化,以加快分析和克服观测者之间差异的影响。 我们制定并评估了培训机器学习模型的方法,以利用波特斯/沃德瓦夫尺度,在玄武纪地块(BG)和半地块(CSO)中计分PVS发生率。 我们作品中的新颖之处在于在训练期间除了使用PVS放射性分数之外,还使用了不完善的,半自动生成的"银-标准"PVS分化口罩. 我们比较评价了一个有条件的神经元网络(CNN),它接受PVS口罩作为额外的输入通道,一个多任务CNN,它既进行PVS分和分分,又利用PVS口罩的特性预测PVS分数的后勤回归模型. 多任务学习是最有效的方法,实现平均精度64.08%,而有条件的CNN为60.22%,基线CNN仅为预测PVS分数而训练的52.11%,物流回归模型为49.32%。 多任务模式显示能够将其他有线电视新闻网没有显示的单个PVS本地化,并以概率合理的方式行事,对内在更困难的类的预测信心更低. 年龄,性别,高血压状态,白物质超强度体积,以及缺血性中风损伤状况被证明与多任务模型的PVS分数预测和地面真实性有类似关系.

articles.title: Anatomy-Aware Prediction of Bronchoscopic Accessibility from 3D CT
articles.content: Pre-operative planning for bronchoscopy is critical for the diagnosis of lung lesions. Current accessibility assessment relies on subjective manual inspection of CT scans, which is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. In this paper, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a novel supervised learning task and present the first end-to-end framework to address it. We propose an Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that integrates specialized modules: a CT Expert for local morphological features, a Lobe Expert for anatomical priors, and a Path Geometry Expert that encodes the sequential constraints of the bronchial tree. To support this task, we curated the first clinical dataset of 438 cases with pre-operative CT scans and documented procedural outcomes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.8052, significantly outperforming both state-of-the-art baselines and experienced human experts. This work establishes a new benchmark for computer-aided interventional planning in pulmonary medicine. Our data and code will be publicly available at https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从3D CT获取的 Bronchocographic 解剖学- 智能预测
articles.content_zh: 支气管镜检查手术前规划对于肺损伤诊断至关重要. 目前的无障碍评估依赖于对CT扫描的主观人工检查,这种检查很花时间,容易被观测器间可变性所影响. 在本文中,我们正式将支气管镜学无障碍预测作为一项由小说监督的学习任务,并提出了第一个解决这一问题的端到端框架. 我们提出一个解剖学-人工智能混合实验(MoE)模型,该模型融合了专门的模块:一个CT本地形态特征专家,一个Lobe解剖学前科专家,和一个路径几何专家,该模型编码了支气管树的相继约束. 为了支持这一任务,我们整理了第一个438个病例的临床数据集,其中包含手术前的CT扫描和记录的程序结果. 实验结果表明,我们的方法实现的AUROC为0.8052,大大超过了最新基线和经验丰富的人类专家。 这项工作为计算机辅助的肺医学干预规划确定了新的基准。 我们的数据和代码将在https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/上公布。

articles.title: Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models
articles.content: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Do-JEPA:从化妆到干预后期世界模式
articles.content_zh: 后世的模型被训练来预测接下来会发生什么, 所以在它们的目标中,没有任何东西能将一个行为与它仅仅共同发生的行为区分开来。 C-JEPA等制造物体的模型介入预测者所看到的事物;我们介入实际发生的事情。 从一个保存的模拟状态中,我们用$a$和$a_{\varulty}$来运行动态,并训练模型来预测两个潜在未来之间的差额$Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varulty}}$. 由此产生的目标Do-JEPA具有影响损失、支持损失(在行动进入的地方)、传播损失(在影响蔓延的地方)和变化性损失(不得改变)。 在一个具有对象相通变量的合成系统中,支持监督在99.95%的试验案例中发现了直接干预对象,其中一个稀有的动作口罩将动作传送到每个案例中的扰动槽上,响应-设定监督恢复了环形传播图(对接AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). 从像素上看,效应损失比完全相同数据所训练的控件要低:当对自然动作序列进行训练和测试时,在LeWM模型上的潜在效应误差和物理效应误差降低28.4%;在三个独立生成的CausalWorld基准上,在物理变化下,在反应效应误差降低约20%,预测效应的潜在上下文敏感度降低66%。 从零开始就加以训练,这就需要实际准确性;用它来调整现有模型就可以消除这一费用。 这些结果表明,干预世界而不是模型所看到的,有助于潜在世界模型预测其行动的原因。

articles.title: MG-Thinker: Bi-Axial Self-Reflection for Multi-Image Reasoning Grounding
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently delivered substantial gains in multimodal reasoning, opening a promising route for fine-grained visual perception. Yet for multi-image reasoning grounding (MRG), reasoning over real-world multi-image contexts toward pixel-precise localization, existing RL-based approaches overlook two characteristics intrinsic to this paradigm: a coarse-to-fine hierarchical reasoning pattern, and heterogeneously distributed task--sample difficulties. In this work, we present MG-Thinker, a post-training RL framework that advances a new MRG paradigm featuring such hierarchical reasoning, supported by a curated 25K MRG dataset with task-adaptive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotations that elicit multi-perspective evidence before conclusion. To remedy the heterogeneous task--sample difficulties, we further propose Bi-Axial DAPO (BiA-DAPO), which decomposes rollout advantages along an intra-group signal axis and an inter-group competence axis through two complementary mechanisms, both grounded on our defined candidate pool for stable group-level statistics. Extensive experiments show that MG-Thinker achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-image reasoning grounding while consistently improving generalization across multi-image understanding and diverse multimodal benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MG-Thinker:双轴自反射多图像理性地取地
articles.content_zh: 加强学习(RL)最近在多式推理方面取得了巨大收益,为精细的视觉感知开辟了一条很有希望的道路。 然而,对于多图像推理(MRG),相对于现实世界的多图像背景,向像素精准本地化的推理,现有的基于RL的方法忽略了这个范式所固有的两个特征:从粗到细的分级推理模式,以及不同分布的任务-实例困难。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了MG-Thinker,这是一个培训后RL框架,它提出了一种新的MRG范式,以这种等级推理为特征,辅以一套25K MRG 数据集,其中附有任务适应性思维链(COT)说明,在结论前引出多视角证据。 为了解决各种任务实例方面的困难,我们进一步提议双Axial DAPO(Bia-DAPO),通过两个互补机制,将分组内信号轴和分组间能力轴的推出优势分解,两者都以我们为稳定分组一级统计确定的候选人才库为基础。 广泛的实验表明,MG-Thinker在多图像推理的基础上实现了最先进的性能,同时不断改进跨多图像理解和多种多模式基准的通俗化。

articles.title: Think Before You Score: Thinking Reward Model for Visual Generation
articles.content: Visual reward models are essential for evaluating and improving visual generation models, yet existing approaches typically map task conditions and candidate outputs directly to scalar rewards, leaving implicit what should be evaluated for each individual case. We introduce Think Before You Score, a paradigm that explicitly determines what matters for each case before judging how well the candidate performs. Following this principle, we propose the Thinking Reward Model (TRM), which formulates case-adaptive rubrics, performs rubric-guided assessment, and produces fine-grained pointwise rewards. We further observe that conventional pairwise preference optimization can induce score polarization, and introduce Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization (PD-GRPO), which leverages pairwise supervision to improve reward discrimination while preserving fine-grained pointwise scoring. Extensive experiments on image generation and editing reward-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that TRM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source reward models while remaining highly competitive with proprietary alternatives. Moreover, using TRM as a reward for reinforcement learning consistently improves diverse visual generation models, demonstrating that its fine-grained, case-adaptive rewards translate into effective optimization signals for visual generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在你得分之前思考:为视觉世代思考奖励模式
articles.content_zh: 视觉奖励模式对评价和改进视觉生成模式至关重要,但现有办法通常直接为衡量奖励而绘制任务条件和候选人产出图,从而隐含着对每个案例应进行评估的内容。 我们引入了“先思考你得分”的范式,这个范式在判断候选人表现如何之前,明确决定了每个案件的重要性。 遵循这一原则,我们提出 " 思考奖励模式 " (TRM),该模式制定适应案例的分词,进行有分寸的指导评估,并产生精细的分寸奖励。 我们进一步注意到,传统的对等偏好优化可诱发分数分化,并引入对等双组相对政策优化(PD-GRPO),利用对等监管来改善奖励歧视,同时保留精细分数。 关于图像生成和编辑奖励模式基准的广泛实验表明,TRM在开源奖励模式中实现了最先进的业绩,同时与专有替代品保持高度竞争。 此外,使用TRM作为强化学习的奖励,不断改进了多种视觉生成模型,表明其精细的,可适应案例的奖励转化为视觉生成的有效优化信号.

articles.title: Visual Anomaly Synthesis for Model Selection in Data Scarcity
articles.content: Defect detection systems for industrial condition monitoring can only be relied upon if they are validated, yet defective samples are rare and, for a specific asset, often nonexistent. We present a framework that synthesizes severity-graded defects on real non-defective images without any defect references for the target asset, that can be used for model selection and validation. A defect taxonomy for common failure modes is distilled from literature into prescriptive prompts at varying defect severities. Regions of interest are cropped from in defect-free images and edited with a pre-trained image generation model ("FLUX.2 [klein]"). Color-matching and blending are employed to improve structural coherence with the original image. Generations are filtered out by a scorer and by estimated detection difficulty. Model selection experiments on MVTecAD show image AUROC choice regret over model selection can be nearly halved compared to the best fixed model chosen with access to test data. Experiments show the need for severity-graded anomaly synthesis. A case study investigates the proposed method for in-situ monitoring of Pelton turbine runners in hydropower, where real defect images are rare and expensive to collect. A PatchCorebased anomaly detection model is fit on Pelton turbine images and selected and validated using synthetic images, showing strong detection performance (94 % correct detection at optimal threshold and AUROC 0.97). The model reliably detects moderate and advanced defects, while early-stage defects remain challenging, indicating the synthetic data meaningfully stresses detector sensitivity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 数据稀缺中用于模型选择的视觉异常合成
articles.content_zh: 工业条件监测的缺陷检测系统只有经过验证后才能依赖,但缺陷样品很少,而且就特定资产而言,往往不存在。 我们提出一个框架,在真实的非缺陷图像上合成严重分级的缺陷,而不为目标资产提供任何缺陷参考,可用于模型选择和验证. 常见故障模式的缺陷分类法从文献中分解出来,在不同缺陷断裂时被分解成指令性提示. 感兴趣的区域是从没有缺陷的图像中裁剪而来,并用经过预先训练的图像生成模型("FLUX.2 [klein]")来编辑. 采用相色相色相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 代数被计分器和估计的检测困难过滤出. MVTecAD上的模型选择实验显示图像 AUROC 选择对模型选择的遗憾,与选择的获得测试数据的最佳固定模型相比,可以几乎减半. 实验显示需要进行重度分级异常合成. 一项案例研究调查了对水力发电中的Pelton涡轮跑跑道进行现场监测的拟议方法,在水力发电中,真实的缺陷图像很少,收集费用也很高。 基于补丁Core的异常探测模型被安装在佩尔顿涡轮机图像上,并使用合成图像进行选择和验证,显示强探测性能(在最佳阈值下正确探测率为94%,AUROC为0.97). 该模型可靠地检测出中度和高级缺陷,而早期缺陷仍然具有挑战性,表明合成数据有意义地强调探测器的敏感性.

articles.title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
articles.content: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them, and the frozen programs outperform the strongest prior agentic system run with the same language model (96.3% against 89.3%). On RoboDojo tasks whose instructions leave the goal unstated, no program succeeds without demonstrations. ENCORE also runs on a real bimanual robot, learning cube handover and cup inversion from five demonstrations each.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Encore:操纵策略的少有热剂发现
articles.content_zh: 编码代理现在可以在很少的人力帮助下编写,运行并调试程序. 然而,机器人任务通常通过一个句子来指定,该句子将如何抓住,如何进行接触,结果应该是什么样子,一个只给出句子的特工必须通过试想和错误找到这些细节. 我们介绍ENCORE,它让特工们进行一些示范,作为阅读而不是培训数据的证据。 一个决定性的构建器将每个演示分馏成一组多视图键框,抓取事件,帧条,以及全轨. 一个编码代理研究包,写一个针对固定感知和动作API的政策程序,在几个开发推出时反复地加以完善,并在从未显示成功信号的密封评价前将其冻结. 在LIBERO-PRO上,代理的首个程序已经成功完成了一半的扰动任务和一项没有演示的任务,被冻结的程序比使用同一种语言模型运行的最强的前代理系统(96.3%对89.3%)运行得更好. 在RoboDojo任务中,如果指令未说明目标,则没有演示程序成功。 ENCORE还运行在一款真正的双人机器人上,学习了立方体交接和杯子倒置,每次5个演示.

articles.title: PCaPaint: Prostate Cancer Inpainting by Mitigating Shortcut Learning
articles.content: The development of AI systems for tumor-specific applications is limited by the scarcity of labeled data. Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach but faces challenges for prostate cancer MRI which contains high-resolution multi-sequence data. Although methods leveraging latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable large-volume synthesis, they are prone to shortcut learning, simply reproducing the condition image created by masking the lesion region. In this work, we introduce PCaPaint, a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that explicitly addresses this failure mode. To overcome shortcut learning that compromises synthetic tumor texture, we propose a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy in which the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise, and we provide theoretical justification.
