In addition, we propose a novel training objective for LDM that emphasizes the error within the lesion region. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the generated synthetic data improves downstream performance in prostate lesion segmentation, patient-level classification and lesion-level detection. Furthermore, our method significantly outperforms a recent state-of-the-art LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PCaPaint:通过减速快捷键学习进行前列腺癌涂装
articles.content_zh: 肿瘤特有应用的AI系统的开发受到标签数据稀缺的限制. 合成肿瘤涂片提供了一个很有希望的方法,但前列腺癌核磁共振面临着挑战,其中包含高分辨率多序列数据。 虽然利用潜在扩散模型(LDMs)的方法可以进行大容量的合成,但它们容易被快捷学习,只是复制由掩盖损伤区域所创造的条件图像。 在这部作品中,我们引入了PCaPaint,一种以LDMs为基础的前列腺癌涂层方法,明确解决了这种故障模式. 为了克服妨碍合成肿瘤纹理的捷径学习,我们提出了一个简单而高效的调节策略,在这种策略中,条件图像充满了高斯噪音,我们提供了理论理由. 此外,我们提出了LDM的新的培训目标,强调损伤区域内部的错误. 此外,我们引入了多序列潜伏设计,其中T2w扫描和DWI&ADC扫描使用两个独立的自编码器进行压缩,以保持其独特的频率特性. 广泛的实验表明,所生成的合成数据改善了前列腺损伤分解、患者一级分类和损伤一级检测的下游性能。 此外,在下游的性能和合成图像质量方面,我们的方法大大超过了最近最先进的基于LDM的肿瘤涂料方法。

articles.title: TAEC: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination for Multi-Step Visual RAG
articles.content: Multi-step visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers complex questions by repeatedly retrieving visual evidence, updating an intermediate state, and deciding whether to continue searching or answer. Yet retrieving relevant evidence does not ensure its effective use throughout the reasoning trajectory. As multi-step reasoning progresses, redundant sources occupy context capacity needed for missing evidence, observations tied to resolved requirements or unproductive searches linger in context, and visual sources are revisited with insufficient detail for fine-grained reading. We term this loss of usable evidence over a reasoning trajectory trajectory-level evidence utilization degradation. To address it, we propose Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC), a training-free framework that coordinates evidence use around unresolved answer requirements. TAEC tracks these requirements in a shared trajectory state to guide which evidence enters the context, how accumulated memory is retained, and at what level of detail visual evidence is examined. Under a unified evaluation protocol on ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and MMLongBench-Doc, TAEC achieves the best overall performance against leading training-free visual RAG baselines, with the highest average accuracy across multiple proprietary vision-language models. These results demonstrate that aligning evidence with evolving reasoning needs improves evidence use throughout multi-step visual RAG.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TAEC:多步骤视觉RAG的轨迹-智能证据协调
articles.content_zh: 多步可视取回-增强生成(RAG)通过反复取回可视取出的证据,更新中间状态,以及决定是否继续搜索或回答来解答复杂的问题. 然而,检索相关证据并不能确保在整个推理过程中有效使用证据。 随着多步骤推理的进展,冗余来源占用了缺失证据所需的上下文能力,观察与已解决的要求挂钩,或者在上下文中无益地搜索;视觉来源被重新审视,但细节不够细微地阅读. 我们把这种可用证据的丧失称为推理轨迹水平的证据利用率下降。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议进行轨迹-了解证据协调(TAEC),这是一个无培训框架,它围绕尚未解决的答案要求协调证据的使用。 TAEC在共同的轨迹状态下跟踪这些要求,以指导哪些证据进入上下文,如何保留所积累的内存,以及在何种详细程度审查可视证据. 在ViDoSeek,SlidVQA,和MMLong Bench-Doc的统一评价协议下,TAEC相对于领先的无培训视觉RAG基线,实现了最佳的整体性能,在多个专有视觉语言模型中平均精度最高. 这些结果显示,使证据与不断发展的推理需求相一致,可以改进整个多步骤视觉RAG的证据使用.

articles.title: When to Retrieve, When to Stay: Uncertainty-Aware Temporal Evidence Allocation for Streaming Video-LLMs
articles.content: Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints. As the visual history grows, a bounded visual?processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance. Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous. We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation. A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty. WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty. Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM. Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench. In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method. Code will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 何时获取,何时停留:用于流取视频-LLMs的不确定-了解时间证据分配
articles.content_zh: 流取视频理解需要Video-LLMs(Video-LLMS)在因果限制下对连续的视觉流进行推理. 随着视觉历史的发展,一个有界限的视觉? 处理预算需要选择证据,以平衡时间调整与查询的相关性。 仅以最近为主的选择排除了潜在的相关历史证据,而仅以语义为主的检索可以在相关分数模糊的情况下取代有用的近期上下文. 我们引入WRWS(何时收回,何时留下),这是用于不确定性适应性证据分配的无培训框架. 一个轻量级外视-语言编码器的分数查询整个被观测历史的关联性,而一个适应性分配模块则使用相似性分布的常态化的 en来代替回取不确定性. WRWS 倾向于在关联提示可靠时进行语义检索,并在不确定的情况下加强之前的适中性. 在进行回取第一,编码后再进行管道处理后,WRWS在目标模型可视编码之前选择证据,这样只有所选择的观测数据才被昂贵的目标Video-LLM处理. 跨越四个视频-LLM家族和多个模型尺度的实验显示,在Streaming Bench和OVO-Bench上有竞争力的精度. 在我们的效率评估中,WRWS将平均视向回答时间减少到了最先进的方法的47.93%. 代码将发布。

articles.title: HyperSAM: A Promptable Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
articles.content: Hyperspectral remote sensing provides dense spectral measurements that are indispensable for material-level Earth observation, yet the construction of a general-purpose hyperspectral foundation model remains difficult. Two bottlenecks are especially limiting. First, large hyperspectral corpora rarely provide high spatial resolution together with reliable dense annotations. Second, many hyperspectral models are still trained almost from scratch, so the geometric and interactive priors learned by modern vision foundation models are not fully reused. To alleviate these issues, we \highlight{present} \textbf{HyperSAM}, a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that couples a data-centric hyperspectral synthesis pipeline with a spectral adaptation architecture based on Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). On the data side, HyperSAM synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution SpaceNet multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer generator, while SAM3-derived pseudo-masks provide object-centric supervision. On the model side, the latest implementation uses a frozen SAM3 RGB image branch, a trainable hyperspectral side encoder initialized from the RGB vision transformer (ViT), ControlNet-style zero-initialized feature injection, and a lightweight mixture-of-experts mask refiner. To enhance training robustness against noisy pseudo-labels, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS)-style confidence selection is incorporated for noisy-label weighting. Extensive experiments show that HyperSAM obtains strong generalization on diverse hyperspectral tasks (e.g., classification, anomaly detection, change detection, target detection, and airborne oil-spill mapping) and that high-quality synthetic hyperspectral data can be more effective than simply scaling noisy hyperspectral supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HyperSAM:超光谱快速基础模型 遥感
articles.content_zh: 超光谱遥感提供了密集光谱测量,对材料层面的地球观测是必不可少的,然而,建立通用高光谱基础模型仍然很困难。 两个瓶颈尤其有限。 首先,大型高光谱子公司很少提供高空间分辨度和可靠的稠密说明. 其次,许多超光谱模型几乎还是从零开始训练,因此现代视觉基础模型所学出的各种几何学和交互前科并没有被完全再用. 为了缓解这些问题,我们\要亮出{现在}\textbf{HyperSAM},一个快速的超光谱基础模型,将一个以数据为中心的超光谱合成管道与光谱适应结构结合在一起,基于Section Anything Model 3(SAM3). 在数据方面,HyperSAM通过物理学知情的丰度-转移发生器从高分辨率SpaceNet多光谱成像中合成出全光谱超光谱立方体,而SAM3衍生出以物体为中心进行监视. 在模型方面,最新的实施使用被冻结的SAM3 RGB图像分支,从RGB视觉变压器(ViT)初始化的可被训练的超光谱侧编码器,ControlNet-style-0-初始化特性注射,以及轻量级的混合专家面具精密器. 为提高培训力度,防止高声伪标签,采用了跨模式样本选择(CromSS)式的信心选择,用于高声标签加权。 广泛的实验表明,HyperSAM在多样的超光谱任务(如分类,异常检测,变化检测,目标检测,和空中溢出出出出油的绘图)上获得了强烈的概括性,高质量的合成高光谱数据可以比简单的缩放高光谱监督更有效.

articles.title: UGO: Unified Architecture for General Multi-Object Tracking by Segmentation
articles.content: General multi-object tracking (GMOT) tracks all instances of a user-specified category from a single first-frame exemplar. Prior work relies on bounding boxes and surrogate training, and struggles with non-rigid objects, crowded scenes, and distractors. We introduce UGO, a unified GMOT tracker that pairs a pretrained exemplar-conditioned detection head with an instance-propagation head in a common architecture. A novel training-free, energy-minimization consolidation method converts overlapping proposals into exclusive pixel-wise masks and detections, resolving over-segmentation, duplicates, and conflicts. A hierarchical memory spanning global and instance levels improves recall and per-instance segmentation accuracy using a new memory management protocol. UGO sets a new state-of-the-art on GMOT benchmarks and video object counting, and is competitive with specialist MOT methods, establishing a strong paradigm for unified, open-category multi-object tracking.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UGO: 分块跟踪一般多目标的统一结构
articles.content_zh: 普通多对象跟踪(GMOT)从单个一帧实例中跟踪用户指定类别的所有实例. 之前的工作依赖于边框和代孕训练,与非刚性物体,拥挤的场景和分心者相搏. 我们引入了UGO,一个统一的GMOT跟踪器,它将一个预先训练的模具条件检测头与一个实例传播头在共同的架构中相配. 一种新的无能、能最小化的整合方法,将重叠的提案转换成独有的像素般的口罩和检测,解决过分分化、重复和冲突。 跨越全球和实例层次的分级内存利用新的内存管理协议,提高了召回和分级的准确性。 UGO为GMOT基准和视频对象计数设定了新的最先进的技术,并且与专业的MOT方法具有竞争力,为统一,开放的多对象跟踪建立了强大的范式.

articles.title: OFBD: Object-Focused Background Debiasing for Long-Tailed Learning
articles.content: Balancing performance trade-offs on long-tailed data distributions remains a long-standing challenge in visual recognition. Existing methods mainly improve tail classes through re-balancing, representation learning, or data augmentation, but the underlying cause of tail class degradation is still insufficiently explored. In this paper, we find that standard long-tailed training induces background-biased representation and optimization: tail classes suffer larger background distribution shifts and become increasingly driven by background gradients. This reveals that tail degradation is not merely caused by insufficient samples, but also by the learning of irrelevant background features. To tackle this issue, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a framework that mitigates background bias from both distribution and optimization perspectives. Specifically, Foreground-guided CutMix preserves target-related foregrounds while diversifying complementary backgrounds, and Background-guided Feature Rectification suppresses background-biased features without learnable parameters or additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method improves overall accuracy, achieves significant tail-class gains, and can serve as a plug-in for mainstream long-tailed methods without external data or pretrained recognition models. The code is available at: https://ofbd-neurips2026-longtail-learning.github.io/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OFBD: 用于长期学习的指定对象背景Debiasing
articles.content_zh: 在长尾数据分布上平衡性能取舍,仍然是视觉识别方面长期存在的挑战. 现有方法主要通过再平衡,表现学习,或数据增强来改进尾巴类,但尾巴类退化的根本原因仍未得到充分的探索. 在本文中,我们发现标准长尾训练诱发了背景偏颇的表述和优化:尾班经历更大的背景分布变化并日益被背景梯度所驱动. 这揭示出尾巴退化不仅是由样本不足所引起,也是由学习不相干的背景特征所引起. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用有目标背景的Debiasing(OFBD),这个框架从分布和优化的角度减轻背景偏差。 具体地说,前地导CutMix保留了与目标相关的前地,同时使互补背景多样化,而后地导地物校正压制了背景偏重的特征,而没有可学习的参数或额外的培训. 广泛的实验显示,我们的方法可以提高整体准确性,实现重大的尾等增益,并且可以充当主流长尾方法的插件,而无需外部数据或预先训练的识别模型. 该守则可在以下网站查阅:https://ofbd-neurips2026-长尾-学习.github.io/

articles.title: The Domain Is a Residue: Adapting Self-Supervised Features, Not Generators
articles.content: Clearing fog, rain or snow from footage, or turning renders into photographs, must remove the source domain and keep the scene. Unpaired translators carry it through because their generator sees the source appearance (pixels, a near-invertible latent or a control map) and keeps it. A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style as a residue of 13 to 14% of the feature norm. We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9M-parameter network that moves this residue. We train only the adapter and its discriminators; the encoder and a feature-conditioned decoder, trained once for all conditions, stay frozen. Against CycleGAN-Turbo it is ahead on both metrics on fog and on KID on night, and level within noise on snow, rain and haze. On sim-to-real it leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on both metrics. Only the RFA removes the rain while keeping the scene. The removal costs scene structure: CycleGAN-Turbo keeps more on every condition but fog. On VAE latents the identical adapter collapses to the identity, and decoders from other groups that never saw it render its output. The RFA has about 160 times fewer trainable parameters than CycleGAN-Turbo and under a fifth of its per-condition training time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 域是残留物:适应自我监督的地物,而不是发电机
articles.content_zh: 清除相片中的雾、雨或雪,或变成相片,必须去掉源域并保留现场。 未发音的翻译员通过它,因为他们的生成器看到源的外观(像素,一近不可逆的潜伏或控制图)并保存. 一张DINO特征图修正了现场的内容,并携带了天气,照明和渲染风格作为特征规范的13%至14%的残留. 我们提议使用“代表特性适应器”,即移动这种残留物的2.9M参数网络。 我们只训练适配器及其歧视者; 编码器和有特征条件的解码器, 训练一次所有条件, 保持冻结。 对CycleGAN-Turbo来说,在雾上和KID上都领先,在雪地、雨地和雾地上都处于噪音中。 它在两个度量衡上都领先REGEN和HyPER-GAN。 只有RFA在保留场景的同时去除雨量. 移除成本场景结构:CycleGAN-Turbo在除雾外的每一个条件上都保持较多. 在 VAE 上, 相同的适配器会崩溃到身份, 解码器来自其他组, RFA的可训练参数比CycleGAN-Turbo少了大约160倍,低于其每条件训练时间的五分之一.

articles.title: What Comes Next? Omni-StoryBench for Evaluating Story-Grounded Omnimodal Generation
articles.content: Omnimodal evaluation should go beyond independent text, image, and speech production: individually plausible outputs may not express a coherent shared event. We introduce Omni-StoryBench, a story-grounded omnimodal benchmark evaluating whether models can coherently continue stories across image, narration, and speech. Each instance provides a current storybook page and structured next-page conditions, requiring models to generate the next illustration, narration, and spoken character utterance. Omni-StoryBench contains 900 rigorously validated story transitions from openly licensed children's books, with ground-truth next-page references and speech metadata. We evaluate systems with modality-specific metrics and consistency-centered LLM-as-a-judge rubrics for context preservation, condition following, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence. Across 32 baseline configurations spanning orchestration, semi-orchestration, and native any-to-any paradigms, we find orchestration with strong VLM planning most reliable, while current native omnimodal models often struggle with output completeness and controllability. Our analysis shows text-side performance is associated with image and speech quality, but image generation and visual continuity form the clearest observed bottleneck among the evaluated configurations. These results position Omni-StoryBench as a system-level benchmark measuring coherent omnimodal generation beyond isolated modality quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 接下来是什么? 用于评价故事全方位的Omni-Story Bench 模式生成
articles.content_zh: 模拟评价应超越独立的文本、图像和语音制作:个别可信的产出可能无法表达一致的共享活动。 我们介绍Omni-Story Bench, 一个基于故事的全方位基准, 每个实例都提供了一个当前的故事书页和结构化的下页条件,需要模型生成下个插图,叙述,和口语字符表达. 《Omni-Story Bench》载有900个经过严格验证的故事,从公开许可的儿童书籍中转换出来,并附有下页的地真相参考资料和语音元数据。 我们用特定模式的衡量尺度和以一致性为中心的LLM-as-a-judged special specials来评价各种系统,以维护环境、遵循条件、参考一致性和跨模式一致性。 在32个涵盖管弦乐、半管弦乐和本土任意模式的基线配置中,我们发现管弦乐与强大的VLM规划最为可靠,而目前的本土自制自制模式往往与输出完整性和可控性相冲突。 我们的分析显示文本侧面的性能与图像和语音质量有关,但图像生成和视觉连续性在被评价的配置中构成了最明显的被观察到的瓶颈. 这些结果将Omni-Story Bench定位为衡量超出孤立模式质量的连贯自来模式生成的系统级基准.

articles.title: FLASH: A "Generate Once, Synthesize Many" Framework for Synthetic Anomaly Generation in Industrial Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Synthetic anomaly generation helps expand industrial anomaly datasets when real defects are scarce or unavailable. Existing approaches lie at two extremes: procedural approaches are fast but struggle to represent complex anomalies, while generative approaches produce diverse defects but require costly per-sample generation. We present FLASH, a framework that decouples defect generation from anomaly synthesis under a ``generate once, synthesize many'' paradigm. Given only normal images, FLASH uses Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance and an image-generation model to produce a small set of defect images, from which it extracts, validates, and banks reusable defect patches. For synthesis of anomalous images, Object Boundary Suppression (OBS) first identifies the probable foreground object-aware region of the host image, while Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid (MRSP) noise generates diverse, size-controllable masks that determine the defect location and spatial extent. It then composes a large and diverse synthetic anomalous image set by localizing the defect region, sampling size-controllable placement masks and seamlessly blending retrieved defects onto new defect-free images without further need for image generation. Experiments on the MVTec AD 2 dataset show that FLASH-generated anomalies nearly close the calibration gap on real defects, reaching 78.1% image-level F1 against an 83.6% real-anomaly upper bound and providing the most consistent calibration transfer across detectors among procedural and generative alternatives. Moreover, FLASH synthesizes anomalies more than 11.95x faster than per-sample generative approaches.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FLASH:在工业异常检测中合成异常生成的“基因一次,合成众多”框架
articles.content_zh: 当真正的缺陷稀缺或不存在时,合成异常生成有助于扩展工业异常数据集. 现有办法有两个极端:程序性办法速度快,但难以代表复杂的异常情况,而遗传办法则产生不同的缺陷,但需要花费昂贵的每个样本生成。 我们提出FLASH, 一种框架 脱钩生成 异常合成 在"基因组一次, 合成许多'范式。 仅考虑到正常图像,FLASH使用Vision-Language Model(VLM)指向和图像生成模型来制作出一套小的缺陷图像,从中提取,验证,并存可再用的缺陷补丁. 对于反常图像的合成,对象边界压制(OBS)首先识别出主机图像可能的前地物体感知区域,而多分辨率光谱金字塔(MRSP)噪声则会产生多样,大小可控的口罩来决定缺陷位置和空间范围. 然后,它通过将缺陷区域本地化、取样大小可控放置口罩以及无缝地将收回的缺陷混合到新的缺陷无缺陷图像上,从而构成一个大而多样的合成异常图像。 MVTec AD 2数据集的实验显示,FLASH产生的异常现象几乎缩小了真实缺陷的校正差距,在真实异常的83.6%的上限中,图像级F1达到了78.1%,并在程序和基因替代物之间提供了最一致的校正转移. 此外,FLASH合成的异常量超过11.95x,快于每样基因方法.

articles.title: Technical note on: Zero-Training Feature-Space Alignment via Information Geometry
articles.content: Deep vision models often degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation can improve robustness but typically requires iterative optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and multiple forward-backward passes. We propose Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA), a closed-form method that improves robustness under covariate shift without modifying model parameters. ZFGA is based on the observation that distribution shifts distort feature-space geometry. It estimates the Fisher information matrix of the predictive distribution with respect to feature embeddings and applies a linear transformation that aligns test-feature Fisher geometry with a reference geometry computed from clean data. This provides a natural-gradient-inspired preconditioning step in feature space. We evaluate ZFGA on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C using ResNet-50, DINO ViT-S/16, and CLIP ViT-B/32. ZFGA consistently improves over zero-shot inference across all three models, although it is not the strongest method for every model. Covariance whitening performs better on ResNet-50, while Fisher whitening is statistically indistinguishable from ZFGA on CLIP. Across six training-free and gradient-based alternatives (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, and AdaNPC), ZFGA is the only method that does not substantially harm any of the three model families. The Fisher geometry distortion is also positively correlated with ZFGA gain (Pearson r = 0.366, p = 0.017), providing preliminary evidence that geometric misalignment contributes to robustness degradation. ZFGA requires only forward passes and matrix operations at inference time, offering a lightweight and deterministic alternative to optimization-based test-time adaptation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 技术说明:通过信息几何实现零地貌-空间对接
articles.content_zh: 深视模型在分配转变时往往会退化. 试验时间适应可以提高稳健性,但一般需要迭代优化,超参数调和,并需要多次向后退行. 我们提出零训练费舍尔几何对接(ZFGA),这是一种封闭式方法,在同变相移下能提高稳健性而无需修改模型参数. ZFGA是基于分布移扭曲地物-空间几何的观测结果. 它估计关于地物嵌入的预测分布的Fisher信息矩阵,并采用线性转变,使测试地貌Fisher几何与从干净数据计算出来的参考几何相统一。 这在地物空间中提供了一种自然梯度受启发的前提条件步骤。 我们利用ResNet-50、DINO ViT-S/16和CLIP ViT-B/32. ZFGA对所有三种模型的零射入推论不断改进,虽然它并不是每个模型最强的方法. 在ResNet-50上,共变白化表现较好,而从统计学上看,费舍尔白化与CLIP上的ZFGA是无法区分的. 在所有6种无培训的和以梯度为基础的替代品(共变白化、费舍尔白化、TENT、T3A、LAME和AdaNPC)中,ZFGA是唯一不会对三个模范家庭中任何一个产生实质性伤害的方法。 费舍尔几何扭曲也与ZFGA增益(Pearson r = 0.366,p = 0.017)呈正相关关系,初步证明几何错位会导致强性降解. ZFGA只在推断时间需要前行通行证和矩阵操作,提供轻量级和决定性的替代优化测试时间适应方法.

articles.title: Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers
articles.content: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across multiple benchmarks, including ImageNet, T-FCP enables practical full-conformal image classification with modest test-time overhead, yielding efficient prediction sets and more stable empirical coverage than split conformal alternatives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 缩放全相通图像分类符
articles.content_zh: 相通的预测提供了设定值的预测,并提供了无分布覆盖的保证,使其对高取景图像分类具有吸引力. 然而,分位一致预测缺乏数据效率,而完全一致预测(FCP)尽管其统计效率更强,但在计算上在规模上却令人望而却步,因为它要求在测试时对具体候选人的模型进行调整。 我们利用零发视觉语言模型(VLMs),在大标签空间中引导可伸缩的FCP,以此来应对这一限制. 我们引入了定向全形式预测(T-FCP),它使用轻量级导线导线预测器来prune不可能的标签,并且只对其余候选人适用FCP,减少了计算,同时保留了综合通线程序的正式保证. 我们进一步提出稳定在线LDA(SO-LDA),这是一个基于一级反相变速更新的高效VLM适应解决方案. 通过包括ImageNet在内的多种基准,T-FCP能够进行实用的全形式图像分类,同时进行适度的测试时间管理,产生高效的预测集,比分形相容替代品更稳定的经验覆盖。

articles.title: Why Cross-Skeleton Retargeting Is Non-Identifiable: Structural Limits of Generative Motion Models
articles.content: Cross-skeleton motion generation trains generative models to carry action structure and motion intention from one body to another. Yet a target motion that shows the right action has two explanations that the training data cannot tell apart: the model transferred the source clip, or it recovered a typical motion for the requested action. We show that this ambiguity is structural rather than incidental: under standard generative objectives, the source-conditioned retargeting map is non-identifiable in sparse heterogeneous motion domains. Unpaired distribution matching yields gauge non-identifiability: the latent spaces of different skeletons can be transformed relative to one another without changing the training evidence, so different source-conditioned maps fit it equally well. Sparse paired supervision admits the complementary failure mode, \emph{conditional-mean degeneration}: when clips are paired only by action, squared-error training converges to an average target motion that ignores the source clip. To make the missing evidence observable, we introduce Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF), a diagnostic that tests whether outputs differ from one another the way their source clips do, with the target skeleton and action held fixed. Under this diagnostic, methods that succeed at the standard action-level test on animal motion data often sit at the source-blind floor, while the methods that rise above it retain only a partial relational signal. Retargeting therefore needs objectives and evaluations that can identify the source-conditioned map it claims to learn. Project page: https://cross-skeleton-retargeting.netlify.app/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 为什么是跨斯克勒顿 重新瞄准是无法识别的:基因运动模型的结构限制
articles.content_zh: Cross-Skeleton运动生成会训练出基因模型,将动作结构和运动意向从一个体带到另一个体. 然而,一个显示正确动作的目标运动有两个解释,即训练数据无法区分:模型转移了源片段,或者它恢复了典型的被请求动作的运动. 我们显示,这种模糊性是结构性的,而不是偶然的:在标准基因目标下,来源条件的再瞄准图在稀有的多变运动域中是无法识别的. 未经认证的分布匹配出产量表不可识别性:不同骨架的潜在空间可以在不改变训练证据的情况下相接而成,因此不同源条件的地图同样适合. Sparse配对监督承认了互补的失败模式,\emph{有条件的-mean degeneration}:当片段只被动作配对时,平方-error训练会与一个忽略出源片段的平均目标运动会相会合. 为了让缺失的证据被观察到,我们引入了源-Instance Fieldity(SIF),这个诊断方法测试输出是否彼此不同,其源剪辑的方式,目标骨架和动作固定. 在这种诊断下,在动物运动数据的标准动作级测试中成功的方法往往坐落在源-盲层上,而上方的方法只保留了部分关系信号. 因此,重新确定目标需要能够确定它声称学习的有来源条件的地图的目标和评价。 项目网页:https://cross-skeleton-retarging.netlify.app/.

articles.title: VISTA-Bench: Benchmarking Multilingual Image Translation with Image-Specific Rubrics
articles.content: Image translation is a fundamental capability of multimodal models for multilingual applications, requiring visual understanding and meaning preservation across languages. However, existing benchmarks have limited language coverage and often lack explicit image-specific evaluation criteria, making it difficult to comprehensively assess this capability. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce VISTA-Bench, covering 22 languages and 10 domains, and develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol. The benchmark combines sampling for language and scenario coverage with model-assisted, human-verified annotations that group related text into coherent semantic units and provide multilingual reference translations. The rubrics specify essential content, semantic relations, and acceptable translation variants, yielding separate output-based scores for translation quality and the preservation of visual and knowledge-dependent information. We conduct extensive evaluations of 16 mainstream models, including 12 multimodal models and four text-input models, and provide systematic analyses across languages, domains, and evaluation dimensions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VISTA- Bench:将多种语言图像翻译与图像特定Rubrics设定基准
articles.content_zh: 图像翻译是多语种应用的多模式模式的基本能力,需要视觉理解并意味着跨语言的保存. 然而,现有基准的语言覆盖面有限,往往缺乏针对特定形象的明确评价标准,因此难以全面评估这种能力。 为了系统地评估这一能力,我们引入了VISTA-Bench,涵盖22种语言和10个领域,并制定了针对图像的标点评价协议。 该基准将语言和情景覆盖范围抽样与模型辅助、经人验证的说明相结合,将相关文本分为连贯的语义单元并提供多语种参考翻译。 标题中具体规定了基本内容、语义关系和可接受的翻译变体,为翻译质量和保存视觉和知识依赖信息分别得出了基于产出的分数。 我们广泛评价16个主流模式,包括12个多式联运模式和4个文本输入模式,并提供跨语言、领域和评价层面的系统分析。

articles.title: SAM Meets VLM: Parameter-Decoupled Full-Parameter Training for Unified Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
articles.content: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected not only to answer clinical questions, but also to localize the visual evidence behind their predictions. A common strategy connects a vision--language model (VLM) with SAM-style segmentation through a special <SEG> token, yet full-parameter training of this unified architecture is difficult because image-level reasoning and pixel-level segmentation impose different requirements on the shared representation space. To address this issue, we propose a parameter-decoupled training framework for unified medical reasoning and segmentation. The framework treats the <SEG> hidden state as a semantic-to-spatial prompt for the mask decoder and encourages it to become separable from generic language states, reducing ambiguous segmentation prompts and potential disruption to reasoning representations. It first performs medical shallow alignment to adapt visual features to clinical language without disturbing the LLM; then controlled instruction tuning shapes separable <SEG> prompt states, monitored by the Davies--Bouldin Index (DBI), while scaling segmentation gradients entering the language backbone; finally, the SAM branch is specialized with the VLM frozen to improve mask precision without altering reasoning parameters. Experiments on medical referring segmentation, grounding, visual QA, and textual QA benchmarks show that our framework achieves strong language-conditioned segmentation while preserving competitive reasoning ability. Ablations show that two-phase instruction tuning, gradient scaling, and segmentation specialization all contribute to the model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 萨姆 满足VLM: 参数十进制全参数培训,用于统一医疗原因和分解
articles.content_zh: 医学多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)越来越被期望不仅能够回答临床问题,而且能够将预测背后的视觉证据本地化. 共同战略通过特殊的"SEG"符号将视觉语言模型(VLM)和SAM风格的分块连接起来,然而由于图像级推理和像素级分块对共享代表空间提出了不同的要求,因此这种统一架构的全参数训练是困难的. 为了解决这一问题,我们建议建立一个参数脱钩的培训框架,以便统一医疗推理和分解。 框架将"SEG"隐藏状态视为口罩解码器的语义对空间的快取,并鼓励它与通类语言状态相分离,减少模糊分解的快取和对推理表达的潜在干扰. 它首先进行医学浅接来使视觉特征适应临床语言而不会扰动LLM;然后受控指令调取可分解的"SEG"快取状态,由Davies-Bouldin指数(DBI)监测,同时缩放分化梯度进入语言主干线;最后,SAM分支专门使用VLM被冻结来提高口罩精度而不会改变推理参数. 关于医疗参考分解,地平面,视觉QA和文字QA基准的实验表明,我们的框架在保持竞争性推理能力的同时实现了强大的语言条件分解. 分解表明,两相指令调制,梯度缩放和分化专业化都有助于模型的形成.

articles.title: UniAfford: Token-Routed Multitask Learning for Generalizable 2D-3D Affordance Perception
articles.content: Affordance perception aims to localize actionable regions supporting embodied interaction, yet 2D and 3D affordance grounding have evolved as separate problems, with different task definitions, supervision formats, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This fragmentation limits the learning of transferable object-affordance semantics across visual and geometric spaces. We propose Token Router for Tasks, a multitask training paradigm for MLLM-based systems that routes contextual hidden states to task-specific branches without requiring the language head to generate predefined markers. Routed states are supervised directly by branch-specific objectives, enabling dense prediction losses to shape shared MLLM representations. We instantiate this paradigm as UniAfford, a unified framework for generalizable 2D-3D affordance perception, together with UniAfford-Data, a dataset integrating pixel-level 2D annotations, point-level 3D annotations, and language instructions under a shared object-affordance taxonomy, supporting heterogeneous supervision through semantic-level 2D-3D pairing. UniAfford adopts an MLLM as a shared semantic hub and a modality-aware token router to produce image- and point-cloud-affordance queries. These queries respectively condition a SAM-style pixel decoder and a SONATA-based point decoder, enabling flexible 2D, 3D, and joint affordance inference from image-only, point-cloud-only, or paired multimodal inputs. Experiments demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization across 2D and 3D affordance benchmarks without target-specific fine-tuning, alongside state-of-the-art branch-wise performance under modality-isolated protocols. Ablations validate token routing, joint 2D-3D supervision, and decoder coupling, while language-head diagnostics show that routed latent states carry meaningful object-affordance semantics. Project page: https://4dvlab.github.io/UniAfford
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联合阿福德 : 通用 2D-3D 承受力感知的多任务学习
articles.content_zh: 承受力感想旨在将支持内在互动的可行动区域本地化,然而,2D和3D支付力基础已经发展成为单独的问题,任务定义、监督格式、数据集和评价协议各不相同。 这种分解限制了跨越视觉和几何空间的可转移物体-承受力语义学的学习. 我们提议Token Router for Tasks,即基于 MLLM 的系统的一个多任务培训范式,将背景隐藏状态引导到任务特定分支,而不需要语言头生成预定义的标记. 路由状态由分支特定目标直接监督,使密集的预测损失能够形成共享的MLLM表示. 我们即时将这个范式作为UniAfford,一个通用2D-3D付费感知的统一框架,连同UniAfford-Data,一个集像素级2D说明,点级3D说明,以及共享对象-支付分类法下的语言指令,通过语义级2D-3D对等支持异样的监管. UniAfford采用MLLM作为共享语义中枢和模式-意识符号路由器,以生成图像-和点-云承受力查询. 这些查询分别对一个SAM风格的像素解码器和一个基于SONATA的点解码器设置了条件,使2D,3D能够灵活地进行,并且从只图像,只点-云,或成对的多模式输入中得出联合承受力推论. 实验显示,在不进行特定目标微调的情况下,在2D和3D支付基准上,除了在模式同位化协议下最先进的分枝性能外,还进行了有力的零射通化。 校正符号路由,联合2D-3D监督,以及解码器耦合,而语言-头部诊断显示,路由潜伏状态带有有意义的物体承受力语义. 项目网页:https://4dvlab.github.io/UniAfford

articles.title: Beyond Attention Imbalance: Mitigating Hallucinations via Spectral Surgery
articles.content: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve remarkable success, hallucinations remain a significant barrier to their reliable deployment. Recent studies primarily attribute these issues to cross-modal attention imbalances; most solutions therefore focus on reweighting visual tokens or suppressing language priors. However, such approaches often overlook the spectral characteristics of the visual information flow and frequently rely on Contrastive Decoding (CD), which doubles inference time. Instead of following conventional approaches, we identify two distinct hallucination patterns-Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation and Localized Fixation-and propose FLASH (Frequency-Localized Attention SHaping), a training-free and CD-free framework. FLASH utilizes a Spectral Vortex Score to detect vision heads within multi-head attention layers and applies adaptive spectral modulation to rectify the visual information flow during decoding. Empirical results demonstrate that FLASH achieves a superior balance between performance and efficiency compared to SOTA methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Content Imball:通过外科手术缓解幻觉
articles.content_zh: 虽然大型视觉语言模型取得了显著成功,但幻觉仍然是可靠部署的一大障碍。 最近的研究将这些问题主要归因于跨模式的注意力不平衡;因此,大多数解决办法都侧重于重新加权可视标志或压制语言前缀。 然而,这类方法往往忽略了视觉信息流动的光谱特征,并经常依赖对比解码(CD),后者使推断时间翻了一番. 我们没有遵循传统方法,而是确定了两种不同的幻觉模式——概念-语义分离和本地化的固定,并提出了FLASH(Frequence-Localized Content SHaping),这是一个没有培训和没有CD的框架. FLASH利用光谱分数来检测多头注意力层内的视觉头,并应用适应光谱调制来纠正解码过程中的视觉信息流. 经验结果显示,与SOTA方法相比,FLASH在性能和效率上实现了优异的平衡.

articles.title: Collision-Aware and Observation-Aligned Object-Centric Scene Reconstruction from Point Cloud
articles.content: Object-centric scene reconstruction requires completing partial object observations while preserving metric alignment and avoiding collisions with the surrounding. Existing generation-based methods are often image-conditioned and suffer from scale ambiguity and insufficient geometric constraints. We propose COOL, a framework for COllision-aware and Observation-aLigned reconstruction. Based on an object generation model, COOL conditions the generation on instance and background point clouds. Instance geometry anchors generation in scene coordinates, while background geometry provides local context for scene-consistent completion. We further introduce an explicit collision loss and use joint optimization and resampling to reduce collisions during inference. Experiments on 3D-Front and Scan2CAD demonstrate strong scene-level fidelity, observation alignment, and collision reduction. Moreover, additional studies validate its robustness to mask errors and its applicability to real-world scene replicas.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 碰撞- 智能和观测- 相通对象- 从点云重建
articles.content_zh: 以物体为中心进行场景重建需要完成部分物体观测,同时保持公尺对齐并避免与周围相撞. 现有的以生成为基础的方法往往以图像为条件,并受到尺度模糊和不足的几何限制. 我们提议建立COOL,作为了解碰撞和观察重建的框架。 基于一个物体生成模型,COOL以实例和背景点云为生成条件. 场景坐标中的场景几何锚地生成,而背景几何则为场景相符合的完成提供了局部背景. 我们进一步引入明显的相撞损失,并采用联合优化和再取样,以减少推论中的相撞. 3D-Front和Scan2CAD的实验显示了强烈的场景级忠诚,观测对接,并减少了相撞. 此外,其他研究也证实其能掩盖错误并适用于现实世界的场景复制品。

articles.title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
articles.content: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, pretraining the predictor on DROID video--instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for effective WAM learning from task-specific demonstrations and for transferring future-modeling knowledge acquired from broader in-the-wild videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: V-JEPA 政策:建立关于预测视觉实验的有效世界行动模式
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型将未来视觉状态预测与行动生成结合起来。 通过改造视频生成器或图像编辑模型在规模上预先训练,一行近代WAM的突出线既继承了预测知识,也继承了所学习的模型. 我们询问,由大规模预测预训所引发的预测性视觉潜在空间能否为有效的WAM学习提供足够的基础,而不会继承一个完整的预先培训的视觉基因模型。 为了回答这个问题,我们提出V-JEPA政策,这是一个简单的框架,在被冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的潜在空间上建立一个WAM. 在一个下游的单一阶段,从零开始共同学习一个附有指导条件的与未来相适应的预测器和一个相流相匹配的行动专家,而预测器的未来知情背景关键-价值状态为行动生成提供了条件。 由于总参数为0.9B,其中可培训参数为0.6B,V-JEPA政策通过具有代表性的WAM和跨LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa-GR1的愿景语言行动基线实现竞争性业绩。 将同一下游框架和培训预算下的视觉基础进行比较,发现V-JEPA的潜在作用比歧视性、重建和面向视频的替代作用更有效,特别是在分配转变的情况下。 除了针对特定任务的学习之外,对预测器进行DROID视频指令对子的预先培训,不带动作标签,并将其改造为WAM,在下游控制以及分配外的通化方面产生很大收益. 这些结论共同确立了预测性的视觉潜想,作为WAM从特定任务演示中有效学习的基础,并转让从更宽广的内幕视频中获得的未来模型化知识的基础. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy上查阅。

articles.title: Codebook-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Structurally Heterogeneous Features
articles.content: Cross-modal knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher modality to a student modality. Existing feature-level alignment methods typically assume that teacher and student features reside in structurally alignable representation spaces. However, this assumption does not hold when cross-modal features are structurally heterogeneous and lack clear unit-level correspondence, such as 2D spatial visual grids and 1D temporal audio sequences, thereby limiting the applicability of feature-level alignment. To address this challenge, we propose a cross-modal distillation framework that enables effective knowledge transfer across structurally heterogeneous feature spaces via a vector-quantized codebook. Specifically, teacher features are abstracted into a set of vector-form codes regardless of their original feature structure, and the selected codes serve as concept-level anchors for student learning. Code selection is guided by both task relevance and student compatibility, allowing the student to receive transferable teacher knowledge without requiring direct unit-level feature alignment. Experimental results across diverse cross-modal distillation scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on classification and semantic segmentation tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 结构上异质特征的规范手册-指导性跨相模态知识分解
articles.content_zh: 跨模式的知识分解将知识从教师模式转移到学生模式。 现有的特征级调整方法通常假定师生特征存在于结构相适应的代表空间中。 然而,当跨模式特征在结构上各异,缺乏清晰的单位级对应时,如2D空间可视网格和1D时间相声序列时,这个假设并不适用,从而限制了特征相位相配的适用性. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议建立一个跨模式分馏框架,以便通过一个矢量化的代码册,在结构相异的特征空间之间有效转让知识。 具体来说,无论原始特征结构如何,师生特征被抽象为一组矢量-形式代码,所选代码作为学生学习的概念级锚地. 代码选择以任务关联性和学生相容性为指导,允许学生获得可转移的教师知识而不需要直接的单位级特征相接. 各种跨模式蒸馏设想的实验结果显示了拟议分类和语义分解任务框架的有效性。

articles.title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
articles.content: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 想象 3D- LLM: 将 MLLMs 教给 imagine 3D 幕后回答
articles.content_zh: 从多视图图像来解释3D世界仍然是多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的根本挑战. 现代的MLLMs虽然有效地处理单一图像输入,但很难将不同观点的证据纳入一致的3D理解中. 越来越多的工作试图通过向MLLMs注入3D意识来弥补这一差距,要么通过增强精细的像素水平交叉视图通信,要么通过从3D几何基础模型中引信特征,然而与人类推理的巨大差距依然存在. 在这部作品中,我们重新审视了人类的空间推理,这说明人类与其依赖精细的几何提示,不如大致辨别各种观点之间的共同物体,推断观点之间的相对几何,并组装了场景粗糙的3D布局. 在这一过程的启发下,我们引入了Imagine3D-LLM,这是一种MLLM,它学习将场景的类似紧凑的3D表现集合起来,并且为它对这一表现的回答提供了条件. 具体地说,我们在图像符号之后附加了一小组可学习的汇总符号,把它们解码成一个紧凑的3D高斯电镀表示器,由光度重建损失监督,并结合标准下键预测目标一起训练. 值得注意的是,虽然只有摘要符号直接接受重建监督,但这一目标还促使LLM的基本图像特征内有更强的跨框架通信,表明学习重建在整个模型中传播3D-意识信号. 因此,Imagine3D-LLM在跨多个空间推理和3D理解基准的以往方法上,一贯的超越效果,说明想象场景比被告知其像素几何效果更有效.

articles.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
articles.content: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding steps; spatially, errors in different key rows affect model outputs differently, while state magnitudes vary substantially along both rows and columns. Motivated by these observations, we propose STEPQuant, a spatial-temporal post-training quantization framework for Delta-rule recurrent states. STEPQuant allocates precision according to error magnitude and memory lifetime, and jointly fits key-row and value-column scales based on state distributions and key-row impact on output error. Experiments on Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct across both long- and short-generation benchmarks show that STEPQuant closely matches FP32-state accuracy under a nominal 6-bit budget and outperforms uniform INT8 in its 4-bit configuration. Integrated into SGLang with optimized GPU kernels, 6-bit STEPQuant achieves over 5x recurrent-state compression and reduces total serving memory by up to 68.7%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SteepQuant: Delta规则中的错误发生时间和地点
articles.content_zh: 线性关注用固定大小的经常性状态来取代不断增长的KV缓存,然而这些持久状态在同时服务下会成为巨大的内存瓶颈. 将再生状态直接量化为低精度,往往会导致严重的精度退化,因为再生状态更新传播出量化错误. 我们发现,这些错误的影响取决于两个互补维度:时间上,长生记忆中的错误可能在许多解码步骤中持续存在;在空间上,不同关键行中的错误对模型输出产生不同的影响,而状态的分量则在行和列上差别很大. 基于这些观察,我们提出STEPQuant(STEPQuant),一个三角洲规则反复状态的空间-时间-训练后量化框架。 SteepQuant根据出错规模和内存寿命来分配精度,并基于状态分布和密钥行对输出出错的影响,共同匹配密钥行和值列尺度. 关于Quen3.8-27B和Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruction的实验跨越了长生和短生基准,显示STEPQuant在名义上6位预算下与FP32状态精度紧密相匹配,并超越了4位配置中的统一INT8. 以优化的GPU内核整合到SGLang中,6位STEPQuant实现超过5x的常态压缩并减少总服务内存可达68.7%. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant上查阅。

articles.title: EmoRES-TTS: Residual-Enhanced Vector Steering for Emotional Speech Generation
articles.content: Emotion-conditioned text-to-speech (TTS) models may fail to express the requested emotion reliably, and improving controllability by additional training is costly in both computation and emotion-labeled speech training data. We therefore study vector steering, a training-free approach that modifies the internal representations of a frozen model. CoCoEmo, a conventional vector steering method for emotion TTS, treats each emotion vector as an indivisible direction controlled by a single global strength, limiting adherence to the requested emotion. In this work, we first discover that an emotion vector can be decomposed into a shared component that moves speech away from neutral expression and a residual component that directs generation toward the requested emotion. Building on this finding, we propose Emotion Residual-Enhanced Steering for TTS (EmoRES), a novel method that controls the two components without retraining the backbone. On IEMOCAP, EmoRES outperforms CoCoEmo across all four objective emotion metrics on the IndexTTS-2 and CosyVoice2 backbones. Rank correlation improves by 26.13 and 12.97 percentage points, corresponding to relative gains of 118.8% and 33.1%, while emotion hit rate improves by 12.95 and 6.92 points, corresponding to relative gains of 20.1% and 9.8%. Human evaluation further shows a relative improvement up to 35.0% in the rate at which listeners correctly identified the dominant requested emotion and up to a 17.3% improvement in fidelity, while listeners prefer EmoRES for naturalness in up to 63.8% of pairwise comparisons. Component ablations further demonstrate that effective control benefits from preserving the shared component while strengthening the residual of the emotion steering vectors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EmoRES-TTS:为情感言论生成提供残余-强化矢量指导
articles.content_zh: 情感有条件的文本对语音(TTS)模型可能无法可靠地表达所请求的情感,通过额外培训提高可控性在计算和情感标签的语音培训数据方面都是代价高昂的. 因此,我们研究矢量引导,这是一种无培训的方法,它改变了被冻结的模式的内部表述。 CoCoEmo,一种用于情感TTS的常规向量向导方法,将每种情感向量视为由单一全球强度所控制的不可分割方向,限制了对所请求的情感的坚持. 在这部作品中,我们首先发现一个情感向量可以被分解成一个共享的组件,将语音从中性表达移去,而剩余组件则引导生成人向所请求的情感. 基于这一发现,我们提议对TTS(EmoRES)进行情感残余强化指导(EmoRES),这是一种新颖的方法,在不再培训骨干的情况下控制这两个部分. 在IEMOCAP上,EmoRES在IndexTTS-2和CosyVoice2主干线上的所有四个客观情感度量表上都超越了CoCoEmo. 排名关联性提高了26.13分和12.97分,相对增益为118.8%和33.1%;而情感冲击率提高了12.95分和6.92分,相对增益为20.1%和9.8%. 人类评价还表明,听众正确识别主导性要求的情感的速度相对提高了35.0%,忠诚度提高了17.3%,而听众在对等比较中更喜欢EmoRES自然性,达到63.8%。 组件分解进一步表明,有效控制的好处是保留共享组件,同时加强情感引导向量的残留。

articles.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
articles.content: Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days. Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events. Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the "biography" of the particular entity a question concerns. To address this, we introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that groups visually grounded observations of the same physical instance across clips into retrievable biographies while preserving the context of each moment. During question answering, the biography is retrieved alongside episodic evidence, allowing the model to follow an entity through events using identity links established during memory construction. Evaluations across four benchmarks, including day-long and week-long recordings, demonstrate improvements over prior memory frameworks in both multiple-choice and open-ended question answering. On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0% accuracy, 4.4 percentage points above the best published result. Ablations show that grounded identity association and biography reading both contribute to the gains, which additional descriptions alone do not fully recover.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越时间线:用地基实体生物图增强长视频记忆
articles.content_zh: 回答关于长视频的问题,往往需要将涉及相同物体的事件连接起来,跨越数小时或数天。 编年史描述和文本衍生的实体可以留下实体身份未解决的问题:不同的对象可能共享一个描述,而同一对象的观测仍然在事件间断开. 因此,检索相关事件不一定能恢复特定实体所关注的"传记". 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了地基实体生物图,这是一个长视频的记忆框架,将同一物理实例的视基观测在片段之间组合成可检索的生物图,同时保留每个时刻的背景。 在回答问题时,该传记与零星证据一起检索,使模型能够利用在内存构建过程中建立的身份链接通过事件跟随一个实体. 包括全天和全周录音在内的四项基准的评价表明,在多选择和开放式问题回答方面,比以前的记忆框架有所改善。 在EgoLifeQA上,GEB的精度达到72.0%,比最佳公布结果高出4.4个百分点. 叙述表明,基于身份的关联和传记都有助于取得这些成果,而仅靠补充说明并不能完全恢复。

articles.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision
articles.content: Transformer language models (LMs) are feed-forward: deep-layer representations are never fed back to shallower layers, and the only pathway for information to flow downward across generation steps is the decoded token. This narrow channel forces models to recompute intermediate results and to discard alternative continuations. In this work, we remove this bottleneck during pretraining, introducing the LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) architecture and training method which enable LMs to propagate state across generation. We achieve this by turning recurrent-state learning into a teacher-forced prediction problem: each input token is paired with an information-dense state, derived from the next-token distribution of an off-the-shelf pretrained LM. The model, extended with a small number of additional parameters, is then trained to predict both the next token and the next state. As the input states are precomputed, pretraining remains fully parallel across positions. At inference, the model's own predicted states are fed back, with a minor computational overhead that decreases with model size. Experiments with pretrained models ranging from 135M to 1B parameters show that LIFT consistently outperforms standard Transformers and baselines on language modeling, downstream reasoning tasks, and procedural tasks under token-matched budget, while being on par with or ahead of compute-matched Transformers. Moreover, a controlled study on a state-tracking task shows that a tiny LIFT outperforms same-size Transformers trained on 8x more data, even when trained with the states of a Transformer that fails the task. Overall, we show that LMs can learn to exploit deep-to-shallow feedback during pretraining via scalable teacher supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 与教师监管部门合作,预先培训初级信息反馈转换器
articles.content_zh: 变形器语言模型(LMs)是feed-forward:深层的表示方式从未被反馈回更浅层,信息向下流跨出生成步骤的唯一途径是解码符. 这种狭窄的通道迫使模型重新计算中间结果并丢弃替代续作. 在这部作品中,我们在预训期间去除这个瓶颈,引入了LIFT(Latent Information Reference Transformer)架构和培训方法,使得LMS能够跨代传播状态. 我们通过将经常性状态学习变成一个教师强化的预测问题来达到这个目的:每个输入符都与信息灵通状态相配对,这是从一个现成的预先训练的LM的下接发得到的. 该模型被用少量附加参数扩展,然后被训练来预测下个符号和下个状态. 由于投入状态是预先计算的,预训在位置上仍然完全平行. 推论,模型本身的预测状态被反馈,有一个小的计算间接费用,随着模型大小而减少. 具有135M到1B等参数的预先训练模型的实验表明,LIFT在语言模型构建,下游推理任务,以及同符相配预算下的程序任务方面,一贯优于标准变换器和基线,同时与计算相配的变换器处于等同或领先地位. 此外,对一种状态跟踪任务的受控研究表明,一个小LIFT的性能超过了接受过8x多数据培训的同大小的变形器,即使训练时与一个变形器的状态一起完成了任务. 总的来说,我们表明,LMS可以通过可扩展的教师监督,在预训期间学习利用从深到浅的反馈。

articles.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
articles.content: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 测试时间 AI4AI 中为代理机理设计学习元技能
articles.content_zh: 代理性能既取决于推理能力,也取决于其行为环境. 我们研究测试时间AI-for-AI,询问建设者如何学习为目标构建更好的执行环境,同时两个模型的权重保持不变. 为了使建设者的经验可以再用,我们引入了Meta-Skill:原则,规定何时需要支持以及需要提供何种资源. "构建者"从"目标"对开发集的执行反馈中学习出这些原则,再用被冻结的技能库来构建用于隐形任务的"被". 在Harness-Bench和Newton Bench两地,全行元技能在无技能建设中提高了8.95个百分点的宏观平均业绩,比直接将同一家银行交付给目标高出12.02个百分点。 这些成果突出了将经验转化为可执行支持的价值。 当同一模式为两个角色服务时,收益进一步表明,通过学习建立更好的环境,实现系统层面的自我改进。

articles.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
articles.content: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AdviSD:通过定向多回合自我分裂学习咨询边境有限责任公司
articles.content_zh: 小型可培训的顾问可以使用自然语言的建议来指导被冻结的语言模型执行器. 除了学习任务奖励,顾问还可以利用已完成互动的反馈来改进其建议。 然而,合理的纠正不需要改变执行,但从这种纠正中学习仍会影响顾问在其他情况下的未来决定。 在共同参数模型中,我们证明,如果这些校正目标比其他校正目标更倾向于有益的建议,那么这种校正会限制学习。 相比于从每一个校正中学习,保持它们的频率比其他的要少,可以提高模型的最终性能. 以此为动力,我们的方法,顾问自我扭曲(AdviSD),有选择地将基于结果的强化学习与顾问的反馈性副本中的自我扭曲结合起来。 反省建议作出更正,顾问利用不同程度的差异来选择监督决定,对同一记录的执行者答复作出评分,无论是否发出咨询意见。 这种方法不需要执行人的可能性或额外的执行人推出. 与双子座和克洛德的Qwen3-8B顾问的实验显示,AdviSD在BFCL-v3上比AdviSD顾问-GRPO的成绩高出4.2-6.4个百分点,在EnvScaler上比3.9-5.1分. 训练有素的顾问一般负责域外任务,并跨不同执行人版本和模范家庭进行转移。 AdviSD还比对了匹配的随机选择,支持其选择规则的值.

articles.title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning
articles.content: Language-model (LM) harnesses enable LMs to operate effectively over long contexts using additional compute. However, existing long-context evaluations are insufficient for distinguishing modern harnesses, reflected by saturated accuracy across harnesses and largely similar evaluation costs. In this paper, we introduce a benchmark for evaluating both the effectiveness and efficiency of long-context harnesses. Our tasks require diverse retrieval strategies, including lexical search and semantic matching, together with strategic and adaptive reasoning over global and local context. Much of the context is semantically relevant but only a small subset is useful at each step, creating both a challenging search problem and different accuracy--cost tradeoffs across processing strategies. For example, one task requires identifying every person satisfying several conditions using evidence scattered across documents; strategically checking the most selective condition first can narrow the search before verifying the remaining conditions. We evaluate multiple families of frontier language models with four state-of-the-art harnesses. Our benchmarks remain challenging even for strong model--harness combinations: the best reaches 68\% macro-average accuracy across four evaluation suites. More importantly, we find that the same underlying model can exhibit markedly different efficiency under different harnesses. Our results establish efficiency as an important axis for long-context evaluation and provide a testbed for developing harnesses that process context strategically rather than exhaustively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LongHarness 座椅:压力测试语言模型用于长文解释
articles.content_zh: 语言模型(LM)的取用使LMs能够使用额外的计算在长的上下文中有效运行. 但是,现有的长文评价不足以区分现代的用具,这反映在各种用具的饱和精度和大致相近的评价成本上。 在本文中,我们提出一个基准,用于评价长文本工具的效力和效率。 我们的任务需要各种检索战略,包括词汇搜索和语义匹配,以及全球和地方背景下的战略性和适应性推理。 大部分背景都具有高度相关性,但每个步骤都只有一个小子集是有用的,既造成了一个具有挑战性的搜索问题,又造成了不同处理战略的准确性成本取舍。 例如,一项任务要求利用分散在文件上的证据确定每一个符合若干条件的人;从战略上检查最有选择性的条件首先可以缩小搜索范围,然后核查其余的条件。 我们用四个最先进的工具来评价多个家庭的前沿语言模型。 我们的基准仍然具有挑战性,即使对强模型-缺陷组合而言也是如此:在四个评价套件中,最佳的精确度达到68-%的宏观平均值。 更重要的是,我们发现,同一基本模式在不同的管理下可以显示出明显不同的效率。 我们的成果将效率确立为长文评价的重要轴心,并为从战略角度而不是详尽无遗地开发利用这一进程提供了一个试验床。

articles.title: From Routing Signals to Selective Review: Visual regrounding in MoE VLMs
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) may accept false visual premises, answering questions about a target object's color, count, location, or state even when it is absent. We call this reliability-critical behavior a target-absence grounding failure. Existing visual-grounding detectors primarily rely on generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures. We present the first framework to leverage internal routing decisions in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs to detect target absence before generation and guide selective correction. We extract target-token routing probabilities from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, train a separate L2-regularized linear detector for each model, and use its predictions to selectively invoke a target-aware review prompt. Using routing alone, the Qwen and Gemma detectors achieve ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956 on GQA-Inpaint and retain 0.8095 and 0.7781 on the external OBER dataset, respectively. The resulting routing-gated policy improves end-to-end accuracy on GQA-Inpaint and OBER by +22.25% and +12.17% for Qwen, and by +13.42% and +1.39% for Gemma, without modifying model weights. Further analysis shows that the signal is localized to the target-object token, emerges in early MoE layers, and is distributed across partially substitutable experts. Although cross-dataset threshold shifts require recalibration, false-positive review causes limited harm overall, suggesting that intervention risk can be controlled through joint selection of the detector threshold and review prompt. Overall, we show that routing probabilities alone preserve actionable information about visual perception, allowing computation already produced by an MoE VLM to support low-cost detection and selective visual regrounding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从Routing Signals到选择式审查:在MOE VLMs中视觉重定位
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可能接受虚假的视觉前提,回答有关一个目标对象的颜色,计数,位置,或状态,即使它缺席. 我们把这个可靠性的关键行为 称为目标缺失 地面故障。 现有的目视定位探测器主要依靠生成的响应,隐藏状态,或不确定性措施. 我们提出第一个框架,以利用专家组合中的内部路径决定,在生成前发现目标缺失,并指导选择性修正。 我们从Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it中提取目标-token的路由概率,为每个模型单独训练一个L2-正规线性探测器,并利用其预测有选择地引用目标-意识审查的提示. Quen和Gemma探测器仅使用线路,在GQA-Inpaint上分别实现0.998和0.9956的ROC-AUC,并在外部OBER数据集上保留0.8095和0.7781. 由此产生的路由定型政策提高了GQA-Inpaint和OBER的端对端的精度,Quen的精度为+22.25%和+12.17%,Gemma的精度为+13.42%和+1.39%,没有修改模型重量. 进一步的分析显示,信号是局部到目标对象符号,出现于早期的MOE层,并分布于部分可替代的专家中. 虽然跨数据集阈值变化需要重新校正,但假阳性审查总体上造成的危害有限,这表明干预风险可以通过联合选择探测器阈值和快速审查来控制. 总体而言,我们显示,仅路由概率就保存了可操作的视觉感知信息,使得一个MOE VLM已经产生的计算能够支持低成本的检测和选择性的视觉再定位.

articles.title: How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention
articles.content: The attention operation is naively position invariant. However, positional information is fundamental to natural language, and therefore a variety of explicit position encodings have been developed in transformer-based models, such as rotary position encoding (RoPE). Although explicit position encodings have long been assumed to be required, recent methods that interleave local mixing layers, such as sliding window attention (SWA) and gated linear attention, while not encoding position (NoPE) in global attention layers has recently been shown to be successful at scale. How and why this approach works is not well-understood. In this paper, we develop an explanation of how hybrid models of this sort can implicitly encode position at global NoPE layers. Supported by both theoretical and empirical evidence, our central argument is that SWA and gated linear attention induce a recency bias in the residual stream that propagates to, and is selected by, the global attention logits. Moreover, in contrast to the implicit position encodings found in models with only global NoPE attention, in which positional information arises solely from the causal mask, the recency bias in hybrid models can be maintained across long sequences. In addition to deepening our understanding of how hybrid models encode position, these findings may provide insights for how to encode position in a way that can extrapolate to longer sequence lengths indefinitely.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 本地混音如何编码全球无PE 注意中的相对位置
articles.content_zh: 关注行动天真无常 然而,位置信息对于自然语言来说是根本性的,因此在以变压器为主的模型中已经开发出各种明确的位置编码,如回转位置编码(ROPE). 虽然长期以来人们一直认为需要明确的定位编码,但最近一些将局部混合层相接的方法,如滑动的窗口注意力(SWA)和有门的线性注意力(Global attentional attention),而在全球关注层中没有编码位置(NoPE)被证明是规模上的成功. 这种办法如何运作以及为什么运作,并没有得到很好的理解。 在本文中,我们阐述了这种混合模型如何可以隐含地编码在全球无线环境层的位置。 在理论证据和经验证据的支持下,我们的核心论点是,西南洋分公司和有门线性关注在剩余流中诱发了后退偏差,这种偏差传播给全球关注记录员,并由他们选择。 此外,与只有全局NoPE关注的模型中发现的隐含位置编码不同,其中位置信息完全出自于因果掩码,而混合模型中的后置偏差可以由长序列来维持. 除了加深我们对混合模型如何编码位置的理解外,这些发现可能为如何以可以无限地推导到较长序列长度的方式编码位置提供了深刻的见解.

articles.title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces
articles.content: Chain-of-thought traces are widely read as records of how models reach their answers, informing debugging, agent auditing, and claims about reasoning. Testing this interpretation is difficult because natural-language thinking traces are rarely mechanically verifiable. We revisit it in iGSM, a synthetic grade-school mathematics benchmark designed to study thinking traces and used to support claims of learned reasoning and planning. Crucially, iGSM exposes the exact quantities and dependencies that a correct solution should use, allowing generated traces to be checked programmatically step by step and enabling us to test whether correct answers are reliably accompanied by valid traces. We first evaluate models trained exclusively on valid, minimal traces. Answer correctness and trace validity nearly coincide in distribution but decouple out of distribution: on the hardest instances, 31.6% of correct answers have invalid traces, over half of which pass all syntactic and arithmetic checks but fail semantic dependency checks. We then intervene on trace supervision. Non-minimal training traces induce non-minimal outputs, while re-asking the same problem with a different query reveals computations inherited from the original query, weakening minimality as evidence of selective planning. Shuffling tokens in 10% of training trace sentences preserves near-clean accuracy even out of distribution despite no trace passing verification. Swapped training traces likewise retain high in-distribution accuracy. We discuss the implications of these findings for chain-of-thought monitoring and interpretation in the context of AI safety.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 正确的回答, 无效的追踪 : 关于思维链轨迹的可核实的年级-学校数学启示录
articles.content_zh: 思维链的痕迹被广泛解读为模型如何达到答案的记录,告知调试,代理审计,以及推理的主张. 测试这种解释很困难,因为自然语言思维痕迹很少是机械可核查的. 我们在iGSM中重新审视它,这是一个综合的年级数学基准,旨在研究思维痕迹,并用来支持关于学习推理和规划的主张. 关键是,iGSM揭示了正确解决方案应使用的确切数量和依赖性,使得生成的痕迹能够按程序一步步被检查,并使我们能够测试正确答案是否可靠地伴有有效的痕迹. 我们首先评价只接受过有效、微小痕迹训练的模型。 答案正确性和痕量有效性在分布中几乎吻合,但与分布脱节:在最困难的情况下,31.6%的正确答案有无效的痕迹,其中一半以上通过所有合成和算术检查,但语义依赖检查失败. 然后我们介入追踪监控 非微量训练痕迹会诱导非微量输出,而通过不同的查询重新提出同样的问题则揭示出从原始查询中继承的计算,弱化了最小度作为选择性规划的证据. 尽管没有经过任何微量的验证,但10%的培训微量句子中的抖动符号仍然保持了接近干净的准确性。 抽取的培训痕迹同样保持了高度的分发准确性。 我们讨论了这些结论对在AI安全范围内进行思维链监测和解释的影响。

articles.title: Pruning for Efficiency, Paying in Fairness: Demographic Disparities in Pruned Speech-LLMs
articles.content: Speech-LLMs are expensive to run, making compression important for real-world deployment. However, compressed models are usually selected using aggregate word error rate (WER), which can hide how pruning affects different demographic groups. In this work, we systematically study the effect of audio encoder pruning on SLAM-ASR for different demographic groups. Using the Fair-Speech and Common Voice datasets, we found that the pruning does not affect all demographic groups equally; the gap between best- and worst-performing groups increases in fold. These disparities appear across all three encoder scales, but only the largest model initially hides them behind aggregate WER. LoRA adaptation improves WER for every group, but benefits groups already performing well more strongly and widens for certain groups. On Common Voice English, Danish, and Dutch, accent gaps persist but do not clearly widen, showing that the fairness effects of pruning vary across datasets and must be measured directly. Our findings suggest that for pruned models, deployment decisions should include per-group WER, with the worst-performing group's error rate as an explicit criterion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 追求效率计划,公平支付:Pruned Speech-LLMs的人口差异
articles.content_zh: Speech-LLMs运行昂贵,使得压缩对于现实世界的部署很重要. 然而,压缩模型通常使用集合词出错率(WER)来选择,这可以隐藏普鲁能如何影响不同的人口组别. 在这项工作中,我们系统地研究音频编码器对不同人口群体SAM-ASR的影响。 使用Fair-Speech和Common Voice的数据集,我们发现收视率并不平等地影响所有人口群体;表现最优和表现最差群体之间的差距在叠加. 这些差异出现在所有三个编码器尺度上,但最初只有最大的模型将其隐藏在聚合WER后. LORA的适应改进了每个群体的WER,但受益群体已经表现较好,对某些群体也扩大了。 在共同之声英语,丹麦语和荷兰语中,口音差距仍然存在,但并没有明显扩大,这表明打压的公平效应因数据集而异,必须直接衡量. 我们的调查结果表明,对于被打压的模型,部署决定应当包括每个组的WER,表现最差的组的出错率是一个明确的标准.

articles.title: Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples
articles.content: Turning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) into strong dense retrievers typically requires some form of retriever training. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can instead be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval given only a few in-context examples. To answer this, we introduce RICE (Representations from In-Context Examples), a simple "training-free" approach that extracts high-quality dense representations from LLMs. To do so, RICE conditions the LLM on examples that provide a shared context for query and document encoding. Our results demonstrate that RICE embeddings can substantially improve the accuracy of prompt-based LLM embeddings, establishing it as a simple method to build LLM-based dense retrievers that do not require training. We release our code at https://github.com/nourj98/RICE.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 仅使用内文实例的有效获取
articles.content_zh: 将只有解码器的大型语言模型(LLMs)转变为强密回取器一般需要某种形式的回取器训练. 在本文中,我们问是否可以鼓励有限责任公司提供有效的说明,以便大量检索,仅举几个内容内的例子。 为了回答这一点,我们引入了RICE(In-Context Environments),一种简单的"无训练"方法,从LLMs中提取出高质量的密集的表示. 为此,RICE以实例为LLM设定条件,为查询和文档编码提供共享上下文. 我们的结果表明,RICE嵌入可以大大地提高即时LLM嵌入的精度,将其确立为一种简单的方法来建造不需要培训的基于LLM的密集取回器. 我们在https://github.com/nourj98/RICE发布我们的代码。

articles.title: Gender bias across LLMs is common and highly heterogenous
articles.content: Understanding gender biases in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important as these systems become embedded in decision-support tools with real consequences. Prior research has focused only on a small set of models, leaving open the extent to which gender biases are common and heterogeneous across LLMs. We address this gap across ten models released between April 2025 and June 2026, spanning nine vendors, using two paradigms: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases (Study 1) and moral judgment of abuse or torture against a woman or a man to prevent a catastrophic outcome (Study 2). In Study 1, two of ten models attributed masculine-stereotyped phrases to female writers more often than the reverse, while three models showed the opposite pattern. In Study 2, several models converged on a male-disadvantaging asymmetry that was directionally consistent with a documented human tendency to protect female targets from harm, though the specific conditions under which this asymmetry emerged varied by model; three other models, by contrast, showed no variation across conditions. These results indicate that gender-related biases are common in LLMs. Their direction and magnitude, however, are highly heterogeneous, to the point that some models behave in diametrically opposite ways to others. Bias auditing should therefore be treated as an ongoing, multi-vendor process, rather than a one-time assessment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 法学硕士的性别偏见很常见,而且非常异质
articles.content_zh: 了解大语言模型中的性别偏见越来越重要,因为这些系统已嵌入决策支助工具,并产生实际后果。 先前的研究只侧重于一套小的模型,使不同专业课程的性别偏见普遍并各不相同。 我们在2025年4月至2026年6月期间发布了10种模式,涉及9个销售商,我们利用两种模式解决这一差距:性别归属于定型短语(第1研究)和对虐待或酷刑妇女或男子以防止灾难性后果的道德判断(第2研究)。 在"研究一"中,十个模型中有两个将男性定型的短语归结到女性作家身上比倒数更常见,而三个模型则显示出相反的模式. 在研究2中,有几种模型集中在一种不利于男性的不对称上,这种不对称在方向上与记录在案的人类保护女性目标免受伤害的倾向是一致的,尽管这种不对称出现的具体条件因模型而异;相形之下,其他三种模型则显示各种条件之间没有差异。 这些结果表明,与性别有关的偏见在法学硕士课程中很常见。 然而,它们的方向和规模差异很大,以至于有些模型的行为方式与另一些模型相反。 因此,应把偏见审计视为一个持续、多反馈的过程,而不是一次性评估。

articles.title: Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using dense, token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. Vanilla OPD treats all teacher signals equally, assuming that the teacher's supervision is equally important for every token. However, teacher signals at different tokens may have very different effects on the student's performance: some correct important reasoning errors, while others have little effect on the final answer. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Dr. OPD (OPD Done Right), which defines the optimal weighted OPD to maximize the student's performance. We formulate Dr. OPD as a bilevel optimization problem in which the student learns from weighted teacher supervision, while the weights are selected to maximize the expected reward of the resulting student. To solve Dr. OPD, we develop an efficient iterative solver that updates the token weights and student policy alternatively. At each round, it updates weights in closed form and then takes one gradient step on the resulting weighted OPD objective. Under regularity conditions, we show that this weighted update achieves a higher expected reward than a vanilla OPD update. Empirically, across strong-to-weak and same-size distillation on math and code, Dr. OPD consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines. In particular, in the strong-to-weak distillation setting, Dr. OPD improves average math performance by $9.7$ points over vanilla OPD, and enables the smaller student to surpass its larger teacher.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OPD博士:学习如何优化大语言模型的政策扭曲
articles.content_zh: 政策上蒸馏(OPD)训练一个学生依靠自己产生的响应,使用一个更强大的老师的密集的,象征性的监督. 香草 OPD对所有老师的信号一视同仁,假设老师的监管对于每一个符号都同样重要. 然而,不同符号上的老师信号可能对学生的表现产生非常不同的影响:一些正确的重要推理错误,而另一些则对最终答案影响不大. 基于这一观察,我们引入了OPD博士(OPD Done Right),它定义了优化加权的OPD,以最大限度地提高学生的成绩. 我们把OPD博士发展成一个双层优化问题,其中学生从加权教师监管中学习,而加权则被选取来最大限度地提高由此而来的学生的预期回报. 为了解决OPD博士问题,我们开发了一个高效的迭代解析器,以更新符号权重和学生政策。 每回合,它会以闭合的形式更新权重,然后对由此产生的加权OPD目标采取一个梯度步骤. 在规律性条件下,我们显示,这种加权更新比香草OPD更新实现更高的预期回报. 经验是,在数学和代码上,通过强而弱和同大小的蒸馏,OPD博士的业绩始终高于所有评估的基线。 特别是,在强到弱的蒸馏环境下,OPD博士将平均数学表现比香草OPD提高9.7分,使较小的学生能超越其较大的老师.

articles.title: Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S
articles.content: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High's published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 可审计的长期记忆:在LongMemEval-S上以500分中的479/475计量的确定性检索链
articles.content_zh: 我们评价LongMemEval-S上可审计的长期记忆系统。 它的检索链使用混合候选检索,交叉编码器重排,覆盖-第一数据包编译,以及确定推理脚手架;一个LLM只用作可替换的最终阅读器. 链条将所有黄金会话放在候选集合中,用于468/470可回答的问题,并生成462/470的黄金完整包. 使用Claude Opus读取器通过无标注的CLI别名调用,在GPT-4o下,两个500个问题得分为479/500和475/500. 72个可回答的知识更新行使用了一个经过实质性修改的评分提示符,该提示符在官方文本下的效果尚未得到衡量. 成对的Chronos High发行了478/500;在读者生成,评分即时,以及可能的数据版本上的差异,加上系统内部的差异,都没有建立优越性或等同性. 同一包上的grok-4.6高读取器的分数为476/474分,而最合理的-功率代理变体则回落到461/465分. 头条通行证在八道判决行上各有不同. 第二名裁判员同意头条裁判员在每道传出493/500行(98.6%),得分均会通过472/500;而官方裁判员在重分字节-同道传出1分的回答时也会翻出三个判决. 负控拒绝一个修补了3个错误的草稿但打破了11个正确的草稿的核查员. 所有组件都是针对同样的500个问题开发的,没有搁置的评价或独立的人力裁定;进行检索和脚手架方法来源和记录稿产生的审计;头条阅读器收到额外的操作上下文,其完整的请求没有保留,MCP工具的可用性尚未解决. 我们发布了实际化的包、脚手架、读者产出、法官判决以及检查和重新评分的控制。

articles.title: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
articles.content: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BITEM at NTCIR-19 R2C2 任务:预测来自代理RAG管道信号的信心
articles.content_zh: BITEM团队以单一的代理管道进入了NTCIR-19 R2C2任务的两个子任务,其中模型搜索、读取并记录了有关电影体的证据,而管弦乐手则掌握可以提交的记录和规则。 只有在一连串程序对照它所引用的通道加以核对之后,才受理索赔要求,而且只有经过充分核实的证据才公布答复。 每个问题要经过三到四次, 每一次从一个被剥去的 之前的通行证上拿回的通行证。 每一份答复所显示的置信度由管弦乐手从跑后留下的东西计算出来,从不问该模型,它不能给自己评分。 两次取回运行被排出第4位和第5位的22位,集合出行口值为0.0709nDCG@20,在多跳和后处理重的问题上收益最大,组织者将集合出行排出场顶. 25次答题中,有16次是依据这两次答题的段落,其中12次是由其他小组存档的。 HMR奖励一个信心高的系统,当它回答正确,而当它回答错误时则低. 输油管的精度为0.9219,25分之6,而附在答复后的信任度为0.4915,13分之13. 在同样的记录信号上拟定的几条规则,没有进一步的型号呼叫,也没有进一步的检索,将精确度提高到了0.9375,第5和0.6985,第9个HMR。 单凭HMR的分级可以奖励一个低信心错误回答的系统,所以我们提出accHMR,准确性乘以HMR,它按照准确性的比例报告奖励,而修改后的规则将得分为0.6549分之五. 就今后的工作而言,在管道已经产生的数量上安装一个模型,而不是用手写出这样的规则,是向前迈出的真正一步。

articles.title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
articles.content: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ($S^3$), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate $S^3$ on 2B-30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains. $S^3$ establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: $S^3 $: 光谱 Null-Space Swap 使模型高效合理
articles.content_zh: 法学硕士通过思维链培训,在推理能力方面表现优异,但往往付出过高的代价。 我们发现推理能力的核心在于思考模型在由对应的非思考模型的主导单数方向所定义的投影的虚空范围内的权重部分,去除子空间部分可以在很大程度上提高推理效率,而不会损害思考-模式后训练中获得的精度. 与主要在占优势的亚空间内运作的现有努力不同,我们首先揭开空地的关键作用,并将其用于模型优化。 基于这一发现,我们提议进行Spectral Null-Space交换(S^3美元),这是对非思维和思维检查站的无培训组合。 我们的方法将非思维模式保留在自己的主导子空间内,并将思维检查站控制在它之外,提高推理效率,同时保持准确性. 我们广泛评价2B-30B密集和混合型专家结构的3美元,这些结构跨越了跨数学、多式联运和音频推理领域的28个评价环境。 $S^3美元在无培训模式组成战略中确立新的经验性Pareto Frontiers:在所有情况下,它比完整的思考模型平均减少27.4%的推算符间接费用,同时将总体任务精确度提高1.0个百分点(例如,HMMT25的精确度为+8.3%,同时加速度33.0%)。 我们进一步使用注意的entropy来解释,发现保留成分产生更集中的注意,我们使用一个简化的关于优化的分析模型来证明为什么空空空能有效减少注意的entropy,从而提高推理的效率.

articles.title: On Trajectory-Aware Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
