articles.content: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions. The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model's own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed. Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact. We introduce PUMBA, a unified framework for trajectory-aware training that trains the denoiser on consecutive steps of policy-induced trajectories, passes information between steps, and optimizes them jointly by backpropagation through time. A controlled study of this design space shows that i) exact train--inference alignment fails due to local overfitting, whereas a looser alignment still brings training masks closer to those seen at inference; ii) passing continuous information outperforms discrete gradient estimators through the commitment at each step; and iii) performance improves as backpropagation through time spans more steps, which we support theoretically. Combined, these components match the best checkpoint of a same-size autoregressive model. Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B, where it improves the trade-off between performance and number of function evaluations (NFEs) in both full-canvas and block diffusion generation. At matched performance, it needs up to 22% fewer NFEs than standard fine-tuning with twice the budget in full-canvas generation, and up to 26% fewer than standard fine-tuning for the same number of steps in block diffusion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于遮掩扩散语言模型的轨迹- 智能培训
articles.content_zh: 蒙面扩散模型(MDMs)通过每个步骤解码出数个活字来生成文字,但它们在不同的条件下都经过了训练和取样. 模型以随机遮掩的序列来训练,而推论则遵循由模型自身预测而成的轨迹. 此外,每个步骤都无法获得前一个步骤计算的结果。 最近的方法从不同的角度来缩小这些限制,留下这些选择如何相互作用的开口. 我们引入了PUMBA, 一个统一的轨迹意识训练框架, 它训练德诺瓦人 连续步由政策引起的轨迹, 传递信息 在步由之间, 对这一设计空间进行的一项有控制的研究表明,由于局部偏差,准确的列车-推论调整失败了,而松散的调整仍然使训练口罩更接近于推论中看到的口罩;通过每一步骤的承诺,连续传递信息的表现超过了离散梯度估计器;和三)随着反射跨出更多步骤,性能得到改善,我们在理论上支持这些步骤。 综合起来,这些组件匹配了同尺寸自递模型的最佳出入口. 根据这些调查结果,我们扩大了PUMBA,以监督LLaDA-8B的微调,在全扫描和块传播生成方面,它改进了性能与功能评价(NFE)数量之间的取舍。 在匹配的性能下,它需要比标准微调低22%的NFE,在全扫描仪生成时,其预算比标准微调低两倍;而在区块扩散中,同样数量的步骤比标准微调低26%。

articles.title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
articles.content: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SelfSearch:奖励自由搜索自我改进代理
articles.content_zh: LLM代理商的编码能力提高,使他们能够检查并修改自己的指令、工具和执行程序。 现有办法利用这种能力,通过反复的下游评价寻找改进的代理商,这需要大量费用,并将搜寻与被评价的任务联系起来。 我们引入了\textbf{ selfSearch},这是一种免费的搜索程序,其中代理商使用以往自改进事件的记录修改自己. 这些记录记录了早期修改尝试的推理,工具行动和结果,为改进任务解决和自我修改提供了具体的经验. 在搜索过程中没有下游的奖励信号,SelfSearch在所有6个模式基准设置中都会比起初始代理提高人口-平均成功率,个体代理在终端-Bench 2.1上获得高达11.2个百分点. 在 SWE-bench 多语种上,一个代理通过\textbf{ 5.0} 百分点提高成功率,同时通过\textbf{38.5}在初始代理和进化代理解决的任务上降低执行成本. SelfSearch通过以较低的搜索成本提供评价指导的搜索基线,实现了竞争性任务的成功. 仅使用\textbf\ 4.03}搜索成本,它会产生一个可解决\textbf{ 82.0} 终端- Bench 2.1任务与 DeepSeek V4 的牵引装置 在公共的九harness比较的设置下闪光,匹配了顶级得分的吊带,Codex. 这些结果表明,通过自我改造获得的经验可以提高代理人下游的能力和效率。

articles.title: Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization
articles.content: Persistent textual memory allows language models to carry information across long interactions, but learning what to remember is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. A memory rewrite may only become useful many steps later, while much of the observed utility may be inherited from information already stored before the rewrite. We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which isolates the incremental value of each memory rewrite by crediting it for its marginal contribution to current and future downstream utility. This turns delayed memory utility into a direct learning signal for optimizing what information should persist. We study MGPO on document-level information extraction, where structured supervision makes the effects of individual memory updates directly measurable. MGPO improves extraction while reducing average memory length by nearly 80% relative to the initial memory policy before optimization. The learned memory policy also supports reuse and transfer across domains, downstream models without further training. These results show that effective memory learning depends not only on preserving useful information, but on identifying which memory updates create lasting incremental value.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学会记住什么:长视野反事实记忆优化
articles.content_zh: 持续的文字记忆可以让语言模型通过长长的相互作用来传递信息,但学习要记住什么基本上是信用分配问题. 内存重写可能只会在后期成为有用的许多步骤,而所观察到的多功能可能继承自重写前已经存储的信息. 我们引入了记忆增益政策优化(MGPO),它将每个内存的增益值通过对当前和未来下游效用的边际贡献的信用来隔离出每个内存重写. 这使延迟的内存效用变成一个直接的学习信号,以优化哪些信息应该持续存在。 我们研究关于文件层次信息提取的MGPO,其中结构化的监督使得个人内存更新的效果可以直接衡量. MGPO改进了提取,同时在优化前将平均内存长度相对于初始内存政策减少了近80%. 所学的记忆政策还支持跨域再利用和转让,下游模式无需进一步培训. 这些结果显示,有效的内存学习不仅取决于保存有用的信息,而且取决于确定哪些内存更新创造了持久的增量值.

articles.title: Time-Anchored Diffusion Language Models: Latent-Space Caching for Fast Generation
articles.content: Recent work on anchored diffusion language models improves denoising by shaping an intermediate latent space with supervised important-token targets. In this work, we introduce time-based (self-supervised) anchoring, which learns and reuses latent anchors without requiring such targets. Our key observation is that anchors encode persistent properties of the clean sequence, such as its semantic intent, global structure, or intermediate plan. Although their hidden representations become stale as the token canvas evolves, their semantic content remains useful across nearby diffusion times. This is implemented through a two-stage architecture consisting of a relatively expensive anchor network that generates the latent cache state and a lightweight denoising network that intelligently combines the cached latent state with the current state at each reverse step using a fusion module. This gives anchoring a latent-space caching interpretation: the anchor network is evaluated periodically, while its cached representation is reused across multiple reverse steps. We instantiate this framework as TADM:Post-train, which time-anchorizes pretrained DLMs, and TADM:Pretraining, which learns time-based anchors during pretraining. Applied to DiffusionGemma-26B, TADM:Post-train improves throughput by approximately 49% to 79% on several math, code, and STEM benchmarks (GSM8K, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench-v6, HumanEval, MMLU-Pro). TADM:Pretraining reduces Transformer-layer computation by up to 38% relative to a standard single-stage DLM, achieves up to 73% higher measured throughput than ADLM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 时空传播语言模型:Latent-Space Caching for Fast Generation
articles.content_zh: 最近关于定位传播语言模型的工作通过塑造一个具有有监督的重要目标的潜在中间空间,改进了发音。 在这项工作中,我们引入了基于时间(自我监督)的锚地,学习和再利用潜在的锚地而不需要这种目标。 我们的关键观察是,锚定了清洁序列的持久性属性,例如它的语义意图,全球结构,或中间计划. 虽然随着象征画布的演化,它们隐藏的表达方式变得僵化了,但其语义内容在相邻的传播时期仍然有用. 这项工作是通过一个两阶段结构实施的,一个是相对昂贵的锚网,生成潜在的缓存状态;另一个是轻量级去诺网络,利用聚变模块,将缓存的潜在状态与每个倒移阶段的当前状态智能地结合起来。 这样可以锁定潜在的空间缓存解释:定期评估锚网,而其缓存的表示则通过多个反向步骤被再利用。 我们即时将这个框架作为TADM:Post-train,它定时将预先训练的DLM定时;TADM:Pretrain,在预先训练时学习时间主播. TADM: 在数个数学、代码和STEM基准(GSM8K、AIME26、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCode Bench-v6、HumanEval、MMLU-Pro)上, TADM:Pretraining使变压器层的计算相对于标准的单相DLM减少高达38%,所测量的吞吐量比ADLM高达73%.

articles.title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
articles.content: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student to match a privileged teacher distribution along its own sampled trajectory. Standard OPSD applies this supervision to unverified student rollouts while conditioning the teacher on privileged context, typically a reference solution. We separate these roles in a factorial analysis and find that scaffold correctness has a stronger effect on downstream accuracy than context correctness. Unverified scaffolds create an imitation gap because the teacher can use information unavailable to the student. This gap shrinks with model scale, yet OPSD continues to supervise mostly unverified trajectories. In contrast, verified scaffolds remain effective even when the teacher is conditioned on the student's own unsuccessful rollout. Based on this finding, we introduce OASIS, which retains the OPSD objective but supervises mostly verified by label on-policy trajectories and replaces written solutions with unverified model-generated attempts as the teacher context. OASIS therefore requires only final-answer labels. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025, OASIS improves over the base model by 3.2--3.8 points on average, while OPSD's gain falls from 3.05 points at 1.7B to 0.14 at 8B. At 8B, OASIS improves over OPSD by 3.05 points, showing that verified on-policy scaffolds preserve the effectiveness of self-distillation as models scale.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 克服LLM在政策上自我扭曲方面的扩大限制 理由
articles.content_zh: 政策上的自我消化(OPSD)训练一名学生,以配合其自己被抽取的轨迹的特权教师分布. 标准OPSD将这种监督应用到未经核实的学生推出时,同时给教师设定特权背景,一般是一种参考解决方案. 我们在因子分析中将这些角色分开,发现脚手架正确性对下游准确性的影响比上下文正确性更强. 未经核实的脚手架造成了模仿差距,因为老师可以使用学生所得不到的信息. 这种差距随着模型尺度而收缩,然而OPSD继续监督大部分未经验证的轨迹. 与此相对照的是,经过核实的脚手架依然有效,即使教师受到学生自己推出失败的制约。 基于这一发现,我们引入了OASIS,它保留了OPSD的目标,但监督大多通过政策上的标签轨迹进行验证,并以未经验证的模型生成的尝试取而代之的书面解决方案作为教师的背景. 因此,OASIS只需要最后的回答标签。 纵观2024年AIME,2025年AIME和2025年HMMT上的Qwen3-1.7B,4B和8B,OASIS平均比基准模型改善3.2-3.8分,而OPSD的收益从1.7B的3.05分下降到了8B的0.14分. 8B时,OASIS比OPSD改进了3.05分,显示经核实的政策脚手架保持了自沉作为模型尺度的有效性.

articles.title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment
articles.content: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or 'evil' persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether different models are equally affected by the same fine-tuning examples. In this work, we use training data attribution to quantitatively estimate how much each harmful example contributes to EM. We benchmark the quality of the attribution via retraining -- a sound attribution score should enable us to enhance or attenuate EM by filtering data on that score. Score-based filtering can substantially enhance or attenuate EM; we find that both data-attribution scores and a black-box harmfulness score can identify consequential examples. All models we test become misaligned when trained on the same dataset, and influence scores perform best when filtering data from the same model that computed them. We find cross-model generalization of influence scores from scores derived from the three model families we tested, but this generalization does not recover same model filtering performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不良咨询的不平等影响: 使用培训数据来调制紧急错配
articles.content_zh: 在狭义,错位的任务上精细地调整出大型语言模型,可以解除他们的训练后对齐,并诱发出小说错位行为——这种现象被称作\emph{ergent misignation} (EM). EM已经与类似人物的表达方式联系起来,其中微调可以通过放大一个有害或"邪恶"的人来减少损失. 仍然不清楚培训数据有哪些特性驱动这种效应:所有有害的例子是否都大致同样地造成错位,不同的模型是否同样受到同样微调的例子的影响。 在这项工作中,我们利用培训数据归属来量化地估计每个有害的例子对EM的贡献程度. 我们通过再培训来衡量归属的质量 -- -- 良好的归属分数应使我们能够通过过滤有关该分数的数据来增强或削弱EM。 基于分数的过滤可以大大地增强或削弱EM;我们发现,数据分配分数和一个黑盒有害分数都能够识别相应的例子. 所有我们测试的模型,在同一个数据集上训练时,都变得不匹配,并且当从同一个模型中过滤数据时,影响分数的表现最好. 我们发现从我们测试的三个模型家庭的分数中得出的影响分数的跨模型概括,但这种概括并不能恢复相同的模型过滤性能.

articles.title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs
articles.content: Current pre-training datasets are derived from web crawls, with all their issues, and were not designed to support mid- and post-training pipelines--for instance, they contain little explicit reasoning. Thus, many frontier labs have begun to develop their own internal datasets, starting from state-of-the-art models, to augment their pre-training data mix, eg, with reasoning traces to address cold-start problems. While demonstratively effective, none of these datasets are public, and the effect of this so-called synthetic data on knowledge and skill acquisition of language models, including small ones, remains poorly understood. We present SYNTH, the first open-source synthetic corpus derived from 58,698 Wikipedia articles that collapses pre-, mid-, and post-training into a single training stage via structured amplification of curated encyclopedic seeds. We evaluate SYNTH by training a suite of models: a 56M tiny model (Monad), 0.3B-0.6B dense models (Baguettotron), and a 13B / 1B-active MoE. At iso-compute, SYNTH outperforms filtered web data, and our models remain competitive with similarly-sized open-weight baselines. Because SYNTH is back-translated from grounded passages, SYNTH-trained models achieve high factual precision despite 10-140x fewer training tokens, with memorization targeted by the seed corpus. These results show that synthetic datasets, including our SYNTH dataset, are capable of producing competitive generalist models from a fraction of the training data, enabling rapid iteration as the frontier advances. These findings open up possibilities for both generalist models with significantly increased data efficiency, as well as domain-specific models where no instruction or conversational data is available. Finally, we publicly release our SYNTH dataset and the suite of Baguettotron models under a permissive license, thus supporting open-source language model development.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: All Training: LLMS的全合成单层配方
articles.content_zh: 目前的培训前数据集来自网络爬行及其所有问题,并非旨在支持培训中、培训后的管道,例如,它们很少包含明确的理由。 因此,许多前沿实验室开始开发自己的内部数据集,从最先进的模型开始,以扩充其预训数据组合,例如,用推理痕迹来解决冷启动问题. 这些数据集虽然明显有效,但没有一个是公开的,而这种所谓的合成数据对包括小型语言模型在内的语言模型的知识和技能获取的影响仍然没有得到很好的了解。 我们提出SYNTH,这是第一个来源于58,698篇维基百科文章的开源合成体,通过结构化拓扑的百科全书种子,将前,中,后训练分解为单一的训练阶段. 我们通过培训一套模型来评估SYNTH:一种56M微小模型(Monad),一种0.3B-0.6B稠密模型(Baguetotron),以及一种13B/1B活性MOE. 在异位计算时,SYNTH比过滤的网络数据超标,我们的模型仍然与类似大小的开放量基线具有竞争力. 由于SYNTH是从禁足的段落回译而来的,SYNTH训练的模型尽管训练符号少了10-100x,但还是实现了高度的实实在在的精度,而记忆被种子体作为目标. 这些结果表明,合成数据集,包括我们的SYNTH数据集,能够从一小部分培训数据中产生具有竞争力的通用模型,随着前沿的进步,能够快速迭代. 这些研究结果为普遍论模型和没有指令或对话数据的特定领域模型提供了可能性,它们都大大提高了数据效率。 最后,我们公开发布我们的SYNTH数据集和Baguetotron模型套件,使用许可,从而支持开源语言模型开发.

articles.title: Zero-shot Dependency Parsing with Unsupervised Cross-Lingual Bootstrapping
articles.content: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) with encoder-based architectures have shown impressive capabilities in zero-shot cross-lingual transfer for various language understanding tasks. However, applying this technique to dependency parsing remains a significant challenge due to its syntactic nature. To boost model generalizability across linguistic typologies, we propose a cross-lingual unsupervised bootstrapping method to improve syntactic knowledge within the PLM. We show that our method achieves a significant improvement in zero-shot parsing performance in low-resource languages. Analysis of these bootstrapped models uncovers increased robustness in recognizing syntactic structures, evidenced by higher scores in parameter-free tree probing tests.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 零射线依赖性分析与无监督的跨语言靴式
articles.content_zh: 具有编码器架构的预训语言模型(PLM)在零射交叉语言传输中表现出令人印象深刻的能力,用于各种语言理解任务. 然而,由于这一技术的协同性质,将这一技术应用于依赖性分析仍然是一个重大挑战。 为了促进各种语言类型模式的通用性,我们提出一种跨语言的无监督的靴套方法,以提高PLM内部的合成知识。 我们显示,我们的方法在以低资源语言进行零镜头剖析的性能上取得了显著的改进. 对这些靴子模型的分析发现,识别合成结构的强度提高,无参数树探查测试的分数较高就是证明。

articles.title: How Many Labels Does a Language Need? Annotation Budgets and Cross-Lingual Pooling for African-Language Text Classification
articles.content: Every text classifier for an African language begins with a budgeting question: how many labelled examples are needed, and can labels from other African languages stand in for them? We answer both questions empirically for 28 language-task pairs, news topic classification in 16 languages (MasakhaNEWS) and tweet sentiment in 12 languages (AfriSenti), using a character n-gram linear model that trains in seconds on two CPU cores with no pretrained weights and no accelerator. Monolingual learning curves at budgets from 25 to several thousand labels show that topic classification reaches 90\% of its full-data macro-F1 with about 400 labels in the median language, while sentiment is still improving at the full training size in 11 of 12 languages and needs thousands of labels. Pooling the full training data of the other languages in the benchmark is worth a great deal at small budgets and nothing at large ones: at 25 target labels it adds 0.20 macro-F1 on average for news (up to 0.43 for Lingala) and 0.08 for sentiment, the gain decays to zero by 800 labels, and at full size pooling hurts in 9 of 16 and 8 of 12 languages. Twenty-five target labels plus pooled data match what 100 to 400 monolingual labels achieve for most news languages. A complete zero-shot transfer matrix shows that transfer without any target labels recovers a median of only 13\% (news) and 4\% (sentiment) of the gap between a majority-class predictor and the in-language model, with the exceptions explained by shared script (Amharic and Tigrinya), shared lexicon (English and Nigerian Pidgin, the Arabic dialects), or a shared label prior rather than by language family. We release code that regenerates every number from the public benchmark files and translate the results into concrete annotation guidance for teams building African-language classifiers without GPUs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言需要多少标签 ? 非洲语言文字分类的注释预算和交叉集合
articles.content_zh: 每个非洲语言的文本分类器都首先提出一个预算问题:需要多少标注的例子,其他非洲语言的标注可以代表它们吗? 我们用经验来回答28个语言任务对,16种语言的新闻主题分类(MasakhaneWS)和12种语言的推特情绪(AfriSenti)这两个问题,使用一个字符ng线性模型,在两个CPU核心上进行几秒钟的训练,没有预先训练的重量和加速器. 预算的单语学习曲线从25到几千个标签显示,主题分类达到了其全数据宏-F1的90QQ,中位语言的标签约为400个,同时在12种语言中的11种语言的全培训规模上情绪仍在改善,需要数千个标签. 将其他语言的全部培训数据集中到基准中,对于小型预算来说是值很多的,而对于大型预算来说是值很多的:在25个目标标签中,平均为新闻增加0.20 宏-F1(林加拉最多0.43),情绪增加0.08,增益衰减为零800个标签,在全尺寸的集合中,12种语言中的9种和8种伤害. 25个目标标签加上集合数据,匹配了100到400个单一语言标签为大多数新闻语言所实现的目标标签. 一个完整的零镜头传输矩阵显示,没有任何目标标签的传输只回收了多数级预测器与语言模型之间差距的中位数13\%(新闻)和4\%(sentiment),但共享脚本(Amharic and Tigrinya),共享词典(英语和尼日利亚语,阿拉伯语方言),或共享标签之前而非语言家族所解释的除外. 我们发布代码,从公共基准文件中重新生成每个数字,并将结果转化为具体注释指导,用于团队建设没有GPU的非洲语分类器.

articles.title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition
articles.content: How many tokens from its context does a language model actually use, and what determines that number? We study this question through self-attention. Without retraining, we retain only the tokens with the highest attention weights at each head, layer, and query, keeping their original weights unchanged. By varying the selected set size and measuring the increase in negative log-likelihood (NLL), we estimate the effective attention set size needed to stay within a chosen loss tolerance. Relatively small selected sets can keep NLL close to the full-attention baseline, although the required size varies across models. Attention-based selection substantially outperforms random selection. Selected sets exhibit geometric structure, although geometric separation alone does not establish that model loss is preserved. Extending context while evaluating the same prediction targets increases the required set size, while its fraction of context decreases over the tested range. Experiments with a fixed supporting fact show that additional background pushes its tokens down the attention ranking and reduces their attention mass. Renormalizing the retained weights can substantially reduce the required set size, showing that it also depends on how selected representations are combined. Conditional theoretical models explain how competition and attention-mass retention can produce growing set sizes without more distinct information to retrieve. These results provide a way to measure effective attention set size in language models and investigate its dependence on context, competition, and aggregation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 竞争下的自我保留能力
articles.content_zh: 一个语言模型从上下文中实际使用多少个符号,是什么决定了这个数字? 我们自觉研究这个问题。 没有再培训,我们只保留每个头,层,和查询中最高关注权重的符号,保持原有权重不变. 通过改变所选的设定大小和测量负对数(NLL)的增加,我们估计了维持在所选的损失容忍度范围内所需的有效关注设定大小。 相对小的选集可以使NLL接近全注基线,尽管所需的大小因模型而异. 基于注意力的选题大大超过随机选题. 选集显示几何结构,虽然仅几何分离并不能证明模型丢失得到保存. 扩展上下文,同时评价相同的预测目标,会增加所需的设定大小,而其上下文的分量则比试验范围减少. 具有固定支撑事实的实验表明,额外的背景会将其符号推低注意力排名,降低注意力质量. 使保留的权重重新正常化可以大幅度降低所需的设定大小,表明它也取决于如何将选定的表述组合起来. 有条件的理论模型解释竞争和注意力质量保留如何在没有更明确的信息检索的情况下产生不断增长的设定大小. 这些结果提供了一种方法,用以衡量语言模型中设定的有效关注规模,并调查其对背景、竞争和汇总的依赖。

articles.title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
articles.content: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO rely on successful self-generated trajectories, but finite rollout budgets can produce all-fail groups with no reward-based policy-gradient signal. While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model's rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportunities for mutual learning without a designated stronger teacher. To exploit this complementarity, we propose GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories), an off-policy-aware framework that replaces all-fail groups with informative peer groups. GRAFT transfers both successful and unsuccessful peer responses with peer-computed advantages, while controlling cross-model mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance ratio clipping. Across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, gaining 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance. Stored peer trajectories preserve most of the gains, improving over GRPO by 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习超越你的样本: RLVR 外政策- 智能跨模式轨迹交换
articles.content_zh: GRPO等可验证奖励(RLVR)方法的强化学习依赖于成功的自我生成的轨迹,但有限的推出预算可以产生全失败组,没有基于奖励的政策级信号. 虽然更多的推广提高了以更高成本取得成功的机会,但一个模型推出过程中缺失的成功轨迹可能已经被另一个模型发现. 的确,我们发现,各种模式往往在互补的激励下取得成功,在没有指定更强有力的教师的情况下创造了相互学习的机会。 为了利用这种互补性,我们提议用同行推论取代回答失败的团体,这是一个不具有政策意识的框架,用信息丰富的同行小组取代所有失败的团体。 GRAFT传送成功和不成功的同行反应,具有同行计算优势,同时通过序列级兼容权重和符号级重要性比剪切控制跨模型不匹配. 在三个不同的模型对和五个数学推理基准中,GRAFT用同样的每个模型推出预算来不断改进两个模型,平均获得2.1分,在模型一级的平均业绩最高达到4.5分。 存储的同行轨迹保留了大部分收益,比GRPO平均提高了1.8分,而没有同时进行共同培训.

articles.title: It's Not What the Image Shows: Irrelevant Context Destabilises VLM Judges Without Informing Them
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of human annotators, making it important that substitutability tests reflect the model rather than incidental evaluation conditions. We introduce MIST, the Misleading-Image Stress Test: 200 English sentences, each built around a phrase readable either figuratively or literally and shown with an aligned image depicting its reading, a misleading image depicting the opposite, or no image at all. The guidelines require the label to be decided from the sentence alone, so no image should change any answer. We expected each image to pull a judge's labels toward the sense it depicts, and neither kind did. Across thirteen VLM judges, an aligned image changed 20.5% of labels and a misleading one 19.4%, close for every judge and both above the 11.6% produced by deleting the ignore-the-image instruction with the image left in place. Yet only 37% of the labels that differ between the two images moved toward the sense shown, and agreement with our human annotators is unchanged whether the image is absent, aligned or misleading. The effect is smaller in the seven judges that pass the alt-test than in the six that never do, but present in all of them: what moves a judge is that an image is there, not which of the two it is, so a substitutability verdict describes a configuration as much as a model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 这不是图像显示的东西:不相关的上下文破坏VLM 法官不知情 他们
articles.content_zh: 展望语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用于代替人的注释器,因此替代性测试必须反映模型而不是偶然的评价条件. 我们介绍MIST,“错误领导-印象压力测试”:200个英文句子,每个句子都围绕一个可读的短语,既可以比喻,也可以用字面意思,用一个描述其阅读的一致图像,一个描绘相反的误导性图像,或者根本没有图像。 准则要求仅从句子中决定标签,因此任何图像都不应改变任何答案. 我们期望每个图像都把法官的标签 引向它所描绘的感受, 但两者都不是。 在13名VLM法官中,一个对齐的图像改变了20.5%的标签,一个误导性的19.4%,对每个法官都关闭,并且都高于11.6%,因为删除了将图像留在原位的忽略图像指示。 然而只有37%的标签 不同两个图像 转向了所显示的感知, 与我们人类的 注释者一致是不变的, 7位通过备选测试的评委中,效果比6位从未通过,但在所有评委中都呈现的评委中要小: 使评委感动的是,一个形象存在,而不是两个形象中的哪一个,所以一个可替代性的判决描述了一个配置和模型一样多.

articles.title: One Threshold Does Not Fit All Languages: Language-Conditional Deferral for Reliable and Efficient Low-Resource Text Classification
articles.content: In the Global South, the lower-income countries of Africa, Asia, and Latin America where most of the world's languages are spoken, a deployed text classifier usually runs on ordinary CPUs, serves many languages with a single model, has few labeled examples in any of them, and relies on people to catch its mistakes. Such a system is only useful if it can promise how often it will be wrong: at most a fixed fraction of the labels it assigns on its own may be incorrect, and everything else must go to a person. Split conformal prediction delivers this promise through a single confidence threshold, normally estimated on validation data pooled across languages. We ask whether the promise reaches every language, and it does not. On MasakhaNEWS (16 African languages) and AfriSenti (12 languages plus two never seen in training), a pooled threshold meets the 90% target on average but covers Somali at 77.5%, Tigrinya at 83.7%, and the two unseen languages at 77.5% and 81.2%. Estimating one threshold per language brings every language to between 89.1% and 91.0% without retraining, and it shows how unequal the cost of the promise is: keeping it means sending 43% of Somali news and over 80% of Amharic and Xitsonga tweets to a person, against under 8% of Nigerian Pidgin news. One or two hundred labels per language are enough and the models train in minutes on one CPU core, so the fix is affordable: calibrate, report, and budget human review one language at a time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个与所有语文不相适应的门槛:可靠和高效低资源文本分类的语文-有条件的推迟
articles.content_zh: 在全球南方,非洲,亚洲和拉丁美洲的低收入国家,世界上大多数语言都使用,一个部署的文本分类器通常运行在普通CPU上,以单一模式服务许多语言,在其中任何一种语言中很少有被贴上标签的例子,依靠人们来捕捉其错误. 这样的系统只有在能够保证其错误的发生频率时才有用:最多它自己分配的标签的固定部分可能不正确,其他一切必须交给一个人. 通过单一的置信阈值(通常根据各种语文的校验数据集合)进行分门别类的预测,就能实现这一承诺。 我们问,承诺是否达到每一种语言,而它没有。 在MasakhanEWS(16种非洲语言)和AfriSenti(12种加两种在培训中从未见过的语言)方面,集合阈值平均达到90%的目标,但覆盖索马里77.5%,提格里尼亚83.7%,两种看不见的语言77.5%和81.2%。 估计每种语言的门槛值为89.1%至91.0%,而不进行再培训,这表明承诺的代价是多么不平等:保持承诺意味着向一个人发送43%的索马里新闻以及超过80%的阿姆哈拉语和西松加语的推文,而尼日利亚皮奇金语新闻则不到8%。 每个语言的一两百个标签就足够了,模型在一个CPU核心上在几分钟内进行训练,因此固定是负担得起的:校准,报告,以及预算人力一次审查一种语言.

articles.title: Storage Is Not Strategy: State-Conditioned Support Control for LLM Unlearning
articles.content: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981, yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35/36. We introduce Intervention Score, which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline (Static-IV). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from +0.431 to +0.848, and SimNPO margins range from +0.503 to +0.571. The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV, the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of +0.165 and +0.0025. The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 存储不是策略: LLM 的状态支持控制 未学习
articles.content_zh: 许多本地化的大语言模型(LLM)不学习方法从本地化信号中选择一个小参数子集,并在优化时保持固定. 然而,与目标最相关的参数不一定是更新的最佳参数,而候选干预措施随着优化工作的进展而改变价值。 在受控实验中,存储-本地化得分达到接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)0.981下的一个区域,然而存储身份却同意仅对17/36目标进行更好的干预,而低档适应(LORA)则赢得35/36. 我们采用干预得分法,在计算附带损害时,按实际未学习更新的预测效果对可编辑群体进行排序,并利用它形成静态干预-价值基线(Static-IV)。 然后,我们引入选择性动态干预重新排序(DIR-R),只有在经过校准的探测器证明比较合理时,才重新审视该子集。 在Natural-TOFU数据集上,我们的方法在方法与目标之间的19/20比较中具有正的描述边际,尽管有几种方法接近零. 在LACUNA本地化-精度基准上,我们的平均终端功能在所有6个负面偏好优化(NPO)和SimNPO比较中都更高:NPO比值从+0.431到+0.848,SimNPO比值从+0.503到+0.571. 梯度偏差(GradDiff)目标揭示了高度的实地依赖性. 相对于静态-IV,初级四战区GradDiff评价有6胜6负,6连带,无亏损,平均和中位成对收益为+0.165和+0.0025. 证据支持区分本地化、初步干预选择和依赖检查站的支助修订。

articles.title: AnthroDial: Benchmarking LLM Anthropomorphism in Autonomous Social Interaction
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as social agents, yet credible human-like interaction requires more than fluent responses or persona consistency. Agents must autonomously decide whether, when, and how to communicate while adapting to evolving contexts, goals, and relationships. Existing research, however, lacks a unified approach to enabling, evaluating, and improving such capabilities in continuous, open-ended interaction. We introduce AnthroDial, a unified framework for developing anthropomorphic social agents from three complementary aspects: MindFlow, a lightweight interaction harness that enables autonomous, asynchronous, and adaptive communication through a dynamic Mind Buffer; CAPS-Eval, a theory-grounded framework for evaluating cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions of anthropomorphic interaction; and a scalable training paradigm that combines SEEDS for environment expansion with DiAPO for adaptive capability optimization. We further construct evaluation datasets covering everyday communication, game interaction, and long-horizon character interaction. Extensive experiments across diverse models and scenarios demonstrate improved interaction autonomy and naturalness, validate the reliability, discriminativeness, and agreement with human rankings of CAPS-Eval, and confirm the effectiveness of our training paradigm. Together, these components provide a unified framework for developing credible human-like social agents in open-ended interaction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AthroDial:将LLM的Athropomorphism作为自主社会互动的基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)作为社会代理人的部署越来越多,但可信的人形互动需要的不仅仅是流利的反应或个人一致性. 代理人必须自主决定是否、何时以及如何在适应不断变化的环境、目标和关系的同时进行沟通。 然而,现有研究缺乏一种统一的方法,无法在持续、开放的互动中促进、评价和改进这种能力。 我们提出了AnthroDial,这是一个从三个互补方面发展人类形态社会主体的统一框架: MindFlow,一种轻量级的相互作用工具,通过动态的“Mind Buffer”实现自主、同步和适应性的交流;CAPS-Eval,一个理论基础的框架,用于评估人类形态相互作用的认知、情感和行为层面;以及一种可扩展的培训范式,将SEEDS用于环境扩展与DiAPO用于适应能力优化。 我们进一步构建涵盖日常通信,游戏互动,以及长视字符互动的评价数据集. 各种模型和情景的广泛实验表明,互动自主性和自然性得到了提高,验证了CAPS-Eval的可靠性、歧视性和与人类排名的一致,并证实了我们的培训模式的有效性。 这些组成部分共同提供了一个统一的框架,在不限名额的互动中发展可信的人类式社会力量。

articles.title: Can Vision-Language Models Stay Helpful When Facing Implicit Risks? Intent-Privilege OPSD for Efficient Safety-Helpfulness Alignment
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain vulnerable to cross-modal implicit risks: visual and textual inputs that appear benign in isolation can jointly elicit unsafe responses. Existing safety methods often require large preference datasets, costly multi-rollout training, or additional safeguards at inference time. They may also sacrifice helpfulness by directly refusing requests that could be answered safely. In this paper, we propose Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which leverages evidence-grounded intent as privileged supervision during training to help VLMs recognize implicit risks and provide safe, useful responses instead of blanket refusals. OPSD distills a teacher's intent-conditioned preferences over responses into a student using a single rollout per prompt; the student then responds without intent annotations or an additional safety module. With only 1,447 safety-specific examples - 95% fewer than standard preference datasets - OPSD reduces training time by 5x relative to multi-rollout GRPO-style training and average inference length by 7%. It attains the highest ratio for joint safety-helpfulness success, which measures the proportion of responses that are both safe and helpful, across all five evaluation groups. Remarkably, on pooled SIUO+HoliSafe, this success ratio rises from 43.9% to 53.5%. These results show that training-time intent supervision can improve both safety and helpfulness while substantially reducing data, training, and inference costs.

articles.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型能够保持有益 当面对隐性风险? 高效安全-帮助协调的蓄意偏好OPSD
articles.content_zh: 远景-语言模型(VLMs)仍然容易受到跨模式隐含风险的影响:孤立地看似无害的视觉和文字投入可共同引起不安全的反应。 现有的安全方法往往需要大型的首选数据集,昂贵的多推出培训,或在推论时需要额外的保障措施. 他们还可能牺牲帮助,直接拒绝可以安全答复的请求。 在本文中,我们提议利用基于证据的意向作为培训期间的特权监督,帮助自愿多数派认识到隐含的风险,并提供安全、有用的回应,而不是一概拒绝。 OPSD将老师对回应的意向性偏好提炼成学生,每时每刻使用一次推出;然后学生在没有意向说明或附加安全模块的情况下做出回应. 由于只有1,447个具体的安全实例——比标准优先数据集少95%——OPSD将培训时间相对于多滚出GRPO式的培训和平均推断长度减少7%,减少5x. 它在联合安全-帮助成功方面达到最高比率,衡量所有五个评价组中安全和有帮助的答复比例。 值得注意的是,在集合的SIUO+HoliSafe中,成功率从43.9%上升到53.5%。 这些结果表明,培训时间意图监督可提高安全和帮助性,同时大大减少数据、培训和推断费用。

articles.title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?
articles.content:
Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back.
  Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.

articles.title_zh: 可缓存决定模式能否遵循规则?
articles.content_zh:
Certo是一个小的非遗传性决定模型(Quen3-4B):它从他们的文本中给候选动作评分,并返回一个概率,而不是生成一个答案. 准确的设计读取状态,规则,以及每个候选人一起(一个联合计分员),因此成本随菜单而增加. 独立编码允许每个候选人被编码一次,并跨州重复使用(约5x便宜,有77名候选人),但将州与候选人分开. 我们问道,这一行动还能在多大程度上保持对规则的敏感性,是否能够对其进行回训练。
关于Certo的四项实验:(1) 经测试转换为可缓存积分会失去规则敏感性(召回@1 1.00 - > 0.24),而联合计分员持有1.00,最后名单+resrank救援失败;(2) 有针对性的反事实监督恢复了被搁置的合成规则任务的强效性(短语、反事实、组成;可跨种子复制),尽管我们并不孤立预测是否取决于所提供的规则;(3) 根据实际规则没有确立附加的好处 -- -- 在确定截断后,联合计分员在短的一级(0.861 vs 0.500)和在硬的一级(0.655 vs 0483 n=29)上取得显著胜利;(4) 匹配的交叉 domain re-prose multure commission无助于并降低了合同的准确性(9.3-16.2分)。 可缓存编码器可以在它的训练分配上成为规则敏感的编码器,但是转录到隐形源真规则并没有建立;联合计分器以缓存为代价保持边.

articles.title: The Geometry of Inference in Transformer Residual Streams
articles.content: Transformer language models build predictions through successive residual updates, but how their representations become specific to an eventual outcome remains unclear. We study this process by comparing intermediate residual states with their own final states and an empirical bank of final states from other contexts. Across six pretrained language models, the own endpoint becomes preferable to the average alternative early, while many individual endpoints remain closer. These competing sets generally shrink with depth, but their membership changes and their surviving endpoints need not become more similar to one another. Directional alignment and endpoint rank can therefore improve while Euclidean distance to the final state changes little. We develop a simple high-dimensional model that separates the roles of norm, alignment, and endpoint geometry, showing how gradual directional changes can produce sharp reductions in competition. We also prove that a straight path toward the own endpoint cannot introduce new competitors under either Euclidean or cosine distance; observed entries thus establish departures from straight-line convergence. Finally, endpoints associated with lower-ranked output tokens tend to lie farther away in cosine distance across all studied models, connecting residual geometry to output organization. Together, these findings characterize increasing geometric specificity during transformer inference and explain why distance, competitor count, and concentration of the surviving endpoints provide distinct views of that process.

articles.title_zh: 变形器残余流推论的几何
articles.content_zh: 变形语言模型通过连续的剩余更新来构建预测,但其表达方式如何具体针对最终结果仍然不清楚. 我们研究这个过程的方法是比较中间残余状态和它们自己的最终状态,以及从其他背景中分析最终状态的经验库。 在所有6种经过预先训练的语言模式中,自己的终点比一般的替代早期更为可取,而许多个别终点仍然比较接近。 这些相互竞争的场景一般以深度缩小,但是它们的会籍变化和存活的终点并不需要彼此更加相似. 因此,方向对齐和终点排名可以改善,而欧几利得与最终状态的距离变化不大。 我们开发了一个简单的高维模型,将规范,对齐,端点几何等角色区分开来,表明渐进方向变化如何能使竞争急剧减少. 我们还证明,一条通往自己终点的直路不能在欧几利得或余弦距离下引入新的竞争者;因此,观察到的条目证实了偏离直线趋同。 最后,与排名较低的输出符号相关的端点往往在各种被研究模型的余弦距离中更远地存在,将剩余几何与输出组织联系起来. 这些调查结果加在一起,说明在变压器推论期间几何特性日益增强,并解释为什么距离、竞争者的计算和幸存终点的集中对这一过程提供了不同的看法。

articles.title: Thinking in Depth, Speaking Directly: Recurrent Latent Reasoning for Paralinguistically Grounded Spoken Dialogue
articles.content: Empathetic spoken dialogue requires models to use both what is said and how it is said to decide how to respond. Explicit CoT can improve paralinguistic perception and make acoustic cues more explicit in replies, yet does not ensure their effective use in response planning. We call this mismatch the perception-reasoning gap. In addition, CoT may not fully capture acoustic cues in words, and generating it adds inference latency. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopSLM, which builds on looped Transformers for latent reasoning, reusing a decoder block to refine hidden states with acoustic grounding at every pass. Its two-stage training further narrows the perception-reasoning gap by separating learning to reason from learning to respond, enabling direct inference without CoT. On EchoMind, LoopSLM improves paralinguistic understanding, reasoning, and reply quality over Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. Against the CoT-SFT baseline, LoopSLM gains over 20 points in reasoning accuracy while generating 64.5% fewer tokens at half the latency. It also outperforms Qwen3-Omni-Thinking on most empathetic reply metrics with 34x lower latency. Despite training only on dialogue data, LoopSLM improves accuracy on general audio benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 深思熟虑,直言不讳:支持语源化的语气对话的经常后遗症
articles.content_zh: 令人同情的口头对话要求模式既要使用所说的话,又要使用如何决定如何作出反应。 明确的CoT可以改善准语言感知,在答复中使声调提示更加明确,但不能确保它们在应对规划中的有效使用. 我们把这个不匹配称为感知-理性差距。 此外,COT可能无法完全捕捉到词中的声调提示,生成它会增加推论的延迟性. 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了LoopSLM,它以循环变形器为基础进行潜伏推理,重新使用解码器块来精炼隐藏的状态,在每个路段都有声学定位. 它的两阶段培训进一步缩小了感知-理性差距,将学习与学习理性区分开来,以回应,使得在没有CoT的情况下可以直接推论. On EchoMind, LoopSLM比Quen2.5-Omni-7B提高了准语言学的理解,推理,以及回复的质量. 对照CoT-SFT基线,LoopSLM在推理精度上获得超过20分,同时在一半的空闲时间生成64.5%的代币. 它在大多数具有34x低潜度的平缓回复度量表上也超过了Qune3-Omni-Think. 尽管只培训对话数据,LoopSLM提高了一般音频基准的准确性.

articles.title: CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data
articles.content: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires identifying training examples that refuse, evade or otherwise fail to fulfil the requested task. But existing annotation covers evaluation sets of a few thousand prompts at most. We present CompOrca, a compliance labelling over the entirety of the 4,233,923-example OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five independent passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters), and the corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncompliance (1.28%), and nonunanimous rows (3.97%) along with the raw vote counts. A single pass flags 2.7-3.2% of the corpus as noncompliant, while only 1.28% is flagged by all five, allowing for filtering the most ambiguous samples. Against 450 human-annotated examples, 150 of them annotated twice (human-human $κ= 0.93$), the unanimous compliance and noncompliance labels are 97.3% and 86.7% precise, the latter a high-precision subset, not a complete enumeration, of noncompliance. Published refusal-detection methods recall only between 0.4% and 94.1% of the noncompliance class. We release the full corpus with its per-row labels and vote counts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca

articles.title: A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses
articles.content: Rubrics support the structured evaluation of language models. We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR.BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.

articles.title_zh: 在大语言模型反应中评价表达式临床理由的拟议Rubric
articles.content_zh: Rubrics支持对语言模型进行结构化评价. 我们提议在模型反应中评估已表达的临床推理,借鉴三个工作机构:医学教育评估框架(ART、SCT、关键特征问题和欧安组织);临床LLM基准(MedR-Bench、Health Bench、TimER-Bench、DR.BENCH、PRIME-LLM和PatientSafe Bench);以及一般LLM推理评价研究,包括Factality-Validity-Coherence-Utility分类学、FaithCoT-Bench和C2-Faith。 我们以禁足为临床导向 适应分类学的事实类别。 标题将这些概念汇集在一个多层面的框架内,对金本位临床卷发的免费文本反应进行评分。 它包括临时行为锚、适用规则和针对具体案件的安全关键错误的单独旗帜。 一般领域框架为它的设计提供了信息,但并不被视为有效的临床仪器。 标题不取代针对具体案例的参考标准或现有基准中针对具体任务的衡量标准。 尚未测试其介于反应器之间的可靠性、构造有效性或临床效用。 其直接目的是在经验测试之前明确作出评价决定并开放审查。

articles.title: Selecting What Matters: Semantic Compression-Guided Selective Pooling for Long-Context Embeddings
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential as training-free text encoders for long-context embeddings. Existing approaches primarily improve information flow under causal attention and typically construct embeddings by uniformly averaging all token representations. However, for long documents, such mean pooling can dilute salient semantic information with abundant redundant or weakly informative content. To this end, we propose SCSP, a training-free framework that leverages semantic compression for informative token selection in long-context embedding. Specifically, SCSP first partitions a document into sentence-aware chunks and appends a semantic compression prompt to each chunk. A prompt-isolated attention mask preserves information flow among document tokens while restricting each prompt to its corresponding local context. We then use the attention patterns elicited by these prompts to estimate token importance, select informative tokens, and aggregate their intermediate-layer representations into the final embedding. Extensive experiments on long-context embedding benchmarks demonstrate that SCSP can be integrated into both zero-shot and fine-tuned models in a plug-and-play manner, consistently improving their performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 选择什么是紧要的: 语义压缩 - 指导 长文本嵌入的选择性集合
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)已经显示出作为长文本嵌入的无培训文本编码器的强大潜力. 现有办法主要改善因果关注下的信息流动,通常通过统一平均所有象征性表示来构建嵌入。 然而,对于冗长的文件来说,这种集合意味着可以淡化大量冗余或信息不足的显著语义信息。 为此,我们提议使用无培训框架SCSP,利用语义压缩在长文本嵌入中选择信息符号。 具体地说,SCSP首先将一个文档分割成句子感知块,并在每个块中附加一个语义压缩提示. 迅速同化的注意遮罩保持了文件符号之间的信息流动,同时将每个提示限制在相应的本地上下文。 然后,我们利用这些提示所产生的注意模式来估计象征性的重要性,选择信息化的符号,并将其中间层的表示综合到最后嵌入中。 关于长文本嵌入基准的广泛实验表明,SCSP可以以插件和游戏方式融入零镜头和微调模型,不断提高它们的性能.

articles.title: Which papyrus HTR is good enough? Character-error-rate tolerance of four papyrological tasks on Greek texts
articles.content: Purpose: Most Greek papyri remain unpublished and undigitised; a handwritten text recognition (HTR) pipeline that transcribes them automatically would let scholars discover documents and literary works that have so far gone unread. Recognition systems for Ancient Greek papyri are in statu nascendi, and how accurate they must be for a given papyrological task has not been examined. To answer this and set a benchmark for Greek papyrus HTR, we test a range of character error rates (CER) against four papyrological tasks, using published editions as ground truth. Methods: From 63,846 current editions of Greek texts in papyri.info, we imitate a letters-only "perfect HTR" output by removing the editorial layer, then degrade it with a seeded algorithm to exact CERs of 1 - 50%, with lost lines and four error-shape variants. On these data we train small models (TF-IDF, fastText, a character CNN, ByT5-small) for document type, dating and documentary-versus-literary classification, and apply eight keyword search methods. We compare models trained on clean text with models retrained at a specific CER level, and evaluate across CERs. Results: Tolerance differs by task. With clean-trained models, documentary-versus-literary classification retains 90% of its metric up to 20% CER; document type up to 7.5%; subtypes and search up to 5%; dating only up to 3%. Retraining on text containing character errors largely eliminates the sharp degradation that otherwise sets in above 15% CER. Models generally tolerate concentrated damage in a long document better than small errors spread across a short text. Conclusion: The study provides a CER target for each of the four tasks and shows that models trained on noisy text make current, imperfect text recognition useful for them.
