articles.title_zh: 哪个papyrus HTR够好了吗? 关于希腊文本的四个乳腺学任务的字符-错误-率耐受性
articles.content_zh: 目的:大多数希腊语papyri仍然没有出版,也没有数字化;一个自动转录它们的手写文字识别(HTR)管道会让学者发现到目前为止还没有读过的文件和文学作品. 古希腊papyri的识别系统处于statu nascendi状态,对于某一特定的papyrology任务,这些系统必须有多准确,但尚未得到审查。 为了回答这个问题并为希腊papyrus HTR设定基准,我们对照四个papyrology任务测试一系列字符错误率(CER),使用已出版的版本作为地面真理. 方法: 从63,846当前版本的papyri.info的希腊文本中,我们通过去掉编辑层来仿真一个只写字母的"完美HTR"输出,然后用种子算法将其降解,精确的CER为1-50%,有丢失的行和四个错误形状的变体. 在这些数据上,我们训练小型模型(TF-IDF, fastText,一个人物CNN,ByT5-small),用于文档类型,约会和文献对文学分类,并应用8个关键词搜索方法. 我们比较经过清洁文本培训的模型和在特定核证的排减量水平上重新培训的模型,并评估所有核证的排减量。 结果: 容忍因任务而异。 有了经过清洁训练的模型,文献分类和文学分类保留了90%的公分数,最高为20%的CER;文档类型最高为7.5%;子类型和搜索最高为5%;只有3%的日期。 对包含字符错误的文本进行再培训,基本上消除了本来设定在15%以上CER的急剧降解。 模型一般能比散落在短文本中的小错误更能容忍长文件中的集中破坏. 结论: 该研究为这四项任务中的每一项提供了CER目标,并表明,经过关于吵闹文本的培训的模型使得当前不完美的文本识别对他们有用.

articles.title: Context Language Models
articles.content: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语境语言模型
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了背景语言模型(CLMs),即本土管理自己背景的语言模型. 我们通过将上下文当作一个文件来实施,并允许模型对这个文件进行不受限制的更新. 这使得模型能够学习上下文中最重要的维护内容,并自然延伸至多个代理环境作为文件共存的多代理系统. 现有模型的CLM零射线比SOTA的上下文管理策略超过各种任务:11.4%的精度更高,浏览Comp-Plus的FLOP减少21.5%;5%的精度较高,12小时边本奇的FLOP减少59%;在24小时多存储代理-恒温任务上,使用同样的计算,提高65%. 此外,通过将上下文管理从外部控制转向内在的模型行为,CLM自然能够同时对上下文管理策略进行内在和参数学的学习. 我们显示,CLM可以通过一个标准的技能优化循环,通过自然语言指令来进行引导,在减少计算的同时,在上下文管理任务上提高被搁置的准确度,达到35.9分。 我们还引入了CLMs的在线强化学习方法,将浏览器Comp-Plus上的Quen3.5-9B性能提高了47.6%,同时使用更少的12%的FLOP. 最后,我们为 CLM 服务共同设计后缀缓存重用,在匹配性能时将服务器侧计算比标准SGLang进一步减少35%.

articles.title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
articles.content: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks. Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum identifies output-sensitive directions and approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream. For causal transformers, the same geometry induces a tokenwise curvature score: a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of the target logits to perturbations of each token's hidden state. This score vanishes outside the causal ancestor set of the target and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings, making it a loss-aware alternative to attention magnitude. We estimate these quantities using matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluate them across decoder-only language models on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb. Empirically, the induced geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to stronger autoregressive distillation objectives such as reverse KL and skew KL. These results support a predictive-geometric view of transformer computation: near successful trajectories, the terminal loss induces a thin, anisotropic set of output-relevant hidden-state directions that can be measured and exploited for compression and distillation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 变形器中隐藏轨迹的预测几何
articles.content_zh: 只有解码器的变压器只能通过终端的下一触控预测损失来训练,然而这一损失通过固定的下游计算来约束每一个中间隐藏状态. 我们通过研究层对层的损耗函数来正式确定这一限制:通过剩余变压器块继续一个候选隐藏状态而获得的终端损失. 围绕成功的验证轨迹,我们显示,这些函数的局部二阶几何学是由隐形空间上一个收回的费舍尔操作员来管理,直到低损余值. 它的频谱确定了输出敏感方向和大约预测-null方向,产生了剩余流的局部可观察到的子空间. 对于因果变压器,相同的几何会诱导一个象征性的曲率分数:目标对数对每个对数隐藏状态的扰动具有费舍尔加权的敏感性. 这个分数消失在目标因果祖先集合之外,由下游的雅各比环控制,使得它成为了注意力量的失落意识的替代品. 我们使用无矩阵的Jacobian-vector和矢量-Jacobian产品来估计这些数量,并在WikiText,OpenWebText和FineWeb上通过全解码器语言模型来评价它们. 经验性地,诱导的几何预测扰动敏感度,支持非统一层分级分配,产生有竞争力的结构化符号喷射信号,并在加入更强大的自旋蒸馏目标如反向KL和Skew KL时,提高低级学生的恢复能力. 这些结果支持了变压器计算的一种预测-几何视角:近乎成功的轨迹,终端损失诱导出一组稀疏的,异位的与输出相关的隐态方向,可以测量和开发用于压缩和蒸馏.

articles.title: Billiger.de Products: A Bilingual Entity Matching Benchmark
articles.content: Existing product matching benchmarks primarily contain English-language product data and are often dominated by a single product category, such as electronics. This paper introduces Billiger.de Products, a bilingual German and English entity matching benchmark covering thirteen consumer product categories, including difficult-to-handle categories such as clothing and furniture. The benchmark data originates from the German price comparison platform billiger.de. Following the design of WDC Products, the benchmark offers multiple variants that differ in the fraction of corner cases, the size of the development set, and the fraction of entities unseen during training. An aligned English translation of every offer keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed, while cross-language test sets combine German and English records within individual pairs. We validate the benchmark using six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on both language versions and the cross-language test sets. The validation shows the difficulty of the benchmark. The comparison of the results on the English version of the benchmark to the results on the German version shows that most matchers score on average higher on the English version. The difference is largest for RoBERTa and HierGAT, while the zero-shot LLM runs are largely insensitive to the language. Comparing the F1 scores achieved by PLM-based matchers on the English version of Billiger.de Products with their performance on existing English-language benchmarks, such as WDC Products and Abt-Buy, shows that Billiger.de Products is more difficult than these benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 比利格尔.de 产品:双语实体匹配基准
articles.content_zh: 现有的产品匹配基准主要包含英语产品数据,并经常以电子等单一产品类别为主. 本文介绍Billiger.de Products,是德语和英语双语实体匹配基准,涵盖13个消费产品类别,包括服装和家具等难以处理的类别. 基准数据来源于德国价格比较平台billiger.de. 在WDC产品设计之后,该基准提供了多个变体,在角箱的分量,开发集的大小,以及培训期间所未见的实体的分量等方面都有差异. 每个报价的对齐英文译文保留所有对数,分数,和标签的固定,而跨语言测试集则将德语和英语记录结合在单个对数之内. 我们用6个受监督的匹配器和零镜头的GPT-5.2来验证基准,这两个语言版本和跨语言测试集. 验证显示基准难度. 将英语版基准结果与德语版基准结果的比较表明,大多数匹配者在英语版平均得分较高. RoBERTa和HierGAT的区别最大,而零镜头LLM运行对语言基本不敏感. 比较基于PLM的配对者在英语版Billiger上取得的F1分数. 以现有英语基准(如WDC产品和Abt-Buy)为依据的产品表明Billiger。 d 产品比这些基准更难。

articles.title: Reader Proficiency Shapes Layer-wise Surprisal Profiles
articles.content: Reading behaviour varies not only with linguistic input, but also with reader proficiency. In this study, we investigate whether the layer-wise relationship between surprisal from large language models (LLMs) and human gaze behaviour differs across readers with different levels of proficiency and across gaze measures. Using eye-tracking data from the MECO L2 corpus, we compare readers with high and low vocabulary proficiency on first-pass gaze duration (FPGD) and total gaze duration (TGD). We quantify the distribution of the predictive power of surprisal across model layers using Predictive Depth. Across 12 tested LLMs, we find that readers with lower vocabulary proficiency tend to show deeper Predictive Depth for FPGD, while this difference is smaller for TGD. Also, TGD itself shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD in both proficiency groups. These patterns suggest that where predictive power is concentrated across LLM layers may be related to the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by different gaze measures, and that this relationship can vary with reader proficiency. Our leave-one-out analysis further shows that the advantage of informative internal layers extends to unseen texts, although the practical improvements in prediction are limited. Overall, our results show that layer-wise LLM surprisal provides a useful perspective on variation in reading behaviour across both reader groups and gaze measures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 阅读器熟练度形状图层- 顺势配置
articles.content_zh: 阅读行为不仅在语言输入上不同,在阅读能力上也不同. 在这项研究中,我们调查大语言模型(LLMs)的顶端与人类的目光行为之间的分层关系,是否因不同水平的熟练程度和不同目光尺度的读者而有所不同. 利用来自MECO L2体的眼跟踪数据,我们比较了阅读器在第一通道视距(FPGD)和总视距(TGD)上的高和低词汇熟练度. 我们用预测深度来量化超导在模型层之间的预测力分布. 在经过测试的12个LLMs中,我们发现词汇熟练度较低的读者往往表现出FPGD更深的预测深度,而TGD的这种差异较小. 此外,技术GD本身显示,在两个熟练组中,预测深度比FPGD更深。 这些模式表明,在预测力集中在LLM层上的地方,可能与不同凝视度量所捕获的读取过程的时间和广度有关,而这种关系会随着读者的熟练程度而变化. 我们的 " 一放一出 " 分析进一步表明,内部资料层的优点扩大到无形文本,尽管预测的实际改进有限。 总体来看,我们的结果显示,分层的 LLM 超热量为读者群体和视线测量在阅读行为上的差异提供了有益的视角。

articles.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
articles.content: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 恩吉世界: 前沿机构在专业工程环境中能提供哪些服务?
articles.content_zh: 自主代理在通用计算机使用方面迅速取得进展,但专业工业工程的可靠自动化仍然遥不可及,因为工程工作流程需要推理,而不是几何学和物理限制以及软件和设计阶段保存的依赖性. 我们介绍EngiWorld,第一个围绕完整设计环线构建的基准:1,301项专家精准任务,涉及6个工程领域(CAD,CAE,CAM,BIM,EDA,和3D可视化)和26个专业软件平台,有GUI和CLI两个界面以及6个任务类型,从软件选择到开放式任务. 我们进一步采用了以人工为中心的评价方法,该方法建立在统一的域-验证器套件上,在方案上检查几何有效性、物理可行性以及最终和中间文物的合规性,并通过规格的实现而不是二进制的成功来不断对定量设计任务进行评分。 对七个前沿模型的评价揭示了一个巨大的能力差距:最强的模型只实现了44.3的Engiscore,只有3.6%的多软件尝试成功. EngiWorld为衡量在运行专业工程软件结束的代理商方面的进展提供了第一个严格的基础.

articles.title: When Models Don't Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Comparison Task
articles.content: One of the current premises of mechanistic interpretability research is that detailed accounts of the geometry of neural network representations can tell us how models perform computations, and how to effectively intervene on them. While low dimensional manifolds have been observed for multiple concepts in the literature (e.g. numbers encoded on helices, days of the week on a circle, ...), with structure believed to reflect properties of data and tasks, the extent to which models rely on them for computation, and how they manipulate them, remains unclear. We characterize precisely the geometry of computation in a number-comparison task, as an abstraction of comparison for decision making, and how models utilize geometry in an elegant fashion to implement it. Specifically, we study the causal geometry of number comparison in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a capable and widely studied open-weight model, and find Qwen largely uses linear representations of numbers despite the presence of curved geometry. To compare two numbers, the model first encodes each number along a vector and adds the two representations using attention and the residual connection, bringing them into a shared space in the residual stream. Then, the model uses MLP neurons to compare the pair of numbers on local regions in this shared space, which correspond to smaller intervals of input numbers, and combines these to obtain the position of the maximum. In fact, this reliance on linear representations for comparison also persists when the model compares three numbers. Our findings demonstrate that the manifold hypothesis can co-exist with linear representations: while concepts that are ordered may have manifold structure in representations, the model may use an underlying linear structure of the concept in certain computations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当模型不操纵 操作符 : 比较任务的几何
articles.content_zh: 目前机械解释研究的前提之一是,对神经网络表现的几何学的详细说明可以告诉我们模型是如何进行计算,以及如何有效干预. 虽然文献中针对多个概念观察到了低维多元性(例如编码于螺旋上的数字,一周的天数在一个圆形上,.),其结构被认为反映了数据和任务的属性,模型在计算时依赖它们的程度,以及它们如何操纵它们,但仍然不清楚. 我们把计算在数字比较任务中的几何定性为决策比较的抽象,以及模型如何以优雅的方式利用几何来实施. 具体来说,我们研究了Quen2.5-7B-Instruct中数字比较的因果几何学,这是一种有能力且被广泛研究的开放量模型,发现尽管存在曲线几何学,Quen还是主要使用数字的线性表示法. 为了比较两个数字,模型首先将每个数字按照一个矢量编码,并增加两个表示法,使用注意力和剩余连接,将它们带入剩余流中的共享空间. 然后,该模型使用MLP神经元来比较这个共享空间中局部区域的对数,对数对应较小的输入数间隔,并结合这些来获得最大值的位置. 事实上,在模型比较三个数字时,这种依赖线性表示进行比较的做法也依然存在。 我们的研究结果表明,多重假说可以与线性表示并存:虽然被命令的概念在表达中可能具有多重结构,但模型可能在某些计算中使用概念的基本线性结构.

articles.title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
articles.content: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: KUPAS MASTER: 将主从业者的精品化为代理经验公司
articles.content_zh: 有经验的专业人员不仅知道事实和结论。 他们知道什么暗示重要,为什么判决合理,以及采取何种行动。 例行工作记录往往不包含这种隐性知识,使得大语言模型(LLM)代理商难以有效利用专业经验. 我们介绍KUPAS MASTER,一个经验工程平台 围绕9层认知体的构建。 它使各种工作记录和从业人员的访谈变成可追踪的、可重复使用的经验。 6个案例要素保留了任务进程:背景、提示、判断、行动、界限和结果。 九层认知体构建沿着9个提取维度组织默认体验,并将由此产生的资产存储在6个图书馆:规则,约束,最佳做法,负面例子,角落案例,以及技能. 语义协调、个人经验提炼、组织整合和交叉审查保留来源证据、使用条件和未解决的分歧。 平台将这些资产组合成有明确投入、步骤、依赖性和停止条件的可调用技能,将收集的经验与任务执行和评价反馈联系起来。 该平台利用20名随机选择的从业人员的授权样本,将1 576份源文件处理为23 024份个人经验记录和13 113项组织资产。 评价涉及多个专业领域。 在共同任务投入和评分标准下,基础模型、原始体检索生成(RAG)和KUPAS MASTER剂分别得分70.63、79.75和89.58。 KUPAS MASTER剂在所有七个评分维度上都改进了原始公司RAG。 该平台提供了一个从个人默许经验到组织知识和代理能力的实际途径。

articles.title: Corpus-Guided Dual-Path Propagation for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation supports multi-hop retrieval by organizing corpus information into graphs. However, existing relation-free graph retrieval methods rely primarily on query-sentence similarity to search for evidence. This can exclude useful bridging evidence with low query similarity and activate incidental entities unrelated to the reasoning chain. In this paper, we propose a simple and effective approach called NexusRAG, which augments the relation-free Tri-Graph with a corpus-level entity neighborhood structure derived from joint entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. NexusRAG employs this structure to guide two complementary propagation paths: neighborhood-constrained semantic propagation through sentences identifies the query-relevant entity frontier, while direct structural propagation between neighboring entities expands that frontier to structurally related entities. The propagated entity weights also inform neighborhood-aware passage initialization for Personalized PageRank. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks and a domain-specific subset of GraphRAG-Bench show that NexusRAG consistently outperforms existing approaches. On the GraphRAG-Bench subset, NexusRAG achieves the highest evidence recall in all question categories, exceeding baselines by 4.2-8.1 points. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/Jacob-biu/NexusRAG.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 图形检索-增强生成的双片介质
articles.content_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成支持多跳的检索,方法是将实体信息组织成图. 然而,现有的无关系图检索方法主要依赖于查询-判决与寻找证据的相似性. 这可以排除与低查询相似的有用的连接证据,并激活与推理链无关的附带实体. 在本文中,我们提出了一个名为NexusRAG的简单而有效的方法,它用从联合实体共同发生和语义相似性衍生出来的实体级实体邻里结构来增强无关系的Tri-Graph. NexusRAG使用这一结构来指导两个互补的传播途径:通过句子来识别与查询相关的实体边界,而邻近实体之间的直接结构传播则将这一边界扩展到与结构相关的实体。 宣传的实体权重也为个人化的PageRank提供了解街区的初始化信息。 对3个多跳QA基准和GraphRAG-Bench特定域子集的实验显示,NexusRAG的绩效始终高于现有方法. 在GraphRAG-Bench子集中,NexusRAG在所有问题类别中实现最高证据召回,超过基线4.2-8.1分. 执行守则见https://github.com/Jacob-biu/NexusRAG。

articles.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
articles.content: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under USD 10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95-99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and ARC and 86.7% on Belebele across 122 languages. It beats Qwen on 27 of 37 datasets, with none of Qwen's nine leads outside the bootstrap intervals, and Gemma on all 37. All three models degrade on low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy labels, and rubric-based quality judgments. Jev's choice probabilities are well calibrated and support selective prediction. Binary probabilities rank well but are poorly placed relative to a fixed 0.5 threshold; thresholds tuned on training data raise micro-F1 on UNFAIR-ToS from 0.50 to 0.75. Jev answers MMLU's calculation-heavy questions more accurately than other MMLU questions (94% vs. 91%), whereas both open models, and all three on C-Eval, find them harder. Rotating the options leaves Jev's accuracy unchanged and withholding the question drops it to near chance, ruling out shallow memorization but not memorized question-answer pairs. We release the code, harness and all raw responses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评价和确定系统一个模型Jev的基准
articles.content_zh: Jev是一个来自TypeSafe AI的商用系统一号模型,不生成文本:由于状态和打字问题,它从固定选项返回选择,在标题上的位置,或者声明真实的概率,供应商描述为校准概率. 这种模式针对信息获取管道中的小决定,如路由查询、检查地面、调制内容或按标题评级。 我们评价37个数据集的Jev(jev-1.13.0)零镜头,这些数据集涵盖分类、路由、自然语言推论、阅读理解、常识推理、温和度、法律条款分析和标分,每个数据集有一个冻结模板,并进行完整的评估:346 009项10美元以下的请求。 参考一下,我们得分是 Qune3.8-27B 和 Gemma-4-E4B 在相同的请求上,通过他们 准确的下接概率 选择。 Jev在IMDB,SST-2,HelaSwag和ARC的精度达到95-99%,在Belebele的精度达到86.7%,使用122种语言. 它在37个数据集的27个上击败了Quen,在靴子间隔之外没有Quen的9个线索,而Gemma则全部在37个中. 所有三种模型都以低资源语言、细微的标签或吵闹的标签以及基于文字的质量判断而退化。 捷夫的选择概率有很好的校准,支持选择性预测. 二进制概率排名良好,但相对于固定的0.5阈值,位置差;根据培训数据调整的阈值将UNFAIR-TOS上的微F1从0.50提高到0.75。 Jev比其他的MMLU问题(94%对91%)更准确地回答MMLU的计算重问题,而开放模型和C-Eval上的所有三个都发现它们更难. 旋转选项使得Jev的准确性保持不变,并扣压问题使其几乎落到机会的地步,排除了浅浅的回忆,但没有记住的问答对. 我们发布了代码, 绳索和所有原始反应。

articles.title: Co-Linguistics: AI-augmented Theory Construction in Linguistics
articles.content: LLMs have been studied in recent linguistics as potential models of humans' linguistic abilities. Here we discuss an entirely different use of AI, namely as a co-scientist, to help construct and assess linguistic theories (we refer to the result as "Co-Linguistics"). Since the 1960s, linguistics has developed theories that are in principle mathematically formalizable, often in the language of formal language theory or model theory. The AI revolution in mathematics will thus have consequences in linguistics-but with an essential twist: proving new theorems is rarely the linguist's goal. Rather, one seeks to find the best set of axioms to derive empirical statements. AI could accelerate research by making existing theories fully explicit, by comparing competing theories, and more ambitiously, by proposing new theories (in machine learning, this relates to "program induction"). It will also help assess theories by accelerating the identification and test of crucial predictions, thanks to unparalleled access to data (in machine learning, this relates to "active learning"). While the cycle from theory evaluation to theory construction may give rise to recursive and possibly autonomous improvement of linguistic theories, humans remain central: linguists provide scientific directions and evaluate theories conceptually, and experimental participants are needed to assess empirical predictions that are outside the reach of LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 共同语言学:人工智能在语言学方面的理论构建
articles.content_zh: 近代语言学研究了LLMs作为人类语言能力的潜在模型. 在这里,我们讨论AI的一种完全不同的用法,即作为共同科学家帮助构建和评估语言理论(我们把结果称为"共同语言学"). 从20世纪60年代起,语言学就发展出原则上数学形式化的理论,常以正式语言理论或模型理论的语言出现. 因此,数学中的AI革命会在语言学中产生后果——但有一个根本的曲折:证明新的定理很少是语言学家的目标. 相反,人们寻求找到一套最好的逻辑来得出经验性陈述。 AI可以通过使现有理论完全明确,比较相互竞争的理论,更雄心勃勃地提出新的理论(在机器学习中,这与"程序诱导"有关)来加速研究. 它还会通过加速识别和测试关键预测来帮助评估理论,这得益于无与伦比的数据获取(在机器学习中,这与"主动学习"有关). 虽然从理论评价到理论构造的周期可能导致语言理论的递归性以及可能自主的改进,但人类仍然处于中心地位:语言学家提供科学方向,在概念上评价理论,需要实验参与者来评估LLMS所无法达到的经验预测.

articles.title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
articles.content: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RLTL; DR: 通过内部化自我产生的反馈进行自我改进
articles.content_zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)的共同模式是让代理人在一项任务中作出多次尝试,并优化对成功任务的尝试。 这在自我改进的领域成为问题,因为任务如此困难,以至于代理商成功的机会很低甚至没有成功机会,而且没有教师模型或实例解决方案从中提炼出来. 在本文中,我们介绍RLTL;DR. 每次尝试失败后,我们都会向政策显示校验输出,并让它以单一TL;DR透视的形式写出自己的反馈. 接下来的推出以所有之前的见解为条件,我们依次进行抽样推出,直到找到解决方案. 此外,我们通过对内容中的深刻见解进行反向传播,将一项直接任务内部化,以深入了解绘图。 关于挑战工具调用和编码数据集(过滤至Pass@128=0),一个Quen 3.5 9B思维政策的标准GPRO训练在Pass@1为0%至1%时保持不变. RLTL; DR突破了这个学习障碍,实现了14-31%的Pass@1,在培训期间有见识,而关键是12-13%的见识在时空没有见识。 我们认为,关键在于深入了解内部化。 为了进一步研究这一点,我们减少了对SFTL;DR的方法,只培训(任务、洞察力)拖拉机,而不展示或支持任何推出。 只有4k的这些拖拉机的培训几乎恢复了RLTL的完整性能;DR和古典SFT在全面推出时几乎完全恢复. 这显示了一种很有希望的紧凑式的训练范式, “关于这种任务,记住这种事情”, 我们希望这能激励未来的研究。

articles.title: Correct, Don't Delete: Mitigating Emergent Misalignment with Corrective Supervision
articles.content: Fine-tuning a language model on a narrow set of harmful demonstrations, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned on unrelated questions, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). The usual defense is to find the offending rows and delete them, but a row locator failed our held-out test and deleting rows helps less than expected. We ask a different question: given a fixed set of poisoned rows, is it better to correct them than to remove them? We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on a mixture of bad medical advice and benign chat data, select a quarter of the poison rows in advance, and either delete them or replace each with a corrected answer to the same prompt, keeping everything else the same. Replacing the rows cuts the EM rate by about a third and improves answers on held-out medical questions, while deleting the same rows has little measurable effect. The advantage is larger when half the poison rows are corrected, and it holds on a second base model and a second misaligned model organism. The content of the replacement appears to matter: paraphrasing the rows while keeping their bad advice shows no clear benefit, and the correct answers distributed with the dataset appear to do about as well as our rewriter's. Realigning an already-poisoned model with further fine-tuning is known to work, but which data does the work has not been compared directly. We find that a short round of training on corrections beats the same amount of training on generic chat data, that corrections on other medical prompts do roughly as well as corrections of the poisoned prompts themselves, and that instructing the correction writer to model a careful, harm-avoiding assistant adds no measurable benefit over plain corrections. In the settings we tested, correcting harmful training data reduces EM more than deleting it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 正确, 不删除: 减轻紧急错位与矫正监管
articles.content_zh: 对狭义的一组有害示威进行语言模型的精细调整,如糟糕的医学建议,可以使其在无关的问题上大致错位,这种现象被称为突发错位(EM). 通常的辩护是找到违法的行并删除它们,但一行的定位器失败了我们的搁置测试和删除行帮助比预期少. 我们问了一个不同的问题:给固定的一组有毒的行,是否比去掉更好呢? 我们微调Qwen2.5-14B-指示 在一个糟糕的医学建议和良性聊天数据的混合上,提前选择四分之一的毒排,或者删除它们,或者用一个更正的答案替换每个药排,让其他的东西都一样. 替换行将EM速率减少约三分之一,改善被搁置医疗问题的答案,而删除同一行几乎没有可衡量的效果. 当一半的毒排被纠正后,其优势更大,它坚守在二基模型和二位错配模型生物上. 替换的内容似乎很重要:在保留错误建议的同时对各行进行解释,没有明显的好处,用数据集分发的正确答案似乎与我们的重写者一样。 重新调整一个带有进一步精细调整的已经精密化的模型已知是有效的,但哪些数据能做工作并没有被直接比较. 我们发现,短期的惩戒培训比一般聊天数据培训要多,其他医疗提示的惩戒工作也大致如此,对中毒者的惩戒工作本身也一样,指示惩戒撰稿人树立一个小心谨慎、避免伤害的助理,比简单的惩戒工作没有多少好处。 在测试的环境下,纠正有害的训练数据比删除更能减少EM.

articles.title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable
articles.content: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45-88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds. Source deference and user agreement are not behaviorally interchangeable inside the model: on matched items with the same wrong answer, causal interventions can selectively suppress one without equally affecting the other. In three open-weight families, removing a fitted source direction lowers source compliance by 65-80 percentage points while removing a user or assistant direction has far smaller effects, and removing the user direction shows the reverse preference. A separately fitted intervention derived from source-versus-user cue activations moves compliance in both directions while leaving the prompt text unchanged. An authority direction fitted on trivia also transfers to PIQA and multi-turn SYCON dialogues without refitting, and removing it lowers wrong-source compliance by tens of percentage points in four of five families with no detected change in MMLU-Pro or GSM8K accuracy at our evaluation sizes. Source deference and user agreement therefore need separate evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型中的偏执权威: 源代码和用户协议不能互换
articles.content_zh: 语言模型往往同意用户所说的任何内容,培训后越来越多地针对这种杂乱无章的现象,使模型能够根据其优点评价索赔,而不是屈从于用户。 然而,当错误的答案被归结于一个经核实的来源时,同样的模型就更加符合要求,这就是检索结果、工具输出和基于搜索的内容如何经常显示信息。 我们测量了5个开放体重家庭和3个封闭API家庭的这一差距。 支持错误答案的单一核实来源说明翻转了8个模型中7个模型中45-88%的基线正确反应,遵守程度随着注释的权威性的提高而上升. 源服从和用户协议在模型内部不能在行为上互换:在有相同错误答案的匹配项目上,因果干预可以有选择地压制一个而不同样影响另一个. 在三个开放量级的家庭中,移除一个装配的源方向会降低源遵守度65-80个百分点,而移除一个用户或助手方向会产生远为较小的效果,移除用户方向会显示反向偏好. 从源码对用户提示激活中得出的单独配制的干预可以使遵守双向移动,同时使及时文本保持不变。 在三维度上安装的指令也向PIQA和多回合SYCON对话框转移而无需调整,并删除该指令将五个家庭中四个家庭中的误源合规率降低了数十个百分点,而根据我们的评价大小,MMLU-Pro或GSM8K的准确度没有发现任何变化。 因此,对来源的尊重和用户的同意需要单独的评价。

articles.title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
articles.content: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FOCUS: LLM 代理商的培训-自由决策-保护环境压缩
articles.content_zh: LLM剂积累了随着任务长度的线性增长的相互作用历史,导致四极推论成本缩放和因注意力稀释而发生性能降解. 现有的上下文压缩方法学习什么是脱机:通过对比优化指南,蒸馏压缩机,或者训练压缩政策. 这需要大量费用。 此外,压缩政策是先入为主的,不以不断变化的试验时间轨迹为动态条件。 在本文中,我们提出一个补充问题: 哪些过去的互动因果决定了代理人的未来决策? 我们把上下文压缩重编成一个因果决定保存问题,凌驾于离散的交互单元之上,并引入FOCUS,一个完全在测试时间运行的无训练上下文压缩框架. 我们的方法不需要离线数据收集或微调,它具有架构可知性,作为模块压缩层附着在任何闭合的API前沿模型上. 我们评价各种代理基准的FOCUS,包括API和工具调用、质量保证、网络域和多回合对话。 我们的方法确立了新的艺术性能水平,将峰值环境削减了48%,依赖性提升了73%,同时将任务成功率提升了8.9个百分点,高于未压缩的执行.

articles.title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
articles.content: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 协助人员通过信息价值合理澄清
articles.content_zh: 语言辅助剂的用户经常提出模棱两可的请求. 对此,一名助理可以直接根据对请求的解释采取行动 -- -- 有可能与用户错位 -- -- 或提出澄清问题。 哪一个选择最安全和最有帮助? 一种常见的方法是提出在达到门槛之前尽量减少用户意图的不确定性的问题. 然而,这忽视了不确定性减少对下游业绩的影响、询问与立即采取行动的费用,以及用户无需询问即可提供更正的可能性。 为了实现这些取舍,我们引入了通过信息价值理性调查。 REVOIR通过对一个问题的信息价值的推断时间推理来作出澄清决定,这捕捉到由于得到的答复而预期任务奖励的改进. 在两个辅助性任务中 -- -- 模糊的问题回答(CondAmbigQA)和偏好协调的家庭任务规划(ADAPT) -- -- 我们显示,REVOIR在问题比基于催化、思维链、微调或信息收益的办法少的情况下取得更大的成功,比经过微调的澄清政策提高13-15%的对ADAPT的偏好满意度,同时不需要培训和问问题少了五倍。 此外,当助理在行动后可以接受廉价的用户矫正时,REVOIR自然推断提问并不总是有效率的,显示了我们的方法的适应性. 相形之下,我们发现香草推理代理商未能适应性地澄清用户请求,随着推理努力的增加,要求更少的澄清.

articles.title: Pair Difficulty Matters: Rethinking Pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation and Consistency
articles.content: Large Language Model judges are widely used to rank texts and text-generating systems through pairwise comparison, and their reliability is typically assessed via three proxies: position bias, transitivity, and pairwise agreement (self- or human-labeled). Because these proxies drive judge selection and benchmarking, a substantial literature reporting that judges perform poorly on them risks steering practitioners away from otherwise capable evaluators. We argue this assessment is misleading. Under the Bradley--Terry geometry underlying pairwise aggregation, each proxy is dominated by close-rank-gap pairs, where inconsistency is information-theoretically expected and individual verdicts contribute little to the aggregate ranking; far-gap pairs carry the ranking signal but barely move the proxies. We formalize this argument and validate it in a controlled simulation and on two human-rated corpora: the proxies correlate only weakly with ranking accuracy against gold, and their predictive component concentrates in the far-gap regime. Judges should therefore be assessed on rank-gap-conditional metrics, ideally against human rankings. Code at https://github.com/brunobrocai/PairDifficulty.

articles.title: MERGE: Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to enrich user queries in information retrieval (IR) so that a standard retriever such as BM25 can bridge vocabulary gaps with the target corpus. Any single LLM, however, is limited by its training data and architectural biases, and its enrichment behavior depends on hand-crafted prompts that must be re-engineered for each new model -- an expensive and poorly scalable process. We present MERGE (Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment), a two-stage framework: three heterogeneous 7-8B open-source LLMs independently produce candidate expansions, and a larger LLM generatively synthesizes them into a single query. To make prompt engineering scalable across the ensemble, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages. Unlike APO methods that judge candidates with an LLM evaluator, our loop scores each candidate by its downstream retrieval performance and runs a small tournament between the current champion prompt and optimizer-proposed drafts, terminating once the champion survives two consecutive rounds; a history-augmented variant additionally feeds the recent tournament trajectory back to the optimizer. MERGE is retriever-agnostic and issues a single BM25 pass with no rank fusion, no supervised document expansion, and no re-indexing. On five BEIR benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touche-2020, DBPedia), MERGE improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the original queries by +2.1 to +14.9 points and matches or outperforms strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines despite using only compact open-source models. Ablations confirm that the Stage-2 ensemble beats any single Stage-1 LLM, and that task-grounded APO converts large seed-prompt regressions into consistent gains without hand-tuning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MERGE: 多种LLM 通过基因浓缩检索集成
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于丰富信息检索(IR)中的用户查询,使BM25等标准检索器能与目标体弥补词汇空白. 然而,任何单一的LLM都受到其培训数据和建筑偏差的限制,其浓缩行为依赖于手工制作的提示,这些提示必须为每个新模型重新设计 -- -- 一个昂贵而难以扩展的过程。 我们提出MERGE(通过基因浓缩检索的多LLM集),一个分为两个阶段的框架:三个相异的7-8B开源LLMs独立产生候选扩展,一个更大的LLM从基因上将它们合成一个单一的查询. 为了使工程能迅速在综艺节目中扩展,我们将一个基于任务的自动即时优化循环(APO)整合到两个阶段. 与使用LLM评价员来评判候选人的APO方法不同,我们循环通过每个候选人的下游检索性能来评分,并在目前冠军迅速和优化提议的草稿之间进行一个小的联赛,一旦冠军连续两轮存活下来就终止;一个历史强化的变体将最近的联赛轨迹再反馈给优化者. MERGE是检索器-不可知的,并且发出单个BM25的通关单,没有分级聚合,没有监督文件扩展,也没有重新索引. 在五个BERR基准(NQ,SciFact,FiQA,Touche-2020,DBPedia)上,MERGE将BM25 nDCG@10比起最初的查询改进为+2.1到+14.9分并匹配或超越了强大的基于LLM的查询-扩展基线,尽管只使用紧凑的开源模型. 缩放证实"阶段-2"合唱团击败了任何单一的"阶段-1"LLM,以任务为基准的APO将大型种子即时回归转换为一致的增益而无需手调.

articles.title: Devils in Question Relay: Source-Conditioned Relay Steering to Mitigate Hallucinations in Audio-visual Large Language Models
articles.content: Audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) have made remarkable progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning through interactions among visual, auditory, and linguistic information. However, recent studies show that AVLLMs face a critical challenge: $\textbf{source-confused grounding hallucination}$, where cues from the unused modality induce responses that the required modality does not support, undermining reliability in real-world applications. Existing methods have made progress in mitigating this failure, yet how it arises from internal cross-modal interactions remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we conduct path-intervention and representation analyses, revealing a $\textbf{question-relay}$ mechanism: question states carry interfering cues alongside required-source evidence, undermining grounding in required-modality evidence. Cutting pathways from interfering modality to question states yields greater correct-answer logit recovery than cutting those to the generation position. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\textbf{SECRET}$ ($\textbf{S}$ourc$\textbf{E}$-$\textbf{C}$onditioned $\textbf{RE}$lay s$\textbf{T}$eering), a training-free method that mitigates cross-modal interference at the question relay. Using contrasting question representations elicited through different modality-pathway interventions, SECRET steers the original question states toward required-source evidence. Experiments on two widely adopted benchmarks CMM and AVHBench across three AVLLMs show that SECRET consistently outperforms prior training-free methods, substantially mitigating source-confused grounding hallucinations (e.g., up to +18.0 and +7.1 percentage points over base models). Modality-specific captioning further demonstrates its generalizability to open-ended generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 问题中继中的恶魔:从源头有条件的中继引导去缓解视听大语言模型中的幻觉
articles.content_zh: 视听大型语言模型通过视觉、听觉和语言信息之间的相互作用,在多式理解和推理方面取得了显著进展。 然而,最近的研究表明,AVLLMs面临着一个关键的挑战:$\textbf{ 来源相通的地平面幻觉}$,其中来自未使用模式的提示诱发了所需模式不支持的反应,破坏了现实世界应用中的可靠性. 现有方法在减轻这一失败方面取得了进展,但如何从内部跨模式互动中产生这种失败仍然没有得到充分的理解。 为了弥补这一差距,我们进行了路径干预和代表分析,揭示了一个$\textbf{问题-中继}美元机制:问题国与所需来源证据一起带有干扰提示,破坏了所需模式证据的基础。 切断从干扰模式到询问状态的路径,比将这些路径切入生成位置更能产生正确的逻辑恢复。 根据这些调查结果,我们提议了$\textbf{SECRET}$ (\textbf{S}ourc$\textbf{E}-$\textbf{C}$\textbf{C}$\textbf{RE}$lay s$\textbf{T},这是一种免训练的方法,可以减轻问题中继器的跨模式干扰. 利用通过不同方式-路径干预而引发的对比性问题表述,SECRET将原始问题状态引向所需来源的证据。 对三个AVLLMs广泛采用的两个基准CMM和AVH Bench的实验表明,SECRET一贯优于以往的无培训方法,大大地减轻了源相混淆的地基幻觉(例如,比基准模型高达+18.0和+7.1个百分点)。 与模式具体相关的标题进一步表明,它对无限制的一代人具有普遍性。

articles.title: Orthogonal Yet Coupled: Decoupling Geometric Components for Model Merging
articles.content:
Merging pretrained models has emerged as an effective approach for consolidating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing merging methods typically treat each task vector as an indivisible merging unit, overlooking the heterogeneous geometric changes encoded within it. This treatment can induce cross-component coupling: when merging decisions are derived from statistics of the complete task vector, the geometric characteristics of one component may influence how another is selected, weighted, or combined, potentially degrading the quality of the merged model. To address this issue, we propose DiGA, a
Disentangled Geometry-Aware model merging framework. Using the pretrained weights as a shared geometric reference, DiGA orthogonally decomposes each task vector into components corresponding to distinct geometric attributes. Rather than merging the task vectors as a whole, DiGA aggregates corresponding components independently within their respective subspaces and subsequently recombines them into a unified update. This component-wise formulation preserves the geometric identity of each component and prevents the characteristics of one component from interfering with the aggregation of another. Furthermore, DiGA can be incorporated into a broad range of existing model merging methods. Extensive experiments across diverse models, tasks, and merging methods demonstrate that DiGA improves merged-model performance and reduces capability degradation. Our repository is on https://github.com/wzj1718/DiGA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 正交相相配: 模型合并的几何元件脱钩
articles.content_zh:
将预先训练好的模型合并起来,已成为将各种能力合并为一个单一统一模型的有效方法。 然而,普遍采用的合并方法通常将每个任务矢量视为不可分割的合并单位,忽略了其中编码的各种几何变化。 这种处理可以诱发交叉成份耦合:当合并决定来自完整任务矢量的统计时,一个成份的几何特征可能会影响另一个成份如何被选择,加权,或合并,从而可能降低被合并模型的质量. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议DiGA,a
分离几何-智能模型合并框架. DiGA正统地将每个任务向量分解成与不同的几何属性相对应的组件。 DIGA不是将任务向量整体合并,而是在各自子空间内独立地汇总相应的组件,并随后将其重新组合成统一的更新. 这种分元配体保持了每个分元的几何特征并避免了一个分元的特性干扰了另一个分相的聚合. 此外,可以将DIGA纳入广泛的现有模式合并方法。 各种模型、任务和合并方法的广泛实验表明,DIGA改善合并模型的性能并减少能力退化。 我们的存放地点在https://github.com/wzj1718/DiGA上。

articles.title: RunyaNER: Auxiliary Language Selection for Runyankore NER
articles.content: Cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual fine-tuning are promising approaches for NLP tasks such as Named Entity Recognition (NER) in low-resource languages, but in the absence of target language benchmarks, it is unclear which auxiliary language selection strategy leads to the best transfer. We introduce RunyaNER, the first publicly available NER benchmark for the East African language Runyankore, and use it to investigate the choice of which languages to use for transfer. Created with a semi-automated pipeline and fully manually verified, RunyaNER contains over 237k annotated words across 30k sentences. We benchmark pretrained models on RunyaNER, establishing that our dataset is of sufficient quality and size to produce effective Runyankore NER models. We then use RunyaNER to investigate auxiliary language selection in cross-lingual zero-shot and multilingual fine-tuning settings. Our experiments show that while transfer performance is highly sensitive to auxiliary language selection, embedding-based measures computed from labelled training spans correlate more strongly with downstream transfer performance than traditional linguistic features based on metadata or typology. By releasing RunyaNER and providing a systematic analysis of auxiliary language selection strategies, this work contributes both a new benchmark resource and practical insights for multilingual transfer in low-resource settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RunyaNER: Runyankore NER 的辅助语言选择
articles.content_zh: 跨语言零发转接和多语种微调是NLP任务如以低资源语言命名实体识别(NER)的有希望的方法,但由于缺乏目标语言基准,尚不清楚哪个辅助语言选择策略导致最佳转接. 我们引入了RunyaNER,这是东非语言Runyankore的第一个可公开使用的NER基准,并用它来调查选择哪些语言用于传输. 由半自动管道所创建并经过完全人工验证,RunyaNER包含超过237k个注解字,跨越了30k句. 我们在RunyaNER上设定了预先训练的模型的基准,确定我们的数据集具有足够的质量和大小,可以产生有效的Runyankore NER模型. 然后,我们使用RunyaNER来调查跨语言零镜头和多语言微调设置中的辅助语言选择. 我们的实验表明,虽然转移性能对辅助语言选择非常敏感,但从标有标记的培训中计算出的嵌入计量与下游转移性能的关系比基于元数据或类型的传统语言特征更为密切。 通过释放RunyaNER和对辅助语言选择战略进行系统分析,这项工作既为低资源环境下的多语种转让提供了新的基准资源又提供了实用的见解。

articles.title: E-MoE: Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts for Non-Factorized Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking several tokens per denoising step, but their reverse process is typically factorized over positions, limiting sample quality in the few-step regime where diffusion's speed advantage over autoregressive decoding matters most. A recent line of work introduces a continuous Gaussian latent, trained as a variational autoencoder, to capture correlations across positions, but such approaches are prone to posterior collapse, where the latent is silently ignored. We propose Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (E-MoE), which builds the reverse process as a mixture of factorized distributions over a discrete shared latent given by the expert-routing decisions of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone, without increasing active parameters over the factorized baseline. Across synthetic multi-modal benchmarks, binarized MNIST, and LM1B, E-MoE improves few-step generation over factorized baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: e-MoE:非辅助传播语言模型的强化混合
articles.content_zh: 蒙面扩散模型(MDMs)通过每个去诺化步骤逐渐解开数个符号来生成序列,但其反向过程通常会因地制宜地在位置上被分解,在扩散速度优势大于自递解码的少数步骤制度中限制了样本质量. 最近的工作线引入了连续高斯语潜想,作为可变自编码器进行训练,以捕捉不同位置的相通性,但这类方法容易后起倒闭,而潜想被默默地忽略. 我们提议加强专家的混合,通过这种混合,在专家的交流决定给一个专家的骨干所赋予的离散的共享潜伏物上进行要素化分配,而不是在要素化基线上增加活性参数。 在整个合成多模式基准、二进制的MNIST和LM1B中,E-MoE比因子化基线改进了几步生成。

articles.title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
articles.content: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 愿景-语言模型基准的分级压缩
articles.content_zh: 对视觉语言模型(VLMs)的彻底评价已经变得昂贵得令人望而却步,因为各种基准跨越不断扩展的能力范围,新的模型步入了无情的步伐。 将模型排名保留在成本一分之一的基准压缩方法对语言模型进行了很好的研究,但对VLMs来说,这个问题仍然没有得到充分的探讨. 我们介绍的是PRIME Bench(为多式联运评价运行冗余项目),这是一个具有远见的分级基准压缩框架,在保留模型排名的同时,大幅降低评价成本。 这种分级框架分四个阶段运作:数据清理以删除没有图像和全部正确项目可回答的项目;类别代表选择以选择每个能力类别的一个基准;项目与Vision-Aware Difference(VAW)进行核对;以及类别计数核对。 暴力侵害妇女问题将模型间差异与仅从多式联运嵌入计算出的视向分数结合起来,同时鼓励在每个基准内涵盖各种项目。 在从项目选择中抽取的模型上,它的平均忠诚度最高,只保留5%。 分级设计让从业者在任何阶段都停下来来配合他们的计算预算;所发行的套房在保留模型排名的同时删除了超过97%的项目. 除了压缩外,我们的分析还显示VLM评价如何随着模型面板的成长和演变而运作,为设计更有效率、更能模拟更替率的未来基准提供了指导,并明确了评价侧伸展的限度。

articles.title: From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using feedback from a stronger teacher. Teacher interventions can improve these trajectories, but also change the distribution on which the student learns. Our controlled studies show that rollout quality alone is an incomplete criterion for allocating teacher guidance. Deeper intervention yields diminishing gains in rollout accuracy while increasing off-policy load. In a training probe with a restricted rollout horizon, peak student accuracy and performance retention favor different intervention strengths. The preferred intervention depth and placement also vary across benchmarks. These findings motivate MAESTRO, which uses local policy disagreement to jointly adapt when the teacher takes over and how long it generates. Its {policy disagreement score} combines teacher-weighted candidate coverage with local distribution similarity and is aggregated within reasoning paragraphs. Across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MAESTRO achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among the compared methods for both 0.6B and 1.7B Qwen3 students, with the 1.7B student leading on every benchmark. MAESTRO also reduces average training response length by 67.3\% relative to standard OPD. The code is available at https://github.com/yhao-wang/MAESTRO.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从干扰到管弦乐: 教师对政策扭曲的干预
articles.content_zh: 政策分解(On-political distractation (OPD)) 利用更强教师的反馈,对学生进行自己的推理轨迹培训. 教师的干预可以改善这些轨迹,但也改变学生学习的分布. 我们的控制研究显示,推广质量本身是分配教师指导的不完整标准。 更深入的干预在推出准确性方面导致收益下降,同时增加了政策外的负担。 在有限推出视野的训练探测器中,学生最高精度和成绩保留有利于不同的干预优势. 理想的干预深度和位置也因基准而异。 这些发现激励了MAESTRO,它利用地方政策上的分歧来共同适应教师接管的时间和产生时间. 其{政策分歧分数}将教师加权候选人的覆盖率与地方分布相似性结合起来,并在推理段落中加以汇总。 在整个8个数学推理基准中,MAESTRO在0.6B和1.7B Quen3两个学生的比较方法中实现了最高的宏观平均准确性,1.7B学生在每个基准上领先. 与标准OPD相比,MAESTRO还减少了平均训练响应长度67.3\%. 该码可在https://github.com/yhao-wang/MAESTRO上查阅.

articles.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
articles.content: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.

articles.title_zh: 学习为长期记忆获取缺失证据QA
articles.content_zh: 长期记忆可以使语言模型在未来的对话中使用过去的交互. 然而,回答一个问题所需的证据可能分散在遥远的转弯中,而问题本身却忽略了找到它所需的线索. 获取的事实可以揭示这些线索,激发以已经发现的证据为条件的检索决定. 我们介绍MERA(Missing-Evience Retrieval Advancement),它将全球可搜索的内存与特定问题的证据状态区分开来. 被验证的证据指导随后的检索工作,不限制访问全球内存. 我们通过强化学习来训练一个轻量级计划员, 奖励那些找回先前缺失的证据的询问。 MERA在Qwen3-30B和GPT-4o-mini骨干间实现强答精度. 由于Qune3-30B用于证据处理和答案生成,经过培训的0.6B规划师在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S的精确度分别达到77.40%和71.29%,超过30B规划师未经检索基础培训分别达到4.10%和3.96%. 在"LoCoMo"上,后回取回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回

articles.title: Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse
articles.content: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

articles.title_zh: 看看你给我们制造了什么组合:来自Reddit演讲的仇恨叙事提取
articles.content_zh: 叙事取材让我们能够识别出网上的仇恨叙事,支持构建严格的侦测系统. 然而,现有的计算方法在精确度上是有限的,因为它们依赖于语义表述,而语义表述往往只捕捉出地表水平的意义. 为了发现更精确和可解释的叙述,我们提出了一种提炼管道,作为实体评价的对称。 叙述法采用大语言模型(LLM)推理程序取出,该推理程序扩展了基于视角的感官分析,确定了这一方面,将其判断类型归类为评价的基础,并据此得出评价。 然后利用Leiden将摘录的叙述组合起来,然后通过LLM制导的精炼过程,将说明组合解决到预定的颗粒度水平。 我们用2024年批评泰勒·斯威夫特(Taylor Swift)的英国Reddit评论来说明这一叙事程序,分析一个展示仇恨言论模式的有代表性的集群,以展示其解释价值。

articles.title: Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models
articles.content: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.

articles.title_zh: 将学习问题纳入语言模型的适应方案
articles.content_zh: 模型适应通常由固定的食谱来规范,尽管不同的更新程序可以产生实质性的行为结果. 我们提出适应汇编,重新界定一个模型应作为共同预测和决定问题加以调整的地点、方式和程度。 一个编译器不是重新搜索每个学习集的候选程序,而是从先前的适应中学习,以预测一个矢量值的反事实反应表面在候选程序之上 -- -- 它们预期对获取、转移、界限和保护的影响 -- -- 在适应开始前选择一个程序。 因为这种预测几何可以捕捉到多种行为后果,而不是单个得分或分数,所以可以在不同的下游优先事项下被再利用而无需再培训. 在五种学习类型中,首选方案在不同阶段之间有着有意义的差异,这种差异从适应前信息可以预测。 在Llama-3.1-8B上,编译器选取的程序采用详尽无遗的搜索方法,同时优于全球和目标特定的默认. Gemma-2-9B的复制保留了程序异质性和选择头室,但表明利用这个头室需要在远离强烈的默认时考虑不确定性. 这些结果加在一起表明,适应搜索可以在相关学习问题上进行分期摊还,将先前的适应经验转化为决定未来应如何进行学习的基础。

articles.title: SemOPT: Fixing Semantic Errors in LLM-based Optimization Modeling via Reward-Guided Search
articles.content: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT, a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SemOPT:通过Reward-Guided搜索修复基于LLM的优化模型中的语义错误
articles.content_zh: 业务研究支持能源、经济和保健等领域的决策。 解决操作研究问题一般从优化模型入手,将自然语言问题描述转化为可执行解码. LLMS提供了使这一过程自动化的有希望的方法,但它们仍然容易出错. 在实践中,这些出错可以被分为两类: 综合出错指的是无法成功运行或被解码者判断为不可行的解码; 语义出错指的是成功返回客观值但违反原问题意图的解码. 由于语义错误不会触发运行时间故障,因此很难发现和纠正. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了SemOPT,一个修正基于LLM的优化模型的语义指导框架. SemOPT将一个将忠实的数学模型与可信而不正确的模型区分开来的语义奖励模型与一个适应性的校正系统结合起来,在建模空间上应用等级奖励指导搜索. 对7个优化模型基准的实验表明,SemOPT建立了新的技术水平,比复杂数据集上最强的基准平均提高了7.6%。

articles.title: Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation: Mitigating the Deliberation Drift Cliff in Test-Time Compute Scaling
articles.content: Test-time compute scaling has emerged as a cornerstone of advanced machine reasoning, yet performing iterative deliberation directly within continuous latent representation spaces reveals a catastrophic pathology: the Deliberation Drift Cliff. While unconstrained recurrent latent models achieve initial reasoning gains at short horizons (K <= 4), their reasoning collapses when extrapolated to deeper thinking steps (K >= 16), dropping by 22% to 62% across standard logical benchmarks. We resolve the trilemma among expressivity, Lyapunov stability, and computational efficiency in test-time latent reasoning through a 22-round empirical and theoretical investigation. We demonstrate that strictly conservative scalar potential gradient flows suppress long-range drift (cliff 3.40%) but bottleneck peak reasoning accuracy at 32.73%, whereas unconstrained rotational flows achieve high symbolic expressivity (82.33%) but suffer a severe 36.87% drift cliff. To resolve this geometric duality, we establish Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) and propose the Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD). DG-HHD parameterizes the attracting flow as a tangent projection tensor network while orthogonally decoupling non-zero circulation (Hodge machine error 1.65e-17, contraction error 5.55e-17), eliminating runtime autograd dependencies to achieve 1.84x vector field and 2.09x RK45 rollout speedups. In a 15-arm symmetrical Pareto benchmark, DG-HHD achieves 58.67% peak accuracy (+25.94% absolute gain over conservative HHD) and retains 35.27% at K=32. Transferred to small language model (SLM) multi-hop causal reasoning, DG-HHD delivers monotonic compute scaling (49.33% to 51.56%) and suppresses out-of-distribution drift (cliff -0.66%). All 30 Level 0 deterministic invariants are certified.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 汉密尔顿港 后审议: 在测试-时间计算缩放中减轻审议漂流崖
articles.content_zh: 测试时间计算缩放已成为先进机器推理的基石,然而在连续潜在代表空间内直接进行迭接审议揭示出一种灾难性的病理:"被解放的漂流之崖". 虽然不受约束的反复出现的潜在模型在短距离(K QQ 4)上实现了初始推理收益,但当推导到更深的思维步骤(K QQ 16)时,它们的推理崩溃了,在标准逻辑基准上下降了22%到62%. 我们通过22轮的经验和理论调查,解决了表达力、Lyapunov稳定性和测试时间潜在推理的计算效率之间的三难。 我们证明,严格保守的斯卡尔潜在梯度流抑制了长程漂移(cliff 3.40%),但瓶颈峰值推理精度为32.73%,而不受约束的自转流则实现高象征性的表达性(82.33%),但承受了严重的36.87%的漂流悬崖. 为解决这种几何双重性,我们建立了哈密尔顿港Lentent Delection(PH-LD),并提出了直立-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge分解(DG-HD). DG-HHD参数化吸引回流为正切投射收音机网络,而正切脱钩非零回流(Hodge机器出错1.65e-17,收缩出错5.55e-17),去除运行时自动分级依赖,以达到1.84x向量场和2.09x RK45推出速度. 在15臂对称的帕雷托基准中,DG-HHD达到了58.67%的峰值精度(+25.94%的绝对增量高于保守的HHD),并保留了35.27%的K=32. 被转移至小语言模型(SLM)多跳因子推理,DG-HHD提供单调计算缩放(49.33%至51.56%)并抑制出放漂移(cliff-0.66%). 所有30个等级的0决定性变量都经过认证.

articles.title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
articles.content: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在不停止的情况下解决:在小规模上进行政策上的分解
articles.content_zh: 政策分解(On-political discription),即学生从更强大的老师对自己产出的反馈中学习,是将推理传递给更小的模型的一种常见方式. 我们分析它在小尺度上的转移,将Qune3-8B分馏入Qune3 4B,1.7B和0.6B的学生,在思维模式(理性在长度上,然后结束推理和回答)中,并进行比较,在非思维模式(没有单独的推理阶段)中. 长推理需要两种能力,解决一个问题,知道何时解决,我们发现蒸馏会转移第一个,但在思维模式中却不是第二个. 解决的每个大小都有改善,最高有两个上限,我们综合地测量了两种模式和所有学生的大小:学生的一次尝试从未超过在训练前许多尝试中已经达到的水平,学生越小,就越能停留在教师以下。 停止是模式的一部分。 在非思考模式下,每个学生都不停地停止;在思维模式下,学生在训练初期就停止了推理,而学生越小,这种能力越活得越少:教师几乎只在学生已经停止推理的情况下才发出停止信号,因此蒸馏教不会出现新的停止;它只会让学生现有的停止在正确的答案上,而弱小的学生很少有这样的停止. 最小的学生往往达到正确的价值,但并不承诺:他们要么很少给它作标记,要么给它作标记并写出过去. 这些结果共同描述了小学生在政策分解下的行为方式,以及将回答标记,正确性和停止性分开的诊断.

articles.title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
articles.content: Can reasoning models trick chain of thought (CoT) monitors and perform hidden computation without revealing it in their thinking traces? We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. Simple computations can be performed covertly; however, beyond a threshold depending on model size, successfully solving the task necessarily leaks a near-linear amount of information about the covert task input into the CoT. Therefore, sufficiently complex hidden computation always leaves an information-theoretic footprint. However, concerningly, this leakage need not be readable: Under plausible cryptographic assumptions, even a one-layer Transformer can encrypt its reasoning online so that no polynomial-time monitor can extract information about the hidden computation. Overall, our theoretical and empirical results provide a holistic view of both the opportunities and the limitations of CoT monitoring.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 隐性理由必须漏出,但不需要可读:思维链监测的基本机会和限制
articles.content_zh: 推理模型能把思维链(COT)监视和进行隐藏的计算而不在思维痕迹中披露它吗? 我们显示答案取决于基本任务难度和模型大小. 简单的计算可以隐蔽地进行;然而,在取决于模型大小的阈值之外,成功解决任务必然会泄露关于隐蔽任务输入 CoT 的近线性信息. 因此,足够复杂的隐藏计算总是留下信息理论足迹。 然而,就这一渗漏而言,无需可读: 在合理的密码假设下,即使是一层变形器也可以在线加密其推理,这样任何多名时显示器都无法提取关于隐藏计算的信息. 总而言之,我们的理论和经验成果提供了一种整体观点,说明气候技术监测的机会和局限性。

articles.title: Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents
articles.content: An agent that uses tools typically responds to what the user explicitly asks, yet completing the task may require information the user never requested. Work on proactive agents mainly studies whether and when an agent should act on its own, not what information it should pursue. We study a distinct axis of proactivity: its content. Horizontal proactivity pursues unstated information that the current context already identifies, and vertical proactivity pursues needs that only earlier evidence reveals. A need graph, recovered from a benchmark's own decomposition, records which needs depend on which, so both forms, and whether the agent stops at the right time, can be scored from a transcript without a model judge. To learn this behavior, we propose Q&D (questioner and drafter), which trains a questioner to prefer the question whose continuation retrieves more of the required evidence, with no reward model or judge. On held-out splits of three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, at equal retrieval spend, the trained questioner improves both forms of proactivity over the same model, prompted, and outperforms a prompted model $15\times$ larger in the same role on two of the three, and the gain persists after controlling for question volume and length. Without further training, we place the questioner in an interactive customer-service agent with a simulated customer, where it completes more tasks while asking fewer questions, and in retail it outperforms the $15\times$ larger model with fewer follow-up turns from the customer. These results show that proactivity depends not only on whether an agent acts without being asked, but also on what it chooses to pursue and when it stops.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 询问从未要求的东西: 代理中的横向和纵向主动性
articles.content_zh: 使用工具的代理人通常会响应用户明确要求,但完成任务可能需要用户从未要求的信息. 主动代理人的工作主要是研究代理人是否以及何时应该自行行动,而不是研究它应该追求什么信息. 我们研究一个明显的积极轴心:它的内容。 横向主动性追求的是当前上下文已经确定的未说明的信息,而纵向主动性追求的是只有更早的证据才揭示的需求. 需要的图表,从基准本身分解中恢复,需要哪些记录,所以这两种表格,以及代理人是否在合适的时间停止,都可以在没有模型法官的情况下从笔录中得分. 为了了解这种行为,我们提议 QQD(质疑者和起草者),它训练一个提问者更喜欢继续获取更多所需证据的问题,没有奖赏模型或法官. 在三个多跳问答基准的被搁置分出时,在同等检索开支的情况下,训练有素的提问者改进了两种形式的主动性,超越了同一模式,促使在三个模式中两个模式发挥相同作用时,效果比一个激励模式大15美元,在控制提问量和长度后,收益仍然维持不变。 没有进一步的培训,我们就把问话者放在一个与模拟客户互动的客户服务代理中,在模拟客户服务代理中,它完成更多的任务,同时询问较少的问题,在零售中,它的表现超过了15\times$更大的模型,而客户的后续转折较少. 这些结果显示,主动性不仅取决于代理人是否在没有被询问的情况下行事,还取决于代理人选择追求什么以及何时停止.
